Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Basic
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.TimeConstructible
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.InputLength
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.VirtualInput
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Seam
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Bin
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.Transducer
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.WordTests

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Space-constructible functions

[AB09, §4.1, p. 79]: `S : ℕ → ℕ` is space-constructible when some machine
computes `S(|x|)` from `x` within `O(S(|x|))` space, and the book's standing
convention is `S(n) > log n`. The definition mirrors
`Complexity.TimeConstructible` — output in binary (`Nat.bits`), constant slack
`c · S n`, which implements the book's own asymptotic space convention
([AB09, p. 79]: "computes `S(|x|)` in `O(S(|x|))` space"); an exact-space
variant is not posed here (the exact-**time** refutation of chapter 1 does not
transfer: a space deadline forces no premature halt) — and carries the book's
convention as the conjunct `∀ n, logSpace n ≤ S n`, so that downstream
statements (the space hierarchy, Savitch) can draw on it without restating it;
results needing only weaker hypotheses must say so.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.SpaceConstructible` — the binary-output, constant-slack,
  above-log form. [AB09, §4.1, p. 79]

## Main results (proved)

* `Complexity.spaceConstructible_iff` — the definition as an equivalence.
* `Complexity.spaceConstructible_logSpace` — `log` is space-constructible.
* `Complexity.spaceConstructible_linear` — `n + 1` is space-constructible.
* `Complexity.spaceConstructible_poly` — `n ^ c + 1` is space-constructible for `c ≥ 1`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1, p. 79.)
-/

namespace Complexity

open Turing

/-- A function `S` is **space-constructible** when it dominates the logarithm
(`Complexity.logSpace`, the book's standing `S(n) > log n` convention carried as
data) and some machine computes the binary representation of `S (|x|)` from `x`
within `c · S (|x|)` visited work-tape cells. Mirrors
`Complexity.TimeConstructible` (binary output via `Nat.bits`, constant slack).
[AB09, §4.1, p. 79] -/
def SpaceConstructible (S : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ n, logSpace n ≤ S n) ∧
  ∃ c : ℕ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ M : FinTM Bool,
    M.ComputesInSpace (fun x => (S x.length).bits) fun n => c * S n

/-- **Space constructibility, unfolded**: `S` is space constructible exactly when
`logSpace n ≤ S n` for every `n` and, for some constant `c > 0`, some machine computes
`x ↦ (S |x|).bits` in space `c · S` (`Turing.FinTM.ComputesInSpace`). -/
theorem spaceConstructible_iff (S : ℕ → ℕ) :
    SpaceConstructible S ↔
      (∀ n, logSpace n ≤ S n) ∧ ∃ c : ℕ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ M : FinTM Bool,
        M.ComputesInSpace (fun x => (S x.length).bits) fun n => c * S n :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Positive binary words have exactly the normalized logarithmic width. -/
private lemma b3a_bits_length {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n.bits.length = logSpace n :=
  (LogProg.length_bits_eq_log hn).trans (logSpace_eq n).symm

/-- The counter word with its first cell overwritten by `true`. -/
private def b3a_word (n : ℕ) : List Bool := true :: n.bits.tail

/-- The overwrite handles zero while preserving every positive counter width. -/
private lemma b3a_word_length (n : ℕ) : (b3a_word n).length = logSpace n := by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    simp [b3a_word, logSpace, Nat.bits]
  · simp only [b3a_word, List.length_cons, List.length_tail, b3a_bits_length hn]
    unfold logSpace
    omega

/-- Restricting a buffer to its occupied nonnegative interval does not change it. -/
private lemma b3a_buffer_restrict (w : List Bool) (z : ℤ) :
    (if 0 ≤ z ∧ z < (w.length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape w z else none) =
      FinTM.bufferTape w z := by
  by_cases hzero : 0 ≤ z
  · by_cases hlast : z < (w.length : ℤ)
    · simp [hzero, hlast]
    · have out : w.length ≤ z.toNat := by omega
      simp [hzero, hlast, FinTM.bufferTape]
  · simp [hzero, FinTM.bufferTape]

/-- Setting the first buffered cell yields `true :: tail`, including an empty buffer. -/
private lemma b3a_buffer_overwrite (w : List Bool) (z : ℤ) :
    (if z = 0 then some true else FinTM.bufferTape w z) =
      FinTM.bufferTape (true :: w.tail) z := by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst z
    simp [FinTM.bufferTape]
  · by_cases hp : 0 ≤ z
    · have ht : z.toNat ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp only [if_neg hz, FinTM.bufferTape, if_pos hp, List.getElem?_cons,
        if_neg ht, List.getElem?_tail]
      congr 1
      omega
    · simp [hz, FinTM.bufferTape, hp]

/-- A live phase seam: its word is on tape zero and all heads are at the origin. -/
private def b3a_cfg {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] {S : Type} (s : S)
    (x w : List Bool) : Cfg k Bool S x :=
  { Cfg.init s x with
    workTapes := fun j => if j = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape w else fun _ => none }

/-- Map only the control field of a canonical phase seam. -/
private lemma b3a_cfg_map {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] {S T : Type} (f : S → T)
    (s : S) (x w : List Bool) :
    (b3a_cfg (k := k) s x w).mapState f = b3a_cfg (f s) x w := rfl

/-- Relocate a single-buffer seam along a selection preserving tape zero.
**Proof sketch.** Selected tapes use the public configuration projections;
other tapes use the frame theorem at time zero. All unused cells and heads are blank. -/
private lemma b3a_embed_cfg {m k : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero k] {S : Type}
    (R : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (hzero : ι 0 = 0)
    (s : S) (x w : List Bool) :
    embedEmitCfg ι (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (b3a_cfg s x w) =
      b3a_cfg (k := k) s x w := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · funext j
    by_cases chosen : j ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := chosen
      rw [embedEmitCfg_selected_tape]
      have hz : ι i = 0 ↔ i = 0 := by rw [← hzero, ι.injective.eq_iff]
      simp only [b3a_cfg, hz]
    · have frame := (embedEmitTM_frame ι R (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
        [] (b3a_cfg s x w) 0).1 j chosen
      have hj : j ≠ 0 := fun eq => chosen ⟨0, hzero.trans eq.symm⟩
      simpa [b3a_cfg, hj] using frame.1
  · funext j
    by_cases chosen : j ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := chosen
      rw [embedEmitCfg_selected_pos]
      rfl
    · exact (embedEmitTM_frame ι R (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
        [] (b3a_cfg s x w) 0).1 j chosen |>.2
  · rfl

/-- A coarse constant-factor space bound for tape relocation.
**Proof sketch.** Every selected tape is bounded by the source's total space;
each unused tape contributes one cell. Sum this common bound over the host bank. -/
private lemma b3a_embed_space {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (R : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
    (d : Cfg m Bool S x) (t : ℕ) :
    (embedEmitTM ι R).spaceUsed
        (embedEmitCfg ι (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] d) t ≤
      k * (R.spaceUsed d t + 1) := by
  unfold MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin k, (R.spaceUsed d t + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      by_cases chosen : j ∈ Set.range ι
      · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := chosen
        rw [(embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead ι R (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] d t i).2]
        exact (R.spaceUsedByTape_le_spaceUsed d t i).trans (Nat.le_succ _)
      · rw [(embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_frame ι R (fun _ _ => none)
          (fun _ => 0) [] d t j chosen).2]
        omega
    _ = _ := by simp [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed]

/-- The additive space ledger for an arbitrary live-exit seam: the general seam space lemma
`Turing.seamCompTM_spaceUsed_le_add_ofCfg`, with this file's argument names. -/
private lemma b3a_seam_space {k : ℕ} {S T : Type} [DecidableEq S] {x : List Bool}
    (R : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (exit : S) (Q : MultiTapeTM k Bool T) (entry : T)
    {d e : Cfg k Bool S x} {a b : ℕ} (run : R.runFrom d a = e)
    (live : e.state = some exit) (cut : ∀ u < a, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) :
    (seamCompTM R exit Q entry).spaceUsed (d.mapState Sum.inl) (a + 1 + b) ≤
      R.spaceUsed d a + Q.spaceUsed (e.mapState fun _ => entry) b :=
  seamCompTM_spaceUsed_le_add_ofCfg R exit Q entry run live cut

/-- The public native counter, specialized to blank origin tapes with a cardinality ledger.
**Proof sketch.** Instantiate R8.5c at its entry, identify the globally blank frame
with the buffer layout, and enclose each head's visited set in the promised interval.
The first-exit clause is retained for the subsequent dispatch. -/
private theorem b3a_counter :
    ∃ (K : ℕ) (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S)
      (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool S) (entry exit : S) (B : ℕ),
      ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t,
        R.runFrom (b3a_cfg entry x []) t = b3a_cfg exit x x.length.bits ∧
        (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom (b3a_cfg entry x []) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
        R.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg entry x []) t ≤ B * (x.length.bits.length + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨K, S, fs, ds, R, entry, exit, C, contract⟩ := exists_inputLengthTM
  letI := fs
  letI := ds
  refine ⟨K, S, fs, ds, R, entry, exit, (K + 1) * (2 * C + 1), ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨t, _, cut, heads, finished⟩ := contract (b3a_cfg entry x []) rfl rfl
    (by intros; simp [b3a_cfg]) (by intros; simp [b3a_cfg])
  refine ⟨t, ?_, cut, ?_⟩
  · rw [finished]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext j z
      by_cases hj : j = 0
      · simp [b3a_cfg, hj, b3a_buffer_restrict]
      · simp [b3a_cfg, hj]
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · have perTape (j : Fin (K + 1)) : R.spaceUsedByTape (b3a_cfg entry x []) t j ≤
        2 * (C * (x.length.bits.length + 1)) + 1 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (Finset.Icc (-((C * (x.length.bits.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ))
            ((C * (x.length.bits.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)).card := by
          apply Finset.card_le_card
          intro z hz
          obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
          have bound := heads u (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hu)) j
          simpa [b3a_cfg, Finset.mem_Icc, abs_le] using bound
        _ = _ := by rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin (K + 1), (2 * (C * (x.length.bits.length + 1)) + 1) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => perTape j
      _ = (K + 1) * (2 * (C * (x.length.bits.length + 1)) + 1) := by simp
      _ ≤ (K + 1) * ((2 * C + 1) * (x.length.bits.length + 1)) := by
        apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
        ring_nf; omega
      _ = _ := by ring

/-- The public constant writer overwrites cell zero and returns to its origin.
**Proof sketch.** Use R8.4 with `[true]`. Its four-step trace supplies the exact
exit cut and two-cell head interval; the buffer update is the tail identity above. -/
private theorem b3a_overwrite (x w : List Bool) :
    (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]).runFrom (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x w) 4 =
        b3a_cfg .done x (true :: w.tail) ∧
      (∀ u < 4, ((writeConstTM 1 0 [true]).runFrom
        (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x w) u).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]).spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x w) 4 ≤ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, heads⟩ := writeConstTM_run_ofCfg (0 : Fin 1) [true]
    (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x w) rfl
  norm_num only [List.length_singleton] at run
  refine ⟨?_, cut, ?_⟩
  · rw [run]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext j z
      have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp only [b3a_cfg, Cfg.init, hj, if_pos, List.length_singleton,
        zero_add, sub_zero]
      simp only [true_and, show (0 ≤ z ∧ z < 1) ↔ z = 0 by omega]
      by_cases hz : z = 0
      · simp [hz, FinTM.bufferTape]
      · simpa [hz] using b3a_buffer_overwrite w z
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · change ∑ j : Fin 1, _ ≤ 2
    rw [Fintype.sum_subsingleton _ (0 : Fin 1)]
    calc
      _ ≤ (Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) 1).card := by
        apply Finset.card_le_card
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
        simpa [b3a_cfg] using heads 0 u (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hu))
      _ = 2 := by decide

/-- The emitting phase shares tape zero and places its bank after the native counter bank. -/
private def b3a_virtualSelect (K m : ℕ) : Fin (1 + m) ↪ Fin (K + 1 + m) where
  toFun i := ⟨if i.val = 0 then 0 else K + i.val, by split_ifs <;> omega⟩
  inj' := by
    intro i j eq
    apply Fin.ext
    have vals := congrArg Fin.val eq
    dsimp at vals
    split_ifs at vals <;> omega

/-- The initial virtual-input layout is the single-buffer phase seam.
**Proof sketch.** Split the host tapes into its buffer and source bank. The source
starts at input position one, with blank work tapes and all heads at zero. -/
private lemma b3a_virtual_cfg (L : FinTM Bool) (x y : List Bool) :
    vhostCfg (L.tm.initCfg y) true (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) [] =
      b3a_cfg (L.tm.q₀, true) x y := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · funext j z
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i
      have zero : Fin.castAdd L.k (0 : Fin 1) = 0 := rfl
      change FinTM.bufferTape y z =
        (if Fin.castAdd L.k (0 : Fin 1) = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape y else fun _ => none) z
      rw [if_pos zero]
    · have nonzero : Fin.natAdd 1 i ≠ (0 : Fin (1 + L.k)) := by
        intro eq
        have vals := congrArg Fin.val eq
        simp only [Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.val_zero] at vals
        omega
      simp only [vhostCfg, Fin.addCases_right, b3a_cfg, if_neg nonzero,
        MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]
  · funext j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp [vhostCfg, b3a_cfg, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]
    · simp [vhostCfg, b3a_cfg, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]
  · rfl

/-- Assemble the three public phases with an explicit boundary-inclusive space allowance.
**Proof sketch.** Count on a native bank, overwrite its first cell, then host the
length counter on that word. Both seams dispatch at their first exits. The public
relocation and seam ledgers bound total space by a fixed multiple of the normalized
logarithm plus one; the final virtual-input halt emits the full binary answer. -/
private theorem b3a_log_machine :
    ∃ (A : ℕ), 0 < A ∧ ∃ M : FinTM Bool,
      M.ComputesInSpace (fun x => (logSpace x.length).bits)
        (fun n => A * (logSpace n + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨K, S, fs, ds, R, entry, exit, B, counter⟩ := b3a_counter
  letI := fs
  letI := ds
  obtain ⟨L, b, computes, space⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed
  let k := K + 1 + L.k
  let ic : Fin (K + 1) ↪ Fin k := Fin.castAddEmb L.k
  let iw : Fin 1 ↪ Fin k := Fin.castLEEmb (by dsimp [k]; omega)
  let iv := b3a_virtualSelect K L.k
  have ic0 : ic 0 = 0 := rfl
  have iw0 : iw 0 = 0 := rfl
  have iv0 : iv 0 = 0 := by apply Fin.ext; simp [iv, b3a_virtualSelect]
  let C := embedEmitTM ic R
  let W := embedEmitTM iw (writeConstTM 1 0 [true])
  let E := embedEmitTM iv (vhostEmitTM L.tm)
  let CW := seamCompTM C exit W (.wr 0)
  let H := seamCompTM CW (Sum.inr .done) E (L.tm.q₀, true)
  let M : FinTM Bool :=
    { k := k
      State := (S ⊕ WritePhase 1) ⊕ (L.State × Bool)
      tm := {H with q₀ := Sum.inl (Sum.inl entry)} }
  refine ⟨k * (B + b + 8) + 1, by omega, M, ?_⟩
  intro x
  let y := b3a_word x.length
  obtain ⟨t, counted, countCut, countSpace⟩ := counter x
  obtain ⟨written, writeCut, writeSpace⟩ := b3a_overwrite x x.length.bits
  -- Count and overwrite share the buffer; their first-exit cuts justify both dispatches.
  have countRun : C.runFrom (b3a_cfg entry x []) t =
      b3a_cfg exit x x.length.bits := by
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg R ic ic0 entry x [], embedEmitTM_runFrom, counted,
      b3a_embed_cfg R ic ic0]
  have countFirst : ∀ u < t, (C.runFrom (b3a_cfg entry x []) u).state ≠ some exit := by
    intro u hu
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg R ic ic0 entry x [], embedEmitTM_runFrom]
    exact countCut u hu
  have writeRun : W.runFrom (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) 4 =
      b3a_cfg .done x y := by
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw iw0 (.wr 0) x x.length.bits,
      embedEmitTM_runFrom, written, b3a_embed_cfg (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw iw0]
    rfl
  have writeFirst : ∀ u < 4,
      (W.runFrom (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) u).state ≠ some .done := by
    intro u hu
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw iw0 (.wr 0) x x.length.bits,
      embedEmitTM_runFrom]
    exact writeCut u hu
  have cwRun : CW.runFrom (b3a_cfg (Sum.inl entry) x []) (t + 1 + 4) =
      b3a_cfg (Sum.inr .done) x y := by
    simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using seamCompTM_run_ofCfg C exit W (.wr 0)
      countRun rfl countFirst (by simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using writeRun)
  have cwFirst : ∀ u < t + 1 + 4,
      (CW.runFrom (b3a_cfg (Sum.inl entry) x []) u).state ≠ some (Sum.inr .done) := by
    simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg C exit W (.wr 0) .done
      countRun rfl countFirst (by simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using writeRun) rfl
      (by simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using writeFirst)
  -- The last phase forwards the hosted counter's full output, including its halting step.
  let u := b * (y.length + 1)
  have tag : FinTM.VirtualTag (L.tm.initCfg y).inputPos true := by
    simp [FinTM.VirtualTag, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]
  obtain ⟨tagEnd, _, hosted⟩ := vhostEmitTM_runFrom L.tm (L.tm.initCfg y) true tag
    (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) [] u
  have emitted : E.runFrom (b3a_cfg (L.tm.q₀, true) x y) u =
      embedEmitCfg iv (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
        (vhostCfg (L.tm.runFrom (L.tm.initCfg y) u) tagEnd (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) []) := by
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg (vhostEmitTM L.tm) iv iv0 (L.tm.q₀, true) x y,
      ← b3a_virtual_cfg, embedEmitTM_runFrom, hosted]
  have fullRun := seamCompTM_run_ofCfg CW (Sum.inr .done) E (L.tm.q₀, true)
    cwRun rfl cwFirst (by simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using emitted)
  have start : M.tm.initCfg x = b3a_cfg (Sum.inl (Sum.inl entry)) x [] := by
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [M, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, b3a_cfg, Cfg.init]
  refine ⟨(t + 1 + 4) + 1 + u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
    rw [start]
    change (H.runFrom _ _).state = none ∧ (H.runFrom _ _).output = _
    rw [show b3a_cfg (Sum.inl (Sum.inl entry)) x [] =
      (b3a_cfg (Sum.inl entry) x []).mapState Sum.inl from rfl, fullRun]
    obtain ⟨halted, output⟩ := (FinTM.computesInTime_iff L y _ u).mp (computes y)
    simp only [Cfg.mapState, embedEmitCfg, vhostCfg, List.nil_append,
      halted, output, Option.map_none, y, b3a_word_length, and_self]
  · rw [start]
    change H.spaceUsed _ _ ≤ _
    -- Add the three boundary-inclusive ledgers before absorbing the constant slack.
    have firstLedger := b3a_seam_space C exit W (.wr 0) (b := 4)
      countRun rfl countFirst
    have lastLedger := b3a_seam_space CW (Sum.inr .done) E (L.tm.q₀, true) (b := u)
      cwRun rfl cwFirst
    simp only [b3a_cfg_map] at firstLedger lastLedger
    have cSpace := b3a_embed_space R ic (b3a_cfg entry x []) t
    rw [b3a_embed_cfg R ic ic0] at cSpace
    have wSpace := b3a_embed_space (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw
      (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) 4
    rw [b3a_embed_cfg (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw iw0] at wSpace
    have eSpace := b3a_embed_space (vhostEmitTM L.tm) iv
      (vhostCfg (L.tm.initCfg y) true (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) []) u
    rw [b3a_virtual_cfg, b3a_embed_cfg (vhostEmitTM L.tm) iv iv0] at eSpace
    have eSource := vhostEmitTM_spaceUsed_le L.tm (L.tm.initCfg y) true tag
      (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) [] u
    rw [b3a_virtual_cfg] at eSource
    have sizeBound : Nat.size y.length ≤ y.length := by
      rw [← Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
      exact length_bits_le_self _
    have width := LogProg.length_bits_le_log x.length
    have yLength : y.length = logSpace x.length := b3a_word_length _
    have nativeBound : C.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg entry x []) t ≤
        k * (B * (logSpace x.length + 1) + 1) := by
      apply cSpace.trans
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
      apply Nat.add_le_add_right
      exact countSpace.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left B (Nat.add_le_add_right width 1))
    have writerBound : W.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) 4 ≤ k * 3 := by
      exact wSpace.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega))
    have emitterBound : E.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (L.tm.q₀, true) x y) u ≤
        k * (b * (logSpace x.length + 1) + logSpace x.length + 3) := by
      apply eSpace.trans
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
      have ls := space y u
      have bound := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left b (Nat.add_le_add_right sizeBound 1))
      rw [yLength] at bound eSource ls
      omega
    calc
      _ ≤ C.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg entry x []) t +
          W.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) 4 +
          E.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (L.tm.q₀, true) x y) u :=
        lastLedger.trans (Nat.add_le_add_right firstLedger _)
      _ ≤ k * (B * (logSpace x.length + 1) + 1) + k * 3 +
          k * (b * (logSpace x.length + 1) + logSpace x.length + 3) := by
        exact Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add nativeBound writerBound) emitterBound
      _ ≤ (k * (B + b + 8) + 1) * (logSpace x.length + 1) := by
        ring_nf; omega

/-- **The logarithm is space-constructible.** [AB09, p. 79: "all functions of
interest, including `log n`, …, are space-constructible"]

**Proof sketch.** Fill obligations: a machine that (i) counts the input length
in binary on a work tape by one left-to-right input scan with a binary
increment at each step (the `Turing.counterTM`/`incrementTM` idiom — P11 of
`machine-library-design.md` §4, space-annotated per §12 R3) — the counter word
has `|Nat.bits n| = logSpace n` cells **for `n > 0` only** (`Nat.bits 0 = []`
has length `0 ≠ logSpace 0 = 1`), so (ii) the empty
input is special-cased to emit `(logSpace 0).bits = [true]` directly, and
otherwise the machine computes the counter word's bit-length by a second count
and emits its bits. Space: the counters and markers fit in
`A·(logSpace n + 1) ≤ 2A·logSpace n` visited cells (boundary cells included
before absorbing, since `logSpace n ≥ 1`); the dominance conjunct is `le_refl`
at `S = logSpace`.

**Fill appendix.** The empty-input special case is realized uniformly: after
R8.5c counts the native input, the constant writer sets the first buffered cell
to `true`. The resulting word has length `logSpace n`, including at zero. A
Z1-hosted Catalog length counter emits its binary length and genuinely halts.
Both live exits are intercepted at their first visits. The space ledger includes
the native head intervals, the overwrite boundary, the virtual-input boundary
cells and the fresh bank, giving `A * (logSpace n + 1)` before absorption. -/
theorem spaceConstructible_logSpace : SpaceConstructible logSpace := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, M, hM⟩ := b3a_log_machine
  refine ⟨fun _ => le_rfl, 2 * A, by omega, M, ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hs⟩ := hM x
  refine ⟨t, ht, hs.trans ?_⟩
  have hlog : logSpace x.length + 1 ≤ 2 * logSpace x.length := by
    unfold logSpace
    omega
  calc
    A * (logSpace x.length + 1) ≤ A * (2 * logSpace x.length) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hlog
    _ = (2 * A) * logSpace x.length := by ring

/-- **Linear space is constructible**: `n ↦ n + 1` is space-constructible (the
`+ 1` prevents the inherited zero-bound collapse at `n = 0` — the zero-bound
convention, `SpaceComplexity/ZeroSpace.lean` — and satisfies the dominance
conjunct; zero-space classes are nonempty, so this is about collapse, not
vacuity).

**Proof sketch.** The input-scan counter of
`Complexity.spaceConstructible_logSpace`, **initialized at `1`** so that after
`n` consumed symbols it holds `n + 1` (an uncorrected length counter holds `n`
and emits the wrong word); emit its bits. Space:
the counter's binary width plus fixed administrative cells fit in
`A·(n + 2) ≤ 2A·(n + 1)` visited cells; dominance is `logSpace n ≤ n + 1`
(`1 ≤ 1` at `n = 0`; a small arithmetic lemma otherwise).

**Fill appendix.** The counter initialized at `1` is realized by the Catalog
length counter on `true :: x`, using the proved prepend and buffered-composition
rows. Its linear running time bounds all visited work-tape cells, including
the counter width and boundary cells. -/
theorem spaceConstructible_linear : SpaceConstructible fun n => n + 1 := by
  refine ⟨logSpace_le_succ, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨P, a, hp, _⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_prepend_spaceUsed [true]
  obtain ⟨L, b, hl, _⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed
  let M := FinTM.bufferedCompTM P L
  refine ⟨M.k * (a + 2 * b + 4) + 1, by omega, M, ?_⟩
  intro x
  let t := a * (x.length + 1) + (x.length + 1) + 2 + b * (x.length + 2)
  refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [M, t] using FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesInTime P L (hp x) (hl ([true] ++ x))
  · have ht : t + 1 ≤ (a + 2 * b + 4) * (x.length + 1) := by
      dsimp [t]
      ring_nf; omega
    calc
      M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ M.k * (t + 1) :=
        M.tm.spaceUsed_le_mul_succ _ _
      _ ≤ M.k * ((a + 2 * b + 4) * (x.length + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ht
      _ ≤ (M.k * (a + 2 * b + 4) + 1) * (x.length + 1) := by
        rw [← Nat.mul_assoc]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ _)

/-- The tail transducer's transition: one bit of state, "the first bit has been read". -/
private def scp_tailδ : Bool → Bool → Bool := fun _ _ => true

/-- The tail transducer's emission: nothing on the first bit, the bit itself afterwards. -/
private def scp_tailO : Bool → Bool → Option Bool := fun q b => if q then some b else none

/-- After the first bit the tail transducer copies its input. -/
private theorem scp_transduce_copy (l : List Bool) : transduce scp_tailδ scp_tailO true l = l :=
  transduce_of_copy _ _ true (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) l

/-- From its start state the tail transducer computes `List.tail`. -/
private theorem scp_transduce_tail (x : List Bool) :
    transduce scp_tailδ scp_tailO false x = x.tail := by
  cases x with
  | nil => exact transduce_nil _ _ _
  | cons b l =>
    rw [transduce_cons]
    simp only [scp_tailO, scp_tailδ, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Option.toList_none,
      List.nil_append, scp_transduce_copy, List.tail_cons]

/-- The unary intermediate is short: `(|x.tail| + 1) ^ c ≤ |x| ^ c + 1`. -/
private theorem scp_tail_pow_le (c : ℕ) (x : List Bool) :
    (x.tail.length + 1) ^ c ≤ x.length ^ c + 1 := by
  cases x with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b l => simp

/-- The conditional's value: for `1 ≤ c`, the branch function is `x ↦ (|x| ^ c + 1).bits`
(`0 ^ c + 1 = 1` on the empty input; otherwise the count of `true :: 1ᴾ` with
`P = (|x.tail| + 1) ^ c = |x| ^ c`). -/
private theorem scp_value (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (x : List Bool) :
    (if decide (x = []) then Nat.bits 1
      else Nat.bits (true :: List.replicate (1 * (x.tail.length + 1) ^ c) true).length) =
      Nat.bits (x.length ^ c + 1) := by
  cases x with
  | nil =>
    simp only [decide_true, if_true, List.length_nil]
    rw [zero_pow (by omega), Nat.zero_add]
  | cons b l =>
    simp only [reduceCtorEq, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, List.length_cons,
      List.length_replicate, Nat.one_mul, List.tail_cons]

/-- The main branch's time, as arithmetic: with `P = (|x.tail| + 1) ^ c ≤ N + 1`, `N = |x| ^ c`,
and `|x.tail| ≤ |x|`, the four phases' exact times sum to at most
`(5c + 20 + 3c_L)(N + |x| + 1)`. -/
private theorem scp_time_arith (c cL t n P N : ℕ) (hP : P ≤ N + 1) (ht : t ≤ n) :
    n + 1 + t + 2 + (1 + 5 * c + 4) * P + P + 2 + (0 + 1 + P + 1) + (0 + 1 + P) + 2 +
      cL * (0 + 1 + P + 1) ≤ (5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) * (N + n + 1) := by
  have h1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (1 + 5 * c + 4) hP
  have h2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cL hP
  nlinarith [h1, h2, Nat.zero_le (c * n), Nat.zero_le (cL * n), Nat.zero_le (cL * N),
    Nat.zero_le (c * N)]

/-- The conditional's time, as arithmetic: with `n ≤ N`, the bound
`c_M (c_D (n + 1) + max (c₁ (n + 1)) (K (N + n + 1)) + 1) + 1` is at most `A (N + 1)` for
`A = c_M (c_D + c₁ + 2K + 2) + 1`. -/
private theorem scp_space_arith (cM cD c₁ K n N : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ N) :
    cM * (cD * (n + 1) + max (c₁ * (n + 1)) (K * (N + n + 1)) + 1) + 1 ≤
      (cM * (cD + c₁ + 2 * K + 2) + 1) * (N + 1) := by
  have hmax : max (c₁ * (n + 1)) (K * (N + n + 1)) ≤ c₁ * (n + 1) + K * (N + n + 1) :=
    max_le_add_of_nonneg (Nat.zero_le _) (Nat.zero_le _)
  have e1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cD hn
  have e2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₁ hn
  have e3 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left K hn
  have hin : cD * (n + 1) + max (c₁ * (n + 1)) (K * (N + n + 1)) + 1 ≤
      (cD + c₁ + 2 * K + 2) * (N + 1) := by
    nlinarith [hmax, e1, e2, e3]
  have h4 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cM hin
  nlinarith [h4, Nat.zero_le (cM * (cD + c₁ + 2 * K + 2))]

/-- **Polynomial bounds are space-constructible** [AB09, p. 79]: for `1 ≤ c`, the normal-form
bound `n ^ c + 1` is `Complexity.SpaceConstructible`. (Degree zero is excluded: `n ^ 0 + 1 = 2`
fails the bundled `logSpace n ≤ S n` at large `n`; consumers route degree
zero through monotonicity into degree one.)

**Proof sketch.** Dominance: `logSpace n ≤ n + 1 ≤ n ^ c + 1` (`Complexity.logSpace_le_succ`,
and `n ≤ n ^ c` for `1 ≤ c`). The witness machine computes
`x ↦ (|x| ^ c + 1).bits` as a timed conditional on `x = []`
(`Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond`, with the decider
`Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_decideEq []`). On the empty input the constant
writer emits `(1).bits`, which is the value since `0 ^ c + 1 = 1`. Otherwise four phases run by
buffered composition (`Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesInTime`), each at its exact time:
1. a two-state transducer drops the first bit (`Complexity.transducerTM_computes`; from its
   second state it copies, `Complexity.transduce_of_copy`);
2. the unary generator `polyUnaryTM 1 c` writes `(|x| - 1 + 1) ^ c = |x| ^ c` ones;
3. `prependTM [true]` adds one more;
4. the length counter emits the binary length `|x| ^ c + 1`.
The four times sum to `O(|x| ^ c + |x| + 1)`, because the unary word has length at most
`|x| ^ c + 1`, so the conditional halts within `A (|x| ^ c + 1)` steps for a constant `A`
(`|x| ≤ |x| ^ c`). Space follows from time: a `k`-tape machine visits at most `k (t + 1)`
work-tape cells in `t` steps (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_le_mul_succ`), which gives the
space constant `k A + 1`. -/
theorem spaceConstructible_poly (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) :
    SpaceConstructible fun n => n ^ c + 1 := by
  -- the published rows
  obtain ⟨L, cL, hL⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits
  obtain ⟨D, cD, hD'⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_decideEq []
  obtain ⟨K₁, c₁, hK₁⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_const (Nat.bits 1)
  let T := transducerTM scp_tailδ scp_tailO false
  let U := FinTM.polyUnaryTM 1 c
  let P := FinTM.prependTM [true]
  let N := FinTM.bufferedCompTM (FinTM.bufferedCompTM (FinTM.bufferedCompTM T U) P) L
  let f₂ : List Bool → List Bool := fun x =>
    Nat.bits (true :: List.replicate (1 * (x.tail.length + 1) ^ c) true).length
  -- the main branch, input by input: exact times of the four phases, composed
  have hN : N.ComputesFunInTime f₂ fun n => (5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) * (n ^ c + n + 1) := by
    apply (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro x
    have hT : T.ComputesInTime x x.tail (x.length + 1) := by
      have h := (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp
        (transducerTM_computes scp_tailδ scp_tailO false) x
      rwa [scp_transduce_tail] at h
    have hU := (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp (FinTM.polyUnaryTM_computes 1 c) x.tail
    have hP := (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp (FinTM.prependTM_computes [true])
      (List.replicate (1 * (x.tail.length + 1) ^ c) true)
    have hL' := (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp hL
      ([true] ++ List.replicate (1 * (x.tail.length + 1) ^ c) true)
    have h₁ := FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesInTime T U hT hU
    have h₂ := FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesInTime _ P h₁ hP
    have h₃ := FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesInTime _ L h₂ hL'
    apply h₃.mono
    have hp := scp_tail_pow_le c x
    have htl : x.tail.length ≤ x.length := by simp
    simp only [List.length_replicate, Nat.one_mul, List.length_append, List.length_cons,
      List.length_nil]
    exact scp_time_arith c cL x.tail.length x.length _ _ hp htl
  obtain ⟨M, cM, hM⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond hD' hK₁ hN
  -- the value
  have hval : (fun x : List Bool => if decide (x = []) then Nat.bits 1 else f₂ x) =
      fun x => Nat.bits (x.length ^ c + 1) := by
    funext x
    exact scp_value c hc x
  rw [hval] at hM
  -- time, then space from time
  refine (spaceConstructible_iff _).mpr ⟨fun n => ?_,
    M.k * (cM * (cD + c₁ + 2 * (5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) + 2) + 1) + 1, by omega, M, ?_⟩
  · have h1 := logSpace_le_succ n
    have h2 : n ≤ n ^ c := Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) n
    omega
  · apply (FinTM.computesInSpace_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro x
    refine ⟨_, (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp hM x, ?_⟩
    apply (MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_le_mul_succ _ _ _).trans
    have hB := scp_space_arith cM cD c₁ (5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) x.length (x.length ^ c)
      (Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) x.length)
    calc M.k * (cM * (cD * (x.length + 1) + max (c₁ * (x.length + 1))
            ((5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) * (x.length ^ c + x.length + 1)) + 1) + 1)
        ≤ M.k * ((cM * (cD + c₁ + 2 * (5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) + 2) + 1) * (x.length ^ c + 1)) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hB
      _ ≤ (M.k * (cM * (cD + c₁ + 2 * (5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) + 2) + 1) + 1) *
            (x.length ^ c + 1) := by
        rw [← Nat.mul_assoc]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ _)

end Complexity
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/CounterProgSim.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.CounterProgRun
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.UnaryLogspace

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Simulating counter programs in logarithmic space

A counter program (`Complexity.CounterProg`, the model of the emitters of [AB09, Remark 6.7])
that runs for polynomially many steps keeps every register polynomially bounded, so its
registers fit in `O(log n)` bits. This file builds the abstract register machine
`Complexity.CPSim.A P l₀ lm` that, on `⟨1ⁿ, bits p⟩`, runs `P` with its registers, its input
position and the *number* of printed bits held in binary, reading the input of `P` through
two deciders (the length and bit languages of the input) and stopping at the `p`-th printed
bit [AB09, §4.3: composing implicitly logspace computable functions, by recomputing bits on
demand].

This file defines the machine and proves the simulation of one counter step
(`Complexity.CPSim.sim_step`); the whole run and the resulting closure property are in
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.CounterProgSimRun`.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.CPSim.A` — the simulating machine; `lm` selects the length language.
* `Complexity.CPSim.ev` — the register file of a counter state.

## Main results

* `Complexity.CPSim.sim_step` — one counter step is simulated, or the machine answers.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.3, Lemma 4.17; §6.1.1, Remark 6.7.)
-/

namespace Complexity

namespace CPSim

open Turing LogProg

variable {R : ℕ} {Λ : Type}

/-! ## The register file -/

/-- The register of counter register `r`. -/
def rg (r : Fin R) : Fin (R + 3) := Fin.castAdd 3 r
/-- The register of the input position. -/
def rP (R : ℕ) : Fin (R + 3) := ⟨R, by omega⟩
/-- The register of the number of printed bits. -/
def rO (R : ℕ) : Fin (R + 3) := ⟨R + 1, by omega⟩
/-- The scratch register of the print loop. -/
def rT (R : ℕ) : Fin (R + 3) := ⟨R + 2, by omega⟩

/-- The register file: counter registers `ρ`, input position `p`, output count `oc`, scratch
`tm`. -/
def ev (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm : ℕ) : Fin (R + 3) → ℕ := fun i =>
  if h : i.val < R then ρ ⟨i.val, h⟩ else if i.val = R then p else if i.val = R + 1 then oc
  else tm

/-- Reading a counter register. -/
@[simp] lemma ev_rg (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm : ℕ) (r : Fin R) : ev ρ p oc tm (rg r) = ρ r := by
  simp [ev, rg]
/-- Reading the input position. -/
@[simp] lemma ev_rP (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm : ℕ) : ev ρ p oc tm (rP R) = p := by simp [ev, rP]
/-- Reading the output count. -/
@[simp] lemma ev_rO (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm : ℕ) : ev ρ p oc tm (rO R) = oc := by
  simp [ev, rO]
/-- Reading the scratch register. -/
@[simp] lemma ev_rT (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm : ℕ) : ev ρ p oc tm (rT R) = tm := by
  simp [ev, rT]

/-- Writing a counter register. -/
lemma upd_rg (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm : ℕ) (r : Fin R) (v : ℕ) :
    Function.update (ev ρ p oc tm) (rg r) v = ev (Function.update ρ r v) p oc tm := by
  funext i
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := r
  simp only [Function.update_apply, ev, rg, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_castAdd]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

/-- Writing the input position. -/
lemma upd_rP (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm v : ℕ) :
    Function.update (ev ρ p oc tm) (rP R) v = ev ρ v oc tm := by
  funext i; obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  simp only [Function.update_apply, ev, rP, Fin.ext_iff]
  split_ifs <;> omega

/-- Writing the output count. -/
lemma upd_rO (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm v : ℕ) :
    Function.update (ev ρ p oc tm) (rO R) v = ev ρ p v tm := by
  funext i; obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  simp only [Function.update_apply, ev, rO, Fin.ext_iff]
  split_ifs <;> omega

/-- Writing the scratch register. -/
lemma upd_rT (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm v : ℕ) :
    Function.update (ev ρ p oc tm) (rT R) v = ev ρ p oc v := by
  funext i; obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  simp only [Function.update_apply, ev, rT, Fin.ext_iff]
  split_ifs <;> omega

/-- The scratch register is not a counter register. -/
lemma rT_ne_rg (r : Fin R) : rT R ≠ rg r := by
  intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp [rT, rg] at this; omega

/-! ## The machine -/

/-- The labels: simulating label `l`, and the auxiliary labels of the output count, the print
loop and the input read. -/
inductive Lb (Λ : Type) where
  | start
  | sim (l : Λ)
  | bump (l : Λ)
  | prL (l : Λ)
  | prC (l : Λ)
  | prB (l : Λ)
  | prT (l : Λ)
  | rdB (l : Λ)
  | rdT (l : Λ)
  | rdF (l : Λ)
  | ans (b : Bool)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Finitely many labels (via an explicit equivalence with `(Unit ⊕ Fin 9 × Λ) ⊕ Bool`). -/
instance [Fintype Λ] : Fintype (Lb Λ) := by
  classical
  let e : Lb Λ ≃ (Unit ⊕ (Fin 9 × Λ)) ⊕ Bool :=
    { toFun := fun q => match q with
        | .start => .inl (.inl ())
        | .sim l => .inl (.inr (0, l))
        | .bump l => .inl (.inr (1, l))
        | .prL l => .inl (.inr (2, l))
        | .prC l => .inl (.inr (3, l))
        | .prB l => .inl (.inr (4, l))
        | .prT l => .inl (.inr (5, l))
        | .rdB l => .inl (.inr (6, l))
        | .rdT l => .inl (.inr (7, l))
        | .rdF l => .inl (.inr (8, l))
        | .ans b => .inr b
      invFun := fun z => match z with
        | .inl (.inl ()) => .start
        | .inl (.inr (i, l)) =>
          match i with
          | 0 => .sim l | 1 => .bump l | 2 => .prL l | 3 => .prC l | 4 => .prB l
          | 5 => .prT l | 6 => .rdB l | 7 => .rdT l | 8 => .rdF l
        | .inr b => .ans b
      left_inv := fun q => by cases q <;> rfl
      right_inv := fun z => by
        rcases z with (⟨⟩ | ⟨i, l⟩) | b
        · rfl
        · fin_cases i <;> rfl
        · rfl }
  exact Fintype.ofEquiv _ e.symm

variable (P : Λ → CounterProg.Instr R Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (lm : Bool)

/-- **The simulating machine.** At `sim l` it executes `P l`: register instructions act on the
corresponding registers; printing a bit compares the output count with the index `p` on the
input (answer if equal, else count); printing a register loops over the scratch register;
reading asks the length decider (`0`) and the bit decider (`1`) about the input position;
`halt` answers `0` (the index is beyond the output). In length mode (`lm`) every printed bit
answers `1`. -/
def A : ARM (R + 3) 2 (Lb Λ) := fun q =>
  match q with
  | .start => .valP (rP R) (.sim l₀)
  | .sim l =>
    match P l with
    | .halt => .ret false
    | .goto l' => .jz (rP R) (.sim l') (.sim l')
    | .out b l' => .jeqIn (rO R) (.ans (lm || b)) (.bump l')
    | .inc r l' => .inc (rg r) (.sim l')
    | .dec r l' => .dec (rg r) (.sim l')
    | .jz r l0 l1 => .jz (rg r) (.sim l0) (.sim l1)
    | .pr _ _ => .clr (rT R) (.prL l)
    | .rd le _ _ => .call 0 .unaryFst [rP R] (.rdB l) (.sim le)
  | .bump l' => .inc (rO R) (.sim l')
  | .prL l =>
    match P l with
    | .pr r l' => .jeq (rT R) (rg r) (.sim l') (.prC l)
    | _ => .ret false
  | .prC l => .jeqIn (rO R) (.ans true) (.prB l)
  | .prB l => .inc (rO R) (.prT l)
  | .prT l => .inc (rT R) (.prL l)
  | .rdB l => .call 1 .unaryFst [rP R] (.rdT l) (.rdF l)
  | .rdT l =>
    match P l with
    | .rd _ _ lt => .inc (rP R) (.sim lt)
    | _ => .ret false
  | .rdF l =>
    match P l with
    | .rd _ lf _ => .inc (rP R) (.sim lf)
    | _ => .ret false
  | .ans b => .ret b

/-- On a well-formed input every configuration meets the syntactic preconditions. -/
lemma preS_A {y : List Bool} (hv : ValidPlain y) (a : AConf (R + 3) (Lb Λ)) :
    PreS (A P l₀ lm) y a := by
  obtain ⟨_ | q, v, res⟩ := a
  · trivial
  · cases q with
    | sim l => cases h : P l <;> simp [PreS, A, h, hv]
    | prL l => cases h : P l <;> simp [PreS, A, h, rT_ne_rg]
    | rdT l => cases h : P l <;> simp [PreS, A, h]
    | rdF l => cases h : P l <;> simp [PreS, A, h]
    | _ => simp [PreS, A, hv]

/-! ## One step -/

/-- The answer for index `p` on output `O`: the bit `O_p`, or in length mode `p < |O|`. -/
def ans (lm : Bool) (O : List Bool) (p : ℕ) : Bool :=
  if lm then decide (p < O.length) else O.getD p false

/-- A running abstract configuration. -/
abbrev cf (q : Lb Λ) (v : Fin (R + 3) → ℕ) : AConf (R + 3) (Lb Λ) := (some q, v, none)

section Step

variable {n p : ℕ} {u : List Bool} {o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool}
  (ho0 : ∀ h, o 0 (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits h)) = decide (h < u.length))
  (ho1 : ∀ h, o 1 (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits h)) = u.getD h false)
  (B : ℕ)

/-- The invariant of the simulation: preconditions, and registers at most `B`. -/
def G (y : List Bool) (a : AConf (R + 3) (Lb Λ)) : Prop :=
  PreS (A P l₀ lm) y a ∧ ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ B

variable {P l₀ lm B}

/-- Configurations with all values within `B` satisfy the invariant. -/
lemma G_ev (q : Lb Λ) (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (ps oc tm : ℕ) (hρ : ∀ r, ρ r ≤ B) (hps : ps ≤ B)
    (hoc : oc ≤ B) (htm : tm ≤ B) :
    G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)) (cf q (ev ρ ps oc tm)) := by
  refine ⟨preS_A P l₀ lm ⟨n, _, rfl, canon_bits p⟩ _, fun i => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  simp only [ev]
  split_ifs
  · exact hρ _
  all_goals assumption

/-- The output-count comparison: `bits oc = bits p` iff `oc = p`. -/
lemma jeqIn_eq (oc : ℕ) :
    (Nat.bits oc = plainWord (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))) ↔ oc = p := by
  rw [plainWord_pairEncode, bits_injective.eq_iff]

/-- **The print loop**, when the whole value fits below the index: from `prL` with scratch
`j` and count `o₀ + j` the machine reaches the next label with count `o₀ + V`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the remaining count `d`: each round goes through `prL` (scratch
`≠` value), `prC` (count `≠ p`), `prB` (count `+1`) and `prT` (scratch `+1`); at `d = 0` the
test at `prL` exits to `sim l'`. -/
lemma pr_reach {l l' : Λ} {r : Fin R} (hP : P l = .pr r l') (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (ps o₀ : ℕ)
    (hρ : ∀ r, ρ r ≤ B) (hps : ps ≤ B) (hle : o₀ + ρ r ≤ p) (hB : o₀ + ρ r ≤ B) :
    ∀ d j, j + d = ρ r →
      AReach (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)))
        (cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) (cf (.sim l') (ev ρ ps (o₀ + ρ r) (ρ r))) := by
  have hL : A P l₀ lm (.prL l) = .jeq (rT R) (rg r) (.sim l') (.prC l) := by simp [A, hP]
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro j hj
    simp only [Nat.add_zero] at hj; subst hj
    refine AReach.step (G_ev _ _ _ _ _ hρ hps (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + ρ r) (ρ r))) = cf (.sim l') (ev ρ ps (o₀ + ρ r) (ρ r)) := by
      simp [astep_jeq hL]
    rw [this]; exact AReach.refl _
  | succ d ih =>
    intro j hj
    have hG := fun q (oc tm : ℕ) (h1 : oc ≤ B) (h2 : tm ≤ B) => G_ev (n := n) (p := p) (P := P)
      (l₀ := l₀) (lm := lm) q ρ ps oc tm hρ hps h1 h2
    refine AReach.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have e1 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) = cf (.prC l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j) := by
      simp [astep_jeq hL, show j ≠ ρ r by omega]
    rw [e1]
    refine AReach.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have e2 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prC l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) = cf (.prB l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j) := by
      simp only [astep_jeqIn (show A P l₀ lm (.prC l) = _ from rfl), ev_rO, jeqIn_eq,
        show o₀ + j ≠ p by omega, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [e2]
    refine AReach.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.prB l) = _ from rfl), ev_rO, upd_rO]
    refine AReach.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.prT l) = _ from rfl), ev_rT, upd_rT]
    have := ih (j + 1) (by omega)
    rwa [show o₀ + j + 1 = o₀ + (j + 1) by ring]

/-- **The print loop**, when the index falls inside the printed block: the machine answers
`1` when the count reaches the index.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the distance `d` from the count to `p`: each round goes through
`prL`, `prC`, `prB`, `prT`; at `d = 0` the comparison at `prC` succeeds and the machine
answers `1`. -/
lemma pr_halt {l l' : Λ} {r : Fin R} (hP : P l = .pr r l') (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (ps o₀ : ℕ)
    (hρ : ∀ r, ρ r ≤ B) (hps : ps ≤ B) (hlt : p < o₀ + ρ r) (hB : o₀ + ρ r ≤ B) :
    ∀ d j, o₀ + j + d = p →
      AHalt (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)))
        (cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) true := by
  have hG := fun q (oc tm : ℕ) (h1 : oc ≤ B) (h2 : tm ≤ B) => G_ev (n := n) (p := p) (P := P)
    (l₀ := l₀) (lm := lm) q ρ ps oc tm hρ hps h1 h2
  have hL : A P l₀ lm (.prL l) = .jeq (rT R) (rg r) (.sim l') (.prC l) := by simp [A, hP]
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro j hj
    refine AHalt.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have e1 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) = cf (.prC l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j) := by
      simp [astep_jeq hL, show j ≠ ρ r by omega]
    rw [e1]
    refine AHalt.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have e2 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prC l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) = cf (.ans true) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j) := by
      simp only [astep_jeqIn (show A P l₀ lm (.prC l) = _ from rfl), ev_rO, jeqIn_eq,
        show o₀ + j = p by omega, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [e2]
    exact AHalt.ret rfl (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega))
  | succ d ih =>
    intro j hj
    refine AHalt.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have e1 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) = cf (.prC l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j) := by
      simp [astep_jeq hL, show j ≠ ρ r by omega]
    rw [e1]
    refine AHalt.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have e2 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prC l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) = cf (.prB l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j) := by
      simp only [astep_jeqIn (show A P l₀ lm (.prC l) = _ from rfl), ev_rO, jeqIn_eq,
        show o₀ + j ≠ p by omega, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [e2]
    refine AHalt.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.prB l) = _ from rfl), ev_rO, upd_rO]
    refine AHalt.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.prT l) = _ from rfl), ev_rT, upd_rT]
    have := ih (j + 1) (by omega)
    rwa [show o₀ + j + 1 = o₀ + (j + 1) by ring]

include ho0 ho1 in
/-- **One counter step.** From the configuration simulating the counter state
`⟨l, ρ, ps, out⟩` (with `|out| ≤ p`) the machine either answers `0` because `P` halts, or
reaches the configuration simulating the next state, or — if the step prints the `p`-th bit —
answers `ans lm s' p` for the next state `s'`; all through configurations within `B`.

**Proof sketch.** By cases on the instruction: register instructions are one machine step;
printing a bit compares the count with `p` (`jeqIn`); printing a register is the print loop
(`pr_reach`, `pr_halt`); reading asks the length decider, then the bit decider, and advances
the position. -/
lemma sim_step (l : Λ) (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (ps : ℕ) (out : List Bool) (tm : ℕ)
    (hp : out.length ≤ p) (hρ : ∀ r, ρ r ≤ B) (hps : ps ≤ B) (hout : out.length ≤ B)
    (htm : tm ≤ B) (s' : CounterProg.St R Λ)
    (hs : s' = CounterProg.step P u ⟨some l, ρ, ps, out⟩) (hρ' : ∀ r, s'.regs r ≤ B)
    (hps' : s'.pos ≤ B) (hout' : s'.out.length ≤ B) :
    (s'.lbl = none ∧ s'.out = out ∧
      AHalt (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)))
        (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm)) false) ∨
    (∃ l', s'.lbl = some l' ∧
      ((s'.out.length ≤ p ∧ ∃ tm' ≤ B,
        AReach (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
          (G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)))
          (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm))
          (cf (.sim l') (ev s'.regs s'.pos s'.out.length tm')))
      ∨ (p < s'.out.length ∧
        AHalt (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
          (G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)))
          (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm)) (ans lm s'.out p)))) := by
  set y := pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p) with hy
  have hG0 := G_ev (n := n) (p := p) (P := P) (l₀ := l₀) (lm := lm) (.sim l) ρ ps out.length tm
    hρ hps hout htm
  cases hP : P l with
  | halt =>
    left
    have : s' = ⟨none, ρ, ps, out⟩ := by rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl, AHalt.ret (by simp [A, hP]) hG0⟩
  | goto l' =>
    have : s' = ⟨some l', ρ, ps, out⟩ := by rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    refine Or.inr ⟨l', rfl, Or.inl ⟨hp, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩⟩
    have hins : A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .jz (rP R) (.sim l') (.sim l') := by simp [A, hP]
    have : astep (A P l₀ lm) o y (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm)) =
        cf (.sim l') (ev ρ ps out.length tm) := by simp [astep_jz hins]
    rw [this]; exact AReach.refl _
  | out b l' =>
    have : s' = ⟨some l', ρ, ps, out ++ [b]⟩ := by rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hout' ⊢
    refine Or.inr ⟨l', rfl, ?_⟩
    have hins : A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .jeqIn (rO R) (.ans (lm || b)) (.bump l') := by
      simp [A, hP]
    by_cases heq : out.length = p
    · refine Or.inr ⟨by omega, AHalt.step hG0 ?_⟩
      have : astep (A P l₀ lm) o y (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm)) =
          cf (.ans (lm || b)) (ev ρ ps out.length tm) := by
        simp only [astep_jeqIn hins, ev_rO, hy, jeqIn_eq, heq, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [this]
      have ha : ans lm (out ++ [b]) p = (lm || b) := by
        subst heq; cases lm <;> simp [ans, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
      rw [ha]
      exact AHalt.ret rfl (G_ev _ _ _ _ _ hρ hps hout htm)
    · refine Or.inl ⟨by omega, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩
      have : astep (A P l₀ lm) o y (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm)) =
          cf (.bump l') (ev ρ ps out.length tm) := by
        simp only [astep_jeqIn hins, ev_rO, hy, jeqIn_eq, heq, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [this]
      refine AReach.step (G_ev _ _ _ _ _ hρ hps hout htm) ?_
      simp only [astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.bump l') = _ from rfl), ev_rO, upd_rO]
      exact AReach.refl _
  | inc r l' =>
    have : s' = ⟨some l', Function.update ρ r (ρ r + 1), ps, out⟩ := by
      rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    refine Or.inr ⟨l', rfl, Or.inl ⟨hp, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩⟩
    simp only [astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .inc (rg r) (.sim l') by simp [A, hP]),
      ev_rg, upd_rg]
    exact AReach.refl _
  | dec r l' =>
    have : s' = ⟨some l', Function.update ρ r (ρ r - 1), ps, out⟩ := by
      rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    refine Or.inr ⟨l', rfl, Or.inl ⟨hp, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩⟩
    simp only [astep_dec (show A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .dec (rg r) (.sim l') by simp [A, hP]),
      ev_rg, upd_rg]
    exact AReach.refl _
  | jz r l0 l1 =>
    have : s' = ⟨some (if ρ r = 0 then l0 else l1), ρ, ps, out⟩ := by
      rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    refine Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, Or.inl ⟨hp, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩⟩
    have hins : A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .jz (rg r) (.sim l0) (.sim l1) := by simp [A, hP]
    by_cases hr : ρ r = 0
    · simp only [astep_jz hins, ev_rg, hr, ↓reduceIte]; exact AReach.refl _
    · simp only [astep_jz hins, ev_rg, hr, ↓reduceIte]; exact AReach.refl _
  | pr r l' =>
    have : s' = ⟨some l', ρ, ps, out ++ List.replicate (ρ r) true⟩ := by
      rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate] at hout' ⊢
    refine Or.inr ⟨l', rfl, ?_⟩
    have e0 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o y (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm)) =
        cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (out.length + 0) 0) := by
      simp only [astep_clr (show A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .clr (rT R) (.prL l) by simp [A, hP]),
        upd_rT, Nat.add_zero]
    by_cases hle : out.length + ρ r ≤ p
    · refine Or.inl ⟨hle, ρ r, hρ r, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩
      rw [e0]
      exact pr_reach hP ρ ps out.length hρ hps hle hout' (ρ r) 0 (by omega)
    · refine Or.inr ⟨by omega, AHalt.step hG0 ?_⟩
      rw [e0]
      have ha : ans lm (out ++ List.replicate (ρ r) true) p = true := by
        cases lm
        · simp only [ans, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
          rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), List.getElem?_replicate]
          rw [if_pos (by omega)]; rfl
        · simp [ans]; omega
      rw [ha]
      exact pr_halt hP ρ ps out.length hρ hps (by omega) hout' (p - out.length) 0 (by omega)
  | rd le lf lt =>
    have hcall : A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .call 0 .unaryFst [rP R] (.rdB l) (.sim le) := by
      simp [A, hP]
    cases hx : u[ps]? with
    | none =>
      have : s' = ⟨some le, ρ, ps, out⟩ := by rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP, hx]
      subst this
      refine Or.inr ⟨le, rfl, Or.inl ⟨hp, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩⟩
      rw [astep_call₁ _ _ hcall, ho0]
      have : ¬ ps < u.length := by
        intro h; rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem h] at hx; exact absurd hx (by simp)
      simp only [ev_rP, this, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      exact AReach.refl _
    | some b =>
      have hlt : ps < u.length := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hx).1
      have hb : u.getD ps false = b := by simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hx]
      have : s' = ⟨some (if b then lt else lf), ρ, ps + 1, out⟩ := by
        rw [hs]; cases b <;> simp [CounterProg.step, hP, hx]
      subst this
      refine Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, Or.inl ⟨hp, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩⟩
      rw [astep_call₁ _ _ hcall, ho0]
      simp only [ev_rP, hlt, decide_true, ↓reduceIte]
      refine AReach.step (G_ev _ _ _ _ _ hρ hps hout htm) ?_
      rw [astep_call₁ _ _ (show A P l₀ lm (.rdB l) = .call 1 .unaryFst [rP R] (.rdT l) (.rdF l)
        from rfl), ho1]
      simp only [ev_rP, hb]
      refine AReach.step (G_ev _ _ _ _ _ hρ hps hout htm) ?_
      cases b
      · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
          astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.rdF l) = .inc (rP R) (.sim lf) by simp [A, hP]), ev_rP,
          upd_rP]
        exact AReach.refl _
      · simp only [↓reduceIte,
          astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.rdT l) = .inc (rP R) (.sim lt) by simp [A, hP]), ev_rP,
          upd_rP]
        exact AReach.refl _

end Step

end CPSim

end Complexity
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/CounterProgSimRun.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.CounterProgSim

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Counter programs on unary-logspace inputs are unary-logspace

The closure property behind the logspace half of [AB09, Remark 6.7]: if a counter program
(`Complexity.CounterProg`) halts within polynomially many steps on the words `u(n)`, and `u`
is unary-logspace (its bits and length are decidable in logarithmic space from `⟨1ⁿ, i⟩`),
then so is the sequence of its outputs. This is the composition of implicitly logspace
computable functions [AB09, Lemma 4.17] in the special form needed here: the second
function is a polynomial-time counter program, whose registers are therefore polynomially
bounded and fit in `O(log n)` bits.

## Main results

* `Complexity.CPSim.sim_run` — the simulating machine answers for the whole run.
* `Complexity.UnaryLogspace.counterProg` — the closure property.
* `Complexity.CounterProg.length_out_le` — the outputs have polynomial length.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.3, Lemma 4.17; §6.1.1, Remark 6.7.)
-/

namespace Complexity

namespace CPSim

open Turing LogProg

variable {R : ℕ} {Λ : Type} {P : Λ → CounterProg.Instr R Λ} {l₀ : Λ} {lm : Bool}

/-- The answer for an index inside a prefix is the prefix's answer. -/
lemma ans_append (O e : List Bool) {p : ℕ} (hp : p < O.length) :
    ans lm (O ++ e) p = ans lm O p := by
  cases lm
  · simp [ans, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_left hp]
  · simp [ans]; omega

/-- Past the output the answer is `0`. -/
lemma ans_of_le (O : List Bool) {p : ℕ} (hp : O.length ≤ p) : ans lm O p = false := by
  cases lm
  · simp [ans, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_none hp]
  · simp [ans]; omega

/-- The counter state is within `B`. -/
def Bd (B : ℕ) (s : CounterProg.St R Λ) : Prop :=
  (∀ r, s.regs r ≤ B) ∧ s.pos ≤ B ∧ s.out.length ≤ B

section Run

variable {n p : ℕ} {u : List Bool} {o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool}
  (ho0 : ∀ h, o 0 (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits h)) = decide (h < u.length))
  (ho1 : ∀ h, o 1 (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits h)) = u.getD h false)
  {B : ℕ}

include ho0 ho1 in
/-- **The whole run.** From the configuration simulating a running counter state `s` with
`|out| ≤ p`, if `P` halts after `k` more steps, all states within `B`, the machine answers
`ans lm O p` for the final output `O`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `k`, one counter step at a time (`sim_step`): a halting step
answers `0` (the index is past the output); a step printing the `p`-th bit answers it, and
later steps only append (`CounterProg.run_out`, `ans_append`); otherwise continue. -/
lemma sim_run : ∀ (k : ℕ) (s : CounterProg.St R Λ) (tm : ℕ) (l : Λ), s.lbl = some l →
    s.out.length ≤ p → tm ≤ B → (CounterProg.run P u s k).lbl = none →
    (∀ j ≤ k, Bd B (CounterProg.run P u s j)) →
    AHalt (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
      (G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)))
      (cf (.sim l) (ev s.regs s.pos s.out.length tm)) (ans lm (CounterProg.run P u s k).out p) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro s tm l hl _ _ hk _
    rw [CounterProg.run_zero, hl] at hk; exact absurd hk (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro s tm l hl hp htm hk hbd
    obtain ⟨lbl, ρ, ps, out⟩ := s
    simp only at hl; subst hl
    obtain ⟨hρ, hps, hout⟩ := hbd 0 (by omega)
    obtain ⟨hρ', hps', hout'⟩ := hbd 1 (by omega)
    rw [CounterProg.run_zero] at hρ hps hout
    rcases sim_step (P := P) (l₀ := l₀) (lm := lm) ho0 ho1 l ρ ps out tm hp hρ hps hout htm
      (CounterProg.step P u ⟨some l, ρ, ps, out⟩) rfl hρ' hps' hout' with
      ⟨hnone, hout1, hh⟩ | ⟨l', hl', (⟨hle, tm', htm', hr⟩ | ⟨hlt, hh⟩)⟩
    · rw [CounterProg.run_succ, CounterProg.run_of_halted _ _ _ hnone, hout1,
        ans_of_le _ hp]
      exact hh
    · rw [CounterProg.run_succ] at hk ⊢
      refine hr.halt (ih _ tm' l' hl' hle htm' hk fun j hj => ?_)
      have := hbd (j + 1) (by omega)
      rwa [CounterProg.run_succ] at this
    · rw [CounterProg.run_succ]
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := CounterProg.run_out P u (CounterProg.step P u ⟨some l, ρ, ps, out⟩) k
      rw [he, ans_append _ _ hlt]
      exact hh

end Run

end CPSim

namespace CounterProg

variable {R : ℕ} {Λ : Type}

/-- **Outputs of polynomially many steps have polynomial length**: `t ≤ C (n + 1)^c` steps
print at most `(C + 1)² (n + 1)^{2c}` bits. -/
theorem length_out_le (P : Λ → Instr R Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (x : List Bool) (C c n t : ℕ)
    (ht : t ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ c) :
    (run P x (init l₀) t).out.length ≤ (C + 1) ^ 2 * (n + 1) ^ (2 * c) := by
  have h := run_init_out_le P x l₀ t
  have h1 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ c := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have e : (C + 1) ^ 2 * (n + 1) ^ (2 * c) = ((C + 1) * (n + 1) ^ c) ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [e]
  have : t + 1 ≤ (C + 1) * (n + 1) ^ c := by nlinarith
  nlinarith

end CounterProg

open Turing LogProg CPSim in
/-- **Counter programs preserve unary-logspace sequences** [AB09, Lemma 4.17, for a
polynomial-time counter program as the outer function]: if `u` is unary-logspace and the
counter program `P` halts on every `u(n)` within `C (n + 1)^c` steps with output `g(n)`, then
`g` is unary-logspace.

**Proof sketch.** For each of the two languages, `arm_decides_poly` with the simulating
machine `CPSim.A` (length or bit mode) and the deciders of `u`: on `⟨1ⁿ, bits p⟩` the
machine validates the input and runs `sim_run` from the initial state. Within `t ≤ N =
C (n + 1)^c` steps the registers are at most `N`, the input position at most `N`, the output
count at most `N (N + 1)` (`CounterProg.run_init_out_le`), so all registers are below
`(N + 1)² ≤ (C + 1)² (|y| + 1)^{2c}`. Malformed inputs are rejected at once. -/
theorem UnaryLogspace.counterProg {R : ℕ} {Λ : Type} [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ]
    (P : Λ → CounterProg.Instr R Λ) (l₀ : Λ) {u g : ℕ → List Bool} (hu : UnaryLogspace u)
    (C c : ℕ) (hrun : ∀ n, ∃ t ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ c,
      (CounterProg.run P (u n) (CounterProg.init l₀) t).lbl = none ∧
      (CounterProg.run P (u n) (CounterProg.init l₀) t).out = g n) :
    UnaryLogspace g := by
  let As : Fin 2 → Language Bool := fun j => if j = 0 then uLen u else uBit u
  have hAs : ∀ j, As j ∈ LOGSPACE := by
    intro j; fin_cases j
    · exact hu.2
    · exact hu.1
  have key : ∀ lm : Bool, (if lm then uLen g else uBit g) ∈ LOGSPACE := by
    intro lm
    refine arm_decides_poly (A P l₀ lm) .start As hAs ((C + 1) ^ 2) (2 * c) fun y => ?_
    by_cases hv : ValidPlain y
    · obtain ⟨n, w, rfl, hw⟩ := hv
      rw [canon_eq_bits w hw]
      set p := bitsVal w
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hhalt, hout⟩ := hrun n
      set N := C * (n + 1) ^ c with hN
      set B := (N + 1) ^ 2 with hB
      have ho0 : ∀ h, (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) 0
          (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits h)) = decide (h < (u n).length) := by
        intro h
        simp only [As, ↓reduceIte, indicator_eq_decide]
        exact decide_eq_decide.mpr (mem_uLen u n h)
      have ho1 : ∀ h, (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) 1
          (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits h)) = (u n).getD h false := by
        intro h
        show MultiTapeTM.indicator (uBit u : Set (List Bool)) _ = _
        have := mem_uBit u n h
        unfold MultiTapeTM.indicator
        split_ifs with hm <;> cases hb : (u n).getD h false <;> simp_all
      have hbd : ∀ j ≤ t, Bd B (CounterProg.run P (u n) (CounterProg.init l₀) j) := by
        intro j hj
        have hjN : j ≤ N := hj.trans ht
        have hNB : N * (N + 1) ≤ B := by simp only [hB]; nlinarith
        have hNN : N ≤ N * (N + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
        refine ⟨fun r => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have := CounterProg.run_regs_le P (u n) (CounterProg.init l₀) r j
          have h0 : (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).regs r = 0 := rfl
          omega
        · have := CounterProg.run_pos_le P (u n) (CounterProg.init l₀) j
          have h0 : (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).pos = 0 := rfl
          omega
        · have := CounterProg.run_init_out_le P (u n) l₀ j
          have : j * (j + 1) ≤ N * (N + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul hjN (by omega)
          omega
      have hrunA := sim_run (P := P) (l₀ := l₀) (lm := lm) (B := B) (n := n) (p := p)
        (o := fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) ho0 ho1 t
        (CounterProg.init l₀) 0 l₀ rfl (by simp [CounterProg.init]) (Nat.zero_le _) hhalt hbd
      rw [hout] at hrunA
      have hans : ans lm (g n) p = MultiTapeTM.indicator
          ((if lm then uLen g else uBit g : Language Bool) : Set (List Bool))
          (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)) := by
        cases lm
        · show (g n).getD p false = MultiTapeTM.indicator (uBit g : Set (List Bool)) _
          have := mem_uBit g n p
          unfold MultiTapeTM.indicator
          split_ifs with hm <;> cases hb : (g n).getD p false <;> simp_all
        · show decide (p < (g n).length) = MultiTapeTM.indicator (uLen g : Set (List Bool)) _
          have := mem_uLen g n p
          unfold MultiTapeTM.indicator
          split_ifs with hm <;> simp_all
      rw [← hans]
      have hval : ValidPlain (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)) :=
        ⟨n, _, rfl, canon_bits p⟩
      have hev : (fun _ => 0 : Fin (R + 3) → ℕ) =
          ev (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).regs (CounterProg.init l₀ :
            CounterProg.St R Λ).pos (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).out.length 0 := by
        funext i; simp only [ev, CounterProg.init]; split_ifs <;> rfl
      refine AHalt.step ⟨preS_A P l₀ lm hval _, fun r => by simp⟩ ?_
      have : astep (A P l₀ lm) (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V)
          (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)) (some .start, fun _ => 0, none) =
          cf (.sim l₀) (ev (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).regs
            (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).pos
            (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).out.length 0) := by
        rw [← hev]; simp [astep_valP (show A P l₀ lm .start = _ from rfl), hval]
      rw [this]
      refine hrunA.mono fun a ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, fun r => (h2 r).trans ?_⟩
      have hn : n + 1 ≤ (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)).length + 1 := by
        simp [pairEncode_eq_dbl, dbl_replicate]; omega
      have h1 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ c := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
      calc B = (C * (n + 1) ^ c + 1) ^ 2 := rfl
        _ ≤ ((C + 1) * (n + 1) ^ c) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by nlinarith) 2
        _ = (C + 1) ^ 2 * (n + 1) ^ (2 * c) := by ring
        _ ≤ (C + 1) ^ 2 * ((pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)).length + 1) ^
            (2 * c) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hn _)
    · have hn : MultiTapeTM.indicator ((if lm then uLen g else uBit g : Language Bool) :
          Set (List Bool)) y = false := by
        rw [indicator_eq_decide]
        simp only [decide_eq_false_iff_not]
        intro h
        cases lm
        · exact hv (validPlain_of_mem_unaryIdx (p := fun n i => (g n).getD i false = true) h)
        · exact hv (validPlain_of_mem_unaryIdx (p := fun n i => i < (g n).length) h)
      rw [hn]
      refine ⟨1, ?_, ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
      · simp [arun, astep_valP (show A P l₀ lm .start = _ from rfl), hv]
      · simp [arun, astep_valP (show A P l₀ lm .start = _ from rfl), hv]
      · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
        exact ⟨by simp [arun, PreS, A], fun r => by simp [arun]⟩
  exact ⟨by simpa using key false, by simpa using key true⟩

end Complexity
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Examples.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 Seyoon Ragavan. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Basic

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Logspace examples: the parity language

[AB09, Example 4.7]: `EVEN = {x : x has an even number of 1s}` is in `L`. (The
example's second language, `MULT`, needs the campaign's number-triple encoding
conventions and is scheduled with the logspace-reduction phase — phase P4.4 of
`AroraBarakChapters3-4Plan.md` — rather than here.) A worked ARM-compiled
example of a `LOGSPACE` membership already exists in the received surface
(`Complexity.dblLang_mem`, `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.DblLang`);
parity is the book's own first example and gets the direct statement.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.evenLang` — the even-parity language. [AB09, Example 4.7]
* `Complexity.evenScanTM` — the zero-work-tape parity scanner. [AB09, Example 4.7]

## Main results

* `Complexity.evenScanTM_decidesInTime` — the scanner decides parity within
  `n + 1` steps. [AB09, Example 4.7]
* `Complexity.evenLang_mem_LOGSPACE` — parity is decidable in logarithmic
  space. [AB09, Example 4.7]

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.2, Example 4.7.)
-/

namespace Complexity

open Turing

/-- **The parity language** `EVEN`: binary strings containing an even number of
`1`s (rendered as `true`s). [AB09, Example 4.7] -/
def evenLang : Language Bool :=
  {x | x.count true % 2 = 0}

/-- The parity scanner uses no work tapes and two live states: `true` means
that the consumed prefix has even parity. It toggles on `true`, keeps its
state on `false`, and emits its state and halts at the right blank.
[AB09, Example 4.7]

The missing catalog row is a finite-state scanner with a final verdict:
`transducer_run` halts silently, so its contract cannot emit this bit. -/
def evenScanTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 0
  State := Bool
  tm :=
    { q₀ := true
      tr := fun q inp _ => match inp with
        | some b => FinTM.controlAction .pos (some (if b then !q else q))
        | none => ⟨0, fun i => i.elim0, some q, none⟩ }

/-- After consuming a prefix, the scanner stores its even-parity bit, points
to the next input position, and has emitted nothing.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the prefix length. The initial state records
zero true bits. Reading the next bit preserves or toggles parity, advances
the head once, and emits nothing. The prefix-count update is the count of
an appended singleton; residues modulo two justify the toggle. -/
private theorem evenScanTM_prefix (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ x.length) :
    (evenScanTM.tm.runFrom (evenScanTM.tm.initCfg x) j).state =
        some (decide ((x.take j).count true % 2 = 0)) ∧
      (evenScanTM.tm.runFrom (evenScanTM.tm.initCfg x) j).inputPos.val = j + 1 ∧
      (evenScanTM.tm.runFrom (evenScanTM.tm.initCfg x) j).output = [] := by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [evenScanTM]
  | succ j ih =>
    obtain ⟨hq, hp, ho⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have hlt : j < x.length := by omega
    have hs := FinTM.inputSymbol_at
      (evenScanTM.tm.runFrom (evenScanTM.tm.initCfg x) j) j (by omega) hp
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at hs
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    rw [hq]
    simp only [evenScanTM, hs, FinTM.controlAction, Action.apply]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hlt, List.count_append]
      cases x[j] with
      | false => simp
      | true =>
        have hm := Nat.mod_lt ((x.take j).count true) (by decide : 0 < 2)
        by_cases he : (x.take j).count true % 2 = 0
        · simp [Nat.add_mod, he]
        · have he' : (x.take j).count true % 2 = 1 := by omega
          simp [Nat.add_mod, he']
    · rw [moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by omega)]
      simpa using hp
    · simpa using ho

/-- The zero-work-tape scanner decides the even-parity language within
`n + 1` steps on every input of length `n`. [AB09, Example 4.7]

**Proof sketch.** Apply the prefix invariant to the whole input. The next
symbol is the right blank, so one more transition emits the even-parity
indicator and halts. This includes the empty input. -/
theorem evenScanTM_decidesInTime :
    evenScanTM.DecidesInTime evenLang fun n => n + 1 := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨hq, hp, ho⟩ := evenScanTM_prefix x x.length le_rfl
  have hs := FinTM.inputSymbol_at
    (evenScanTM.tm.runFrom (evenScanTM.tm.initCfg x) x.length) x.length le_rfl hp
  simp only [List.getElem?_length] at hs
  apply (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  rw [hq, hs]
  simp only [evenScanTM, Action.apply]
  rw [ho]
  simp [MultiTapeTM.indicator, evenLang]

/-- **Parity is decidable in logarithmic space** — in fact in constant space,
which the `c · logSpace n` budget absorbs since `logSpace n ≥ 1`.
[AB09, Example 4.7]

**Proof sketch.** A direct `Turing.FinTM` with the running parity in control:
either the two-state **zero-work-tape** scanner (space `0`, the round-2 P0
witness construction — `Complexity.exists_zeroTape_parity_decider` in
`SpaceComplexity/ZeroSpace.lean` states exactly this machine, and that file
imports this one, so this proof must be **direct rather than derived from it**:
the reverse dependency would be an import cycle, P4.1 round 1, finding 4) or
the one-work-tape variant (one visited cell); either is within
`1 ≤ 1 · logSpace n`. Correctness is the left-to-right scan invariant —
parity of the consumed prefix — with the final emission
`[Turing.MultiTapeTM.indicator evenLang x]` at the input boundary, halting at
time `n + O(1)`. -/
theorem evenLang_mem_LOGSPACE : evenLang ∈ LOGSPACE := by
  refine ⟨0, evenScanTM, ?_⟩
  refine (FinTM.computesInSpace_zero_of_k_eq_zero (M := evenScanTM) rfl ?_).mono
    (fun _ => Nat.zero_le _)
  intro x
  exact ⟨x.length + 1, evenScanTM_decidesInTime x⟩

end Complexity
```

```
/-
