Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.InputAccess

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The oracle-input simulator: logspace preimages along implicit functions

[AB09, proof of Lemma 4.17, Fig. 4.3]: to decide whether `f x ∈ C`, run `C`'s logspace decider
`M` on a **virtual input** `f x` that is never written down. Whenever `M` reads its input, its
head position (in binary) is a query `⟨x, i⟩` to the length and bit deciders of `f`. The
received `LogProg` call protocol does not host this by itself. A call's virtual input is read
physically, as the whole input or its leading run of `1`s followed by register words, and
nothing serves a decider's input symbols through further calls (P0 reception audit,
`audits/ch34-p0-findings.md`, note 10). This file adds the missing engine as a register-tape
program on the received compiler.

The **oracle-input simulator** `Complexity.LogProg.OIS.prog M` keeps `M`'s work tapes on
registers `0, …, M.k − 1`, where they are touched only by `M`'s own transitions. It keeps `M`'s
input position `p` as the index `p − 1` in binary on the last register `q` (with `p = 0`, the
left blank, recorded in the control state). Each step of `M` runs as follows:

1. one `whole`-mode call on `[q]` asks the length decider whether `p − 1 < |f x|`;
2. if so, a second call asks the bit decider for the symbol;
3. one ordinary step applies `M`'s transition to the work registers;
4. the increment and decrement fragments move `q` as `M`'s clamped input move dictates.

Phase P4.4b of `AroraBarakChapters3-4Plan.md`; `audits/ch4-p44-resolutions-addendum.md`
records it as the route of `Complexity.mem_LOGSPACE_of_logspaceReducible`. The simulator is
campaign-owned and lives here (decision D3), beside its only class-level corollary.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.OIS.Ph`, `OIS.tr`, `OIS.call` — the phases, ordinary transitions and
  call nodes of the simulator.
* `Complexity.LogProg.OIS.prog`, `OIS.start` — the simulator program and its start state.
* `Complexity.LogProg.OIS.lo`, `OIS.hi` — its register ranges.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.OIS.run` — the run contract: against any oracle answering the two
  queries truthfully, the program halts with `M`'s output on the virtual input, inside the
  ranges, with well-formed calls (proved; phase-P4.4b statement).
* `Complexity.LogProg.OIS.compile_decides` — the space contract: compiled against a bank of
  the two deciders, it computes `M`'s output on the virtual input within the ranges plus the
  bank's space (proved; phase-P4.4b statement).
* `Complexity.mem_LOGSPACE_preimage` — logspace preimages along implicitly logspace
  computable maps are in `L` (proved; phase-P4.4b statement).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.3, Lemma 4.17 and its proof, Figure 4.3.)
-/

namespace Complexity

open Turing

namespace LogProg.OIS

/-- The phases of the simulator: the length call (`ask`) and the bit call (`bit`); the
simulated step with the symbol read (`work a lb`, `lb` marking the left blank); the zero test
before a left move (`zt`); the increment (`iC`, `iB`) and decrement (`dD`, `dL`, `dE`, `dB`)
of the index register. -/
inductive Ph where
  | ask | bit
  | work (a : Option Bool) (lb : Bool)
  | zt
  | iC | iB
  | dD | dL | dE | dB
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

variable (M : FinTM Bool)

/-- The index register of the simulator, the last one. -/
abbrev q : Fin (M.k + 1) := Fin.last M.k

/-- The phase after a simulated step, from the decider's input move `d`, at the left blank
(`lb`) or at the right blank (`rb`): from the left blank, a right move reaches position `1`
(index `0`); elsewhere a left move first tests the index for zero, and a right move increments
it unless clamped at the right blank. -/
def nextPh (d : SignType) (lb rb : Bool) : Ph :=
  if lb then (if d = 1 then .ask else .work none true)
  else if d = -1 then .zt
  else if d = 1 ∧ rb = false then .iC
  else .ask

/-- The decider's action on the work registers: input head and index register still, output
forwarded, the next phase by `nextPh`. -/
def liftAct (A : Action M.k Bool M.State) (lb rb : Bool) : Action (M.k + 1) Bool (M.State × Ph) :=
  ⟨0, Fin.lastCases (none, 0) A.workTapes, A.output,
    A.state.map fun s' => (s', nextPh A.inputTape lb rb)⟩

/-- **The ordinary transitions of the simulator.** `work a lb` applies `M`'s transition at the
symbol `a` (at the right blank exactly when `a = none` and not `lb`); `zt` reads the index
register's cell `0` (blank iff the index is `0`); the increment and decrement fragments act on
the index register and return to `ask`. The call phases' transitions are never used. -/
def tr : M.State × Ph → Option Bool → (Fin (M.k + 1) → Option Bool) →
    Action (M.k + 1) Bool (M.State × Ph)
  | (s, .work a lb), _, w =>
    liftAct M (M.tm.tr s a fun i => w i.castSucc) lb (a.isNone && !lb)
  | (s, .zt), _, w =>
    regAct (q M) none 0 (match w (q M) with
      | none => (s, .work none true)
      | some _ => (s, .dD))
  | (s, .iC), _, w => incCAct (q M) (s, .iC) (s, .iB) (w (q M))
  | (s, .iB), _, w => incBAct (q M) (s, .iB) (s, .ask) (w (q M))
  | (s, .dD), _, w => decDAct (q M) (s, .dD) (s, .dL) (s, .dB) (w (q M))
  | (s, .dL), _, w => decLAct (q M) (s, .dE) (s, .dB) (w (q M))
  | (s, .dE), _, _ => decEAct (q M) (s, .dB)
  | (s, .dB), _, w => incBAct (q M) (s, .dB) (s, .ask) (w (q M))
  | (_, .ask), _, _ => junkAct
  | (_, .bit), _, _ => junkAct

/-- **The call nodes of the simulator.** `ask` asks decider `0` (the length language) about
`⟨x, bits i⟩`, `i` the index register: on *yes* go on to `bit`; on *no* the symbol is the right
blank. `bit` asks decider `1` (the bit language) and goes on to the simulated step with the
answer. -/
def call : M.State × Ph → Option (CallSpec (M.k + 1) 2 (M.State × Ph))
  | (s, .ask) => some ⟨0, .whole, [q M], (s, .bit), (s, .work none false)⟩
  | (s, .bit) => some ⟨1, .whole, [q M], (s, .work (some true) false),
      (s, .work (some false) false)⟩
  | _ => none

/-- **The oracle-input simulator** of the decider `M`: a register-tape program over `M.k + 1`
registers calling two deciders. A hand-built program: no received layer serves a decider's
input from oracle calls. -/
def prog : RProg (M.k + 1) 2 (M.State × Ph) := ⟨⟨(M.tm.q₀, .ask), tr M⟩, call M⟩

/-- The start state of the simulator: `M`'s start state, about to ask for symbol `0`. -/
def start : M.State × Ph := (M.tm.q₀, .ask)

/-- The lower register bounds: `-S` on the work registers, `-1` on the index register. -/
def lo (S : ℕ) : Fin (M.k + 1) → ℤ := Fin.lastCases (-1) fun _ => -(S : ℤ)

/-- The upper register bounds: `S` on the work registers, `W` on the index register. -/
def hi (S W : ℕ) : Fin (M.k + 1) → ℤ := Fin.lastCases (W : ℤ) fun _ => (S : ℤ)

/-- The source configuration represented on the host, with an explicit index and phase.
The index is unconstrained after a halt because no later input move is simulated. -/
private def imageCfg {v : List Bool} (x : List Bool) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v)
    (i : ℕ) (ph : Ph) : Cfg (M.k + 1) Bool (M.State × Ph) x :=
  ⟨c.state.map (fun s => (s, ph)), 1,
    Fin.lastCases (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i)) c.workTapes,
    Fin.lastCases 0 c.workTapePos, c.output⟩

/-- The representation at a simulated-step boundary; the index agrees with the input
position while the source is live, and is merely in range once it has halted. -/
private def Represents {x v : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v)
    (d : Cfg (M.k + 1) Bool (M.State × Ph) x) : Prop :=
  ∃ i ≤ v.length,
    d = imageCfg M x c i (if c.inputPos.val = 0 then .work none true else .ask) ∧
    (c.state ≠ none → i = c.inputPos.val - 1)

/-- The intermediate invariant combines register ranges and the canonical call seam. -/
private def Safe {x : List Bool} (F S : ℕ)
    (d : Cfg (M.k + 1) Bool (M.State × Ph) x) : Prop :=
  (∀ r, lo M S r ≤ d.workTapePos r ∧
    d.workTapePos r ≤ hi M S (Nat.bits (F + 1)).length r) ∧
  ∀ l cs, d.state = some l → (prog M).call l = some cs →
    d.inputPos.val = 1 ∧ d.workTapePos (q M) = 0 ∧
    ∃ i ≤ F, d.workTapes (q M) = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i)

/-- An encoded configuration has bounded heads and a canonical call register, independently
of its phase. -/
private theorem imageCfg_safe {x v : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v)
    (i S : ℕ) (ph : Ph) (hi : i ≤ v.length)
    (hb : ∀ r, -(S : ℤ) ≤ c.workTapePos r ∧ c.workTapePos r ≤ (S : ℤ)) :
    Safe M v.length S (imageCfg M x c i ph) := by
  constructor
  · intro r
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) r
    · simp [imageCfg, lo, OIS.hi]
    · simpa [imageCfg, lo, OIS.hi] using hb j
  · intro l cs _ _
    exact ⟨by simp [imageCfg], by simp [imageCfg, q], i, hi, by simp [imageCfg, q]⟩

/-- The length call preserves the represented tapes and returns its Boolean branch. -/
private theorem ask_step {x v : List Bool} (o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool)
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v) (s : M.State) (hs : c.state = some s) (i : ℕ) :
    rrun (prog M) o (imageCfg M x c i .ask) 1 =
      imageCfg M x c i (if o 0 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) then .bit else .work none false) := by
  simp [rrun_one, rstep, prog, call, imageCfg, hs, vword_whole₁, regWords,
    q, tapeWord_bufferTape]
  split <;> rfl

/-- The bit call preserves the represented tapes and stores the answer in the phase. -/
private theorem bit_step {x v : List Bool} (o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool)
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v) (s : M.State) (hs : c.state = some s) (i : ℕ) :
    rrun (prog M) o (imageCfg M x c i .bit) 1 =
      imageCfg M x c i (.work (some (o 1 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)))) false) := by
  simp only [rrun_one, rstep, imageCfg, hs, Option.map_some, prog, call]
  rw [vword_whole₁]
  simp only [regWords, q, Fin.lastCases_last, tapeWord_bufferTape]
  cases o 1 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) <;> rfl

/-- Applying the lifted action updates exactly the source tapes and output.
The source input head moves in `M.tm.step c`; its encoded index is moved afterwards.

**Proof sketch.** Extensionality separates state, input head, work tapes, head positions and
output. Split each register into a source register or the last index register; the former
receives the source action, while the latter is unchanged. -/
private theorem work_step {x v : List Bool} (o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool)
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v) (s : M.State) (hs : c.state = some s) (i : ℕ) (lb : Bool) :
    rrun (prog M) o (imageCfg M x c i (.work c.inputSymbol lb)) 1 =
      imageCfg M x (M.tm.step c) i
        (nextPh (M.tm.tr s c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).inputTape lb
          (c.inputSymbol.isNone && !lb)) := by
  rw [rrun_one, rstep_noncall (prog M) o _ (s, .work c.inputSymbol lb)
    (by simp [imageCfg, hs]) rfl]
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, imageCfg, hs, Option.map_some, prog, tr]
  simp only [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
  refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ rfl
  · simp [liftAct, Action.apply]; rfl
  · simp [Action.apply, liftAct]
  · funext r z
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) r <;>
      simp [Action.apply, liftAct]
    rfl
  · funext r
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) r <;>
      simp [Action.apply, liftAct]
    rfl

/-- An index-only register view of a live encoded configuration is the same encoding with
its phase and index replaced. -/
private theorem index_view {x v : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v)
    (s : M.State) (hs : c.state = some s) (i j : ℕ) (ph ph' : Ph) :
    regCfg (imageCfg M x c i ph) (s, ph') (q M) (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits j)) 0 =
      imageCfg M x c j ph' := by
  refine Cfg.ext (by simp [imageCfg, hs, regCfg]) rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · funext r z
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) r <;> simp [regCfg, imageCfg, q]
  · funext r
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) r <;> simp [regCfg, imageCfg, q]

/-- An intermediate index-fragment configuration is safe when its state is non-call and
its index head is in the fragment's range. -/
private theorem index_fragment_safe {x v : List Bool} (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v)
    (i S : ℕ) (ph : Ph) (l : M.State × Ph) (f : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ)
    (hb : ∀ r, -(S : ℤ) ≤ c.workTapePos r ∧ c.workTapePos r ≤ (S : ℤ))
    (hc : (prog M).call l = none) (hp : -1 ≤ p)
    (hp' : p ≤ (Nat.bits (v.length + 1)).length) :
    Safe M v.length S (regCfg (imageCfg M x c i ph) l (q M) f p) := by
  constructor
  · intro r
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) r
    · simpa [regCfg, imageCfg, lo, hi, q] using And.intro hp hp'
    · simpa [regCfg, imageCfg, lo, hi, q] using hb k
  · intro l' cs hl' hcs
    have hll : l = l' := Option.some.inj hl'
    subst l'
    rw [hc] at hcs
    contradiction

/-- The frozen increment fragment advances the encoded input index and respects the
simulator invariant. -/
private theorem index_inc {x v : List Bool} (o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool)
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v) (s : M.State) (hs : c.state = some s) (i S : ℕ)
    (hi : i < v.length)
    (hb : ∀ r, -(S : ℤ) ≤ c.workTapePos r ∧ c.workTapePos r ≤ (S : ℤ)) :
    ∃ T, rrun (prog M) o (imageCfg M x c i .iC) T = imageCfg M x c (i + 1) .ask ∧
      ∀ n < T, Safe M v.length S (rrun (prog M) o (imageCfg M x c i .iC) n) := by
  obtain ⟨T, he, hm⟩ := inc_run (prog M) o (q M) (s, .iC) (s, .iB) (s, .ask)
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl rfl (imageCfg M x c i .iC) i
  rw [index_view M c s hs, index_view M c s hs] at he
  refine ⟨T, he, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rw [index_view M c s hs] at hm
  obtain ⟨l, f, p, hp, hl, hlo, hhi⟩ := hm n hn
  rw [hp]
  apply index_fragment_safe M c i S .iC l f p hb
  · rcases hl with rfl | rfl <;> rfl
  · exact hlo
  · have hw := length_bits_mono (show i + 1 ≤ v.length + 1 by omega)
    omega

/-- The received decrement fragment reduces a positive encoded index and respects the
simulator invariant. -/
private theorem index_dec {x v : List Bool} (o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool)
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v) (s : M.State) (hs : c.state = some s) (i S : ℕ)
    (hi : i ≤ v.length)
    (hb : ∀ r, -(S : ℤ) ≤ c.workTapePos r ∧ c.workTapePos r ≤ (S : ℤ)) :
    ∃ T, rrun (prog M) o (imageCfg M x c i .dD) T = imageCfg M x c (i - 1) .ask ∧
      ∀ n < T, Safe M v.length S (rrun (prog M) o (imageCfg M x c i .dD) n) := by
  obtain ⟨T, he, hm⟩ := dec_run (prog M) o (q M) (s, .dD) (s, .dL) (s, .dE)
    (s, .dB) (s, .ask) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl rfl rfl rfl (imageCfg M x c i .dD) i
  rw [index_view M c s hs, index_view M c s hs] at he
  refine ⟨T, he, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rw [index_view M c s hs] at hm
  obtain ⟨l, f, p, hp, hcall, hlo, hhi⟩ := hm n hn
  rw [hp]
  exact index_fragment_safe M c i S .dD l f p hb hcall hlo
    (hhi.trans (by exact_mod_cast length_bits_mono (show i ≤ v.length + 1 by omega)))

/-- The zero test changes phase according to whether the canonical index word is empty. -/
private theorem zero_step {x v : List Bool} (o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool)
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v) (s : M.State) (hs : c.state = some s) (i : ℕ) :
    rrun (prog M) o (imageCfg M x c i .zt) 1 =
      imageCfg M x c i (if i = 0 then .work none true else .dD) := by
  have hv : FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i) 0 = (Nat.bits i).head? := by
    simp [FinTM.bufferTape, List.head?_eq_getElem?]
  simp only [rrun_one, rstep, imageCfg, hs, Option.map_some, prog, call,
    MultiTapeTM.step, tr, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, q, Fin.lastCases_last]
  rw [hv, bits_head_odd]
  split_ifs with hi
  all_goals
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [regAct, Action.apply]

/-- The phase table realizes the clamped source input move using the received index
fragments; no work register or output is modified during this adjustment.

**Proof sketch.** Split the source move and the two boundaries. Staying put and clamped
moves need no steps. A right move at a letter uses `index_inc`; a left move tests zero,
then either marks the left blank or uses `index_dec`. -/
private theorem adjust_index {x v : List Bool} (o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool)
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v) (s : M.State) (hs : c.state = some s)
    (p : Fin (v.length + 2)) (mv : SignType) (S : ℕ)
    (hip : c.inputPos = moveInputPos p mv)
    (hb : ∀ r, -(S : ℤ) ≤ c.workTapePos r ∧ c.workTapePos r ≤ (S : ℤ)) :
    ∃ T, Represents M c (rrun (prog M) o (imageCfg M x c (p.val - 1)
        (nextPh mv (decide (p.val = 0)) (decide (p.val = v.length + 1)))) T) ∧
      ∀ n < T, Safe M v.length S (rrun (prog M) o (imageCfg M x c (p.val - 1)
        (nextPh mv (decide (p.val = 0)) (decide (p.val = v.length + 1)))) n) := by
  have hp := p.isLt
  have himg (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ v.length) (ph : Ph)
      (hph : ph = if c.inputPos.val = 0 then .work none true else .ask)
      (hj' : j = c.inputPos.val - 1) : Represents M c (imageCfg M x c j ph) :=
    ⟨j, hj, by rw [hph], fun _ => hj'⟩
  have hpos := (congrArg Fin.val hip).trans
    (moveInputPos_val v.length p.val p.isLt mv)
  clear hip
  by_cases hp0 : p.val = 0
  · cases mv <;> simp only [hp0, decide_true, nextPh, ↓reduceIte,
      SignType.zero_eq_zero, SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, SignType.pos_eq_one] at *
    all_goals
      refine ⟨0, himg _ (by omega) _ ?_ (by omega), fun n hn => by omega⟩
      simp_all
  · cases mv with
    | zero =>
      dsimp only at hpos
      simp only [SignType.zero_eq_zero, nextPh, hp0, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ↓reduceIte, (by decide : (0 : SignType) ≠ -1), (by decide : (0 : SignType) ≠ 1), false_and]
      refine ⟨0, himg _ (by omega) _ ?_ (by omega), fun n hn => by omega⟩
      rw [if_neg (show c.inputPos.val ≠ 0 by omega)]
    | pos =>
      dsimp only at hpos
      by_cases hpr : p.val = v.length + 1
      · simp [nextPh, hpr, SignType.pos_eq_one]
        refine ⟨0, himg _ (by omega) _ ?_ (by omega), fun n hn => by omega⟩
        rw [if_neg (show c.inputPos.val ≠ 0 by omega)]
      · simp only [SignType.pos_eq_one, nextPh, hp0, hpr, decide_false,
          Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, (by decide : (1 : SignType) ≠ -1), and_self]
        obtain ⟨T, he, hm⟩ := index_inc M o c s hs (p.val - 1) S (by omega) hb
        refine ⟨T, ?_, hm⟩
        rw [he]
        exact himg _ (by omega) _ (by rw [if_neg (show c.inputPos.val ≠ 0 by omega)]) (by omega)
    | neg =>
      dsimp only at hpos
      simp only [SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, nextPh, hp0, decide_false,
        Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hi : p.val - 1 = 0
      · refine ⟨1, ?_, fun n hn => ?_⟩
        · rw [zero_step M o c s hs, if_pos hi]
          exact himg _ (by omega) _ (by rw [if_pos (show c.inputPos.val = 0 by omega)]) (by omega)
        · have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
          subst n
          exact imageCfg_safe M c _ S _ (by omega) hb
      · obtain ⟨T, he, hm⟩ := index_dec M o c s hs (p.val - 1) S (by omega) hb
        refine ⟨1 + T, ?_, fun n hn => ?_⟩
        · rw [rrun_add, zero_step M o c s hs, if_neg hi, he]
          exact himg _ (by omega) _ (by rw [if_neg (show c.inputPos.val ≠ 0 by omega)]) (by omega)
        · by_cases hn0 : n = 0
          · subst n
            exact imageCfg_safe M c _ S _ (by omega) hb
          · have heq : n = 1 + (n - 1) := by omega
            rw [heq, rrun_add, zero_step M o c s hs, if_neg hi]
            exact hm (n - 1) (by omega)

/-- A represented configuration inherits its work-head bounds from the source. -/
private theorem represents_safe {x v : List Bool} {S : ℕ}
    {c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v} {d : Cfg (M.k + 1) Bool (M.State × Ph) x}
    (h : Represents M c d)
    (hb : ∀ r, -(S : ℤ) ≤ c.workTapePos r ∧ c.workTapePos r ≤ (S : ℤ)) :
    Safe M v.length S d := by
  obtain ⟨i, hidx, rfl, _⟩ := h
  exact imageCfg_safe M c i S _ hidx hb

/-- One simulated source step, including the final step that halts.

**Proof sketch.** At positive input position, perform the length call and, if its answer
is true, the bit call. The two oracle laws identify the supplied symbol. At the left
blank the symbol is already in the state. Apply `liftAct` once. If its next state is
`none`, the resulting represented configuration keeps the old, bounded index. Otherwise
split the input move and the boundary flags in `nextPh`: use `inc_run` away from the right
blank, and the zero test followed by `dec_run` for a positive predecessor index. A zero
index on a left move changes only the phase. The fragment bounds and the bounds on the
two source configurations give `Safe`; fragment states are non-call states. -/
private theorem represented_step {x v : List Bool} (o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool)
    (ho0 : ∀ i ≤ v.length, o 0 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) = decide (i < v.length))
    (ho1 : ∀ i < v.length, o 1 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) = v.getD i false)
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State v) (d : Cfg (M.k + 1) Bool (M.State × Ph) x) (S : ℕ)
    (hrep : Represents M c d) (hlive : c.state ≠ none)
    (hb : ∀ r, -(S : ℤ) ≤ c.workTapePos r ∧ c.workTapePos r ≤ (S : ℤ))
    (hb' : ∀ r, -(S : ℤ) ≤ (M.tm.step c).workTapePos r ∧
      (M.tm.step c).workTapePos r ≤ (S : ℤ)) :
    ∃ N, Represents M (M.tm.step c) (rrun (prog M) o d N) ∧
      ∀ n < N, Safe M v.length S (rrun (prog M) o d n) := by
  obtain ⟨i, hiv, rfl, hidx⟩ := hrep
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hlive
  have hi := hidx hlive
  have hsym : c.inputSymbol = if c.inputPos.val = 0 then none else v[i]? := by
    simp only [inputSymbol_eq, hi]
  have supply : ∃ T, rrun (prog M) o
      (imageCfg M x c i (if c.inputPos.val = 0 then .work none true else .ask)) T =
        imageCfg M x c i (.work c.inputSymbol (decide (c.inputPos.val = 0))) ∧
      ∀ n < T, Safe M v.length S (rrun (prog M) o
        (imageCfg M x c i (if c.inputPos.val = 0 then .work none true else .ask)) n) := by
    by_cases hp : c.inputPos.val = 0
    · refine ⟨0, ?_, fun n hn => by omega⟩
      simp [rrun_zero, hp, hsym]
    · simp only [hp, ↓reduceIte, decide_false, hsym]
      by_cases hv : i < v.length
      · have he : v[i]? = some (v.getD i false) := by
          simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hv]
        refine ⟨1 + 1, ?_, fun n hn => ?_⟩
        · rw [rrun_add, ask_step M o c s hs, ho0 i hiv]
          simp only [hv, decide_true, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [bit_step M o c s hs, ho1 i hv, he]
        · have hn' : n = 0 ∨ n = 1 := by omega
          rcases hn' with rfl | rfl
          · exact imageCfg_safe M c i S .ask hiv hb
          · rw [ask_step M o c s hs, ho0 i hiv]
            simp only [hv, decide_true, ↓reduceIte]
            exact imageCfg_safe M c i S .bit hiv hb
      · refine ⟨1, ?_, fun n hn => ?_⟩
        · rw [ask_step M o c s hs, ho0 i hiv]
          simp [hv]
        · have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
          subst n
          exact imageCfg_safe M c i S .ask hiv hb
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hAm⟩ := supply
  have hwork := work_step M (x := x) o c s hs i (decide (c.inputPos.val = 0))
  have rest : ∃ T, Represents M (M.tm.step c)
      (rrun (prog M) o (imageCfg M x c i (.work c.inputSymbol
        (decide (c.inputPos.val = 0)))) T) ∧
      ∀ n < T, Safe M v.length S (rrun (prog M) o (imageCfg M x c i
        (.work c.inputSymbol (decide (c.inputPos.val = 0)))) n) := by
    by_cases hh : (M.tm.step c).state = none
    · refine ⟨1, ⟨i, hiv, ?_, fun hn => (hn hh).elim⟩, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      · rw [hwork]
        simp [imageCfg, hh]
      · have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
        subst n
        exact imageCfg_safe M c i S _ hiv hb
    · obtain ⟨s', hs'⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hh
      have hip : (M.tm.step c).inputPos = moveInputPos c.inputPos
          (M.tm.tr s c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).inputTape := by
        simp [MultiTapeTM.step, hs, Action.apply]
      have hrb : (c.inputSymbol.isNone && !decide (c.inputPos.val = 0)) =
          decide (c.inputPos.val = v.length + 1) := by
        have hpos := c.inputPos.isLt
        by_cases hp0 : c.inputPos.val = 0
        · simp [hp0]
        · simp only [hsym, hp0, ↓reduceIte, decide_false, Bool.not_false, Bool.and_true]
          by_cases hit : i < v.length
          · simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hit, show c.inputPos.val ≠ v.length + 1 by omega]
          · simp [(List.getElem?_eq_none (show v.length ≤ i by omega)), show c.inputPos.val = v.length + 1 by omega]
      obtain ⟨T, he, hm⟩ := adjust_index M (x := x) o (M.tm.step c) s' hs' c.inputPos
        (M.tm.tr s c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).inputTape S hip hb'
      refine ⟨1 + T, ?_, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      · rw [rrun_add, hwork, hrb, hi]
        exact he
      · by_cases hn0 : n = 0
        · subst n
          exact imageCfg_safe M c i S _ hiv hb
        · have hn' : n = 1 + (n - 1) := by omega
          rw [hn', rrun_add, hwork, hrb, hi]
          exact hm (n - 1) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBm⟩ := rest
  refine ⟨A + B, ?_, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  · rw [rrun_add, hA]
    exact hB
  · by_cases hnA : n < A
    · exact hAm n hnA
    · have hn' : n = A + (n - A) := by omega
      rw [hn', rrun_add, hA]
      exact hBm (n - A) (by omega)

/-- Every head of a source run up to time `t` is inside the scalar space radius at `t`.

**Proof sketch.** The current cell was visited by that tape. Monotonicity includes it in
the visited set at `t`; the unit-step displacement bound and the corresponding summand
of total visited-cell space give the claimed radius. -/
private theorem source_head_bounds (v : List Bool) (t n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ t) :
    ∀ r, -(M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t : ℤ) ≤
      (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg v) n).workTapePos r ∧
      (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg v) n).workTapePos r ≤
        (M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t : ℤ) := by
  intro r
  have hmem : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg v) n).workTapePos r ∈
      M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg v) n r := by
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨n, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩
  have habs := M.tm.abs_pos_lt_card_visited v t r
    (M.tm.visitedByTapeHead_mono (M.tm.initCfg v) hn r hmem)
  have hcard : (M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg v) t r).card ≤
      M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => (M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg v) t j).card)
      (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ r)
  exact abs_le.mp (habs.le.trans (by exact_mod_cast hcard))

/-- **The run contract of the simulator** (phase P4.4b; proved). Let `M` halt
by time `t` on the virtual input `v`. Let the oracle answer every length query
`⟨x, bits i⟩` with `i ≤ |v|`, and every bit query with `i < |v|`, truthfully. Then the
program, started on the host input `x`:

* halts with `M`'s output on `v`;
* keeps the work registers in `[-S, S]`, with `S` the space `M` uses up to `t`;
* keeps the index register in `[-1, |bits (|v| + 1)|]`;
* at every call has the input head on position `1` and the index register holding some
  `bits i`, `i ≤ |v|`, with its head on cell `0` — so the call's virtual input is
  `⟨x, bits i⟩` (`Complexity.LogProg.vword_whole₁`).

**Proof sketch.** Encode `M`'s configuration `c` on `v` as the program configuration with:

* the work tapes and heads of `c` on registers `castSucc i`;
* `bits (p − 1)` on `q`, with its head on `0` (`p` the input position of `c`; `bits 0` at
  `p = 0`);
* the host input head on `1`, and `c`'s output;
* state `(s, ask)`, or `(s, work none true)` at `p = 0`.

By induction on `n ≤ t`, the run reaches the encoding of `M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg v) n`
until `M` halts. One step goes as follows.

1. At most two calls fix the symbol `inSym v p`: by the oracle laws, the length call says
   `p − 1 < |v|`.
2. `work` applies `M.tm.tr` to the `castSucc` block (`liftAct`), so the work registers move
   exactly as `M`'s tapes.
3. The clamped move of `p` is realized by `nextPh`:
   * `inc_run` only when `p − 1 < |v|`;
   * the zero test and `dec_run` only when `p − 1 ≥ 1`;
   * a phase change at the left blank.

Intermediate configurations are those of the received fragments on `q`. The work heads are
`M`'s, so they lie in `[-S, S]` by `Turing.MultiTapeTM.abs_pos_lt_card_visited`. Template:
`ImplicitEnum.{round, rounds, run}`. -/
theorem run (x v : List Bool) (o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool)
    (ho0 : ∀ i ≤ v.length, o 0 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) = decide (i < v.length))
    (ho1 : ∀ i < v.length, o 1 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) = v.getD i false)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg v) t).state = none) :
    ∃ N, (rrun (prog M) o (Cfg.init (start M) x) N).state = none ∧
      (rrun (prog M) o (Cfg.init (start M) x) N).output =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg v) t).output ∧
      (∀ n ≤ N, ∀ r,
        lo M (M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t) r ≤
            (rrun (prog M) o (Cfg.init (start M) x) n).workTapePos r ∧
          (rrun (prog M) o (Cfg.init (start M) x) n).workTapePos r ≤
            hi M (M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t) (Nat.bits (v.length + 1)).length r) ∧
      ∀ n < N, ∀ l cs, (rrun (prog M) o (Cfg.init (start M) x) n).state = some l →
        (prog M).call l = some cs →
          (rrun (prog M) o (Cfg.init (start M) x) n).inputPos.val = 1 ∧
          (rrun (prog M) o (Cfg.init (start M) x) n).workTapePos (q M) = 0 ∧
          ∃ i ≤ v.length, (rrun (prog M) o (Cfg.init (start M) x) n).workTapes (q M) =
            FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i) := by
  obtain ⟨u, hut, hu, heu⟩ := M.tm.exists_first_halt (M.tm.initCfg v) ht
  have rounds : ∀ n ≤ u, ∃ N,
      Represents M (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg v) n)
        (rrun (prog M) o (Cfg.init (start M) x) N) ∧
      ∀ j < N, Safe M v.length (M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t)
        (rrun (prog M) o (Cfg.init (start M) x) j) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      refine ⟨0, ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, ?_, ?_⟩, fun j hj => by omega⟩
      · refine Cfg.ext rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ rfl
        · apply Fin.ext; simp [rrun_zero, imageCfg, Cfg.init]
        · funext r z
          refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) r <;>
            simp [rrun_zero, imageCfg, Cfg.init, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Nat.zero_bits]
        · funext r
          refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) r <;>
            simp [rrun_zero, imageCfg, Cfg.init, MultiTapeTM.initCfg]
      · intro _; rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      intro hn
      obtain ⟨N, hrep, hmid⟩ := ih (by omega)
      obtain ⟨T, hstep, hfrag⟩ := represented_step M o ho0 ho1 _ _ _ hrep (hu n (by omega))
        (source_head_bounds M v t n (by omega))
        (by simpa only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'] using
          source_head_bounds M v t (n + 1) (by omega))
      refine ⟨N + T, ?_, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      · rw [rrun_add, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
        exact hstep
      · by_cases hjN : j < N
        · exact hmid j hjN
        · have he : j = N + (j - N) := by omega
          rw [he, rrun_add]
          exact hfrag (j - N) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨N, hrep, hmid⟩ := rounds u le_rfl
  have hlast := represents_safe M hrep (source_head_bounds M v t u hut)
  obtain ⟨i, hi, he, _⟩ := hrep
  refine ⟨N, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [he]
    simp only [imageCfg, heu, ht, Option.map_none]
  · rw [he]
    exact congrArg Cfg.output heu
  · intro n hn r
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hn with h | rfl
    · exact (hmid n h).1 r
    · exact hlast.1 r
  · intro n hn
    exact (hmid n hn).2

/-- **The space contract of the simulator** (phase P4.4b; proved). Let:

* deciders `Ms j` decide `As j` in space `sb j`;
* on genuine queries about the host input `x`, `As 0` be the length language and `As 1` the
  bit language of the virtual input `v`;
* `M` compute `w` on `v` by time `t`;
* `B` bound the bank's clean-run radius on every query `⟨x, bits i⟩` with `i ≤ |v|`.

Then the simulator, compiled against the bank of the `Ms j`, computes `w` on `x`, visiting at
most `M.k (2S + 1) + (|bits (|v| + 1)| + 2) + kD (2B + 1)` work cells, where `S` is the space
`M` uses up to `t` and `kD` the bank's tape count.

**Proof sketch.** Take `OIS.run` with the oracle `j, V ↦ [V ∈ As j]`, whose laws are the two
hypotheses. Then apply `compile_space` with the ranges `OIS.lo` and `OIS.hi`; their sizes sum
to the first two terms. Each call's precondition `CallOK` comes from `OIS.run`'s call clause:

* the virtual input is `⟨x, bits i⟩` by `vword_whole₁` and `tapeWord_bufferTape`;
* the clean run of the bank is `bank_cleanRun`, weakened to `B` by `CleanRun.mono`;
* `|bits i| ≤ |bits (|v| + 1)|` by `length_bits_mono`. -/
theorem compile_decides (Ms : Fin 2 → FinTM Bool) (As : Fin 2 → Language Bool)
    (sb : Fin 2 → ℕ → ℕ) (hMs : ∀ j, (Ms j).DecidesInSpace (As j) (sb j)) (x v w : List Bool)
    (hA0 : ∀ i ≤ v.length, pairEncode x (Nat.bits i) ∈ As 0 ↔ i < v.length)
    (hA1 : ∀ i < v.length, pairEncode x (Nat.bits i) ∈ As 1 ↔ v.getD i false = true)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : M.ComputesInTime v w t) (B : ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ j, ∀ i ≤ v.length, max (sb j (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)).length) 1 ≤ B) :
    ∃ T, (compileFinTM (prog M) (start M) (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms)).ComputesInTime x w T ∧
      (compileFinTM (prog M) (start M) (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms)).tm.spaceUsed
          ((compileFinTM (prog M) (start M) (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms)).tm.initCfg x) T ≤
        M.k * (2 * M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t + 1) +
          ((Nat.bits (v.length + 1)).length + 2) + (bankK Ms + bankK Ms) * (2 * B + 1) := by
  classical
  let oracle : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool := fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j) V
  have ho0 : ∀ i ≤ v.length, oracle 0 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) = decide (i < v.length) := by
    intro i hi
    dsimp only [oracle]
    rw [indicator_eq_decide]
    exact decide_eq_decide.mpr (hA0 i hi)
  have ho1 : ∀ i < v.length, oracle 1 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) = v.getD i false := by
    intro i hi
    dsimp only [oracle]
    rw [indicator_eq_decide]
    have hh := hA1 i hi
    cases hv : v.getD i false <;> simp only [hv, Bool.false_eq_true, iff_false, iff_true] at hh
    · simp [hh]
    · simp [hh]
  rw [FinTM.computesInTime_iff] at ht
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hout⟩ := ht
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hOut, hBox, hCalls⟩ := run M x v oracle ho0 ho1 t hhalt
  have hc : ∀ n < N, CallOK (prog M) (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms) oracle
      (lo M (M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t))
      (hi M (M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t) (Nat.bits (v.length + 1)).length) B
      (rrun (prog M) oracle (Cfg.init (start M) x) n) := by
    intro n hn l cs hl hcs
    obtain ⟨hip, hqp, i, hiv, hqi⟩ := hCalls n hn l cs hl hcs
    have hshape : cs.mode = .whole ∧ cs.args = [q M] := by
      rcases l with ⟨s, ph⟩
      cases ph <;> simp only [prog, call, Option.some.injEq, reduceCtorEq] at hcs
      all_goals subst cs; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    have hword : regWords (rrun (prog M) oracle (Cfg.init (start M) x) n) (q M) = Nat.bits i := by
      simp only [regWords, hqi, tapeWord_bufferTape]
    have hquery : vword (callSegs cs x
        (regWords (rrun (prog M) oracle (Cfg.init (start M) x) n))) =
        pairEncode x (Nat.bits i) := by
      rcases cs with ⟨j, mode, args, yes, no⟩
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hshape
      rw [vword_whole₁, hword]
    refine ⟨by rw [hshape.2]; simp, hip, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro r hr
      rw [hshape.2, List.mem_singleton] at hr
      subst r
      rw [hword]
      refine ⟨hqi, hqp, by simp [lo, q], ?_⟩
      simpa only [hi, q, Fin.lastCases_last, Nat.cast_le] using
        (length_bits_mono (show i ≤ v.length + 1 by omega))
    · rw [hquery]
      exact (bank_cleanRun Ms As sb hMs cs.dec _).mono (hB cs.dec i hiv)
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hSpace⟩ := compile_space (prog M) (start M) (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms)
    oracle (lo M (M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t))
    (hi M (M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t) (Nat.bits (v.length + 1)).length)
    B N w hN (hOut.trans hout) hBox hc
  refine ⟨T, hT, hSpace.trans_eq ?_⟩
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp only [lo, hi, Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Fin.lastCases_last, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 2; (try congr 1); omega

end LogProg.OIS

/-- **Logspace preimages along implicitly logspace computable maps are logspace**
(phase P4.4b; proved): if `f` is implicitly logspace computable and `C ∈ L`, then
`{x | f x ∈ C} ∈ L`. [AB09, Lemma 4.17(2), in preimage form; its proof's Fig. 4.3] It is stated,
and will be proved, as a corollary of `Complexity.LogProg.OIS.compile_decides`.

**Proof sketch.** Unpack `f`'s bound `C₀ (|x| + 1)^e` and its two deciders (spaces `c₀`,
`c₁` times `logSpace`), and `C`'s decider `M` (space `c · logSpace`). For each `x`, take the
time `t` of `M` on `v := f x`, and apply `OIS.compile_decides` with:

* the bank `![length decider, bit decider]`;
* the laws `pairEncode_mem_indexLang`;
* `B := (c₀ + c₁) · logSpace (2|x| + 2 + |bits (|f x| + 1)|) + 1`.

The indicator `[f x ∈ C]` is `[x ∈ {x | f x ∈ C}]`. The bound is `O(logSpace |x|)`:
`logSpace |f x|` and `|bits (|f x| + 1)|` are at most `K · logSpace |x|` by
`LogProg.log_poly_bound`, since `|f x| ≤ C₀ (|x| + 1)^e`. The arithmetic follows
`ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable.computesInSpace`. -/
theorem mem_LOGSPACE_preimage {f : List Bool → List Bool} (hf : ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable f)
    {C : Language Bool} (hC : C ∈ LOGSPACE) : ({x | f x ∈ C} : Language Bool) ∈ LOGSPACE := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨A, e, hlen⟩, ⟨cb, Mb, hb⟩, ⟨cl, Ml, hl⟩⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨c, M, hM⟩ := hC
  let Ms : Fin 2 → FinTM Bool := ![Ml, Mb]
  let As : Fin 2 → Language Bool :=
    ![indexLang (fun x i => i < (f x).length),
      indexLang (fun x i => (f x).getD i false = true)]
  let sb : Fin 2 → ℕ → ℕ := ![fun n => cl * logSpace n, fun n => cb * logSpace n]
  have hMs : ∀ j, (Ms j).DecidesInSpace (As j) (sb j) := by
    intro j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)) j
    · exact hl
    · exact hb
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := LogProg.log_poly_bound A e 1
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := LogProg.log_poly_bound (A + 2) (e + 1) 2
  let D := LogProg.bankK Ms + LogProg.bankK Ms
  refine ⟨M.k * (2 * (c * K) + 1) + (K + 2) + D * (2 * ((cl + cb) * J + 1) + 1),
    LogProg.compileFinTM (LogProg.OIS.prog M) (LogProg.OIS.start M)
      (LogProg.bankTM Ms) (LogProg.bankStart Ms), fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hs⟩ := hM (f x)
  let W := (Nat.bits ((f x).length + 1)).length
  let B := (cl + cb) * logSpace (2 * x.length + 2 + W) + 1
  have hbudget : ∀ j, ∀ i ≤ (f x).length,
      max (sb j (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)).length) 1 ≤ B := by
    intro j i hi
    have hquery : (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)).length ≤ 2 * x.length + 2 + W := by
      rw [length_pairEncode]
      have hw : (Nat.bits i).length ≤ W := LogProg.length_bits_mono (by omega)
      omega
    have hmono := logSpace_mono hquery
    have hcoef : sb j (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)).length ≤
        (cl + cb) * logSpace (2 * x.length + 2 + W) := by
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)) j
      · exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_add_right cl cb) hmono
      · exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_add_left cb cl) hmono
    dsimp [B]
    omega
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hSpace⟩ := LogProg.OIS.compile_decides M Ms As sb hMs x (f x)
    [MultiTapeTM.indicator C (f x)]
    (fun i _ => pairEncode_mem_indexLang _ x i)
    (fun i _ => pairEncode_mem_indexLang _ x i) t ht B hbudget
  refine ⟨T, hT, hSpace.trans ?_⟩
  let L := logSpace x.length
  have hL : 1 ≤ L := by simp [L, logSpace]
  have hlog : logSpace (f x).length ≤ K * L := by
    have hm := Nat.log_mono_right (b := 2) (show (f x).length ≤ A * (x.length + 1) ^ e + 1 by
      have := hlen x; omega)
    have hk := hK x.length
    dsimp [L, logSpace]
    omega
  have hW : W ≤ K * L := by
    have hw := LogProg.length_bits_le_log ((f x).length + 1)
    have hm := Nat.log_mono_right (b := 2) (Nat.add_le_add_right (hlen x) 1)
    have hk := hK x.length
    dsimp [W, L, logSpace] at *
    omega
  have hJx : logSpace (2 * x.length + 2 + W) ≤ J * L := by
    have hw : W ≤ (f x).length + 2 :=
      (LogProg.length_bits_le_log _).trans (by
        have := Complexity.logSpace_le_succ ((f x).length + 1)
        rw [Complexity.logSpace_eq] at this
        omega)
    have hp : x.length + 1 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) := by
      simpa only [pow_one] using
        Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 1 ≤ x.length + 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ e + 1 by omega)
    have he : (x.length + 1) ^ e ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
    have hpoly := (hlen x).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left A he)
    have harg : 2 * x.length + 2 + W ≤ (A + 2) * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) + 2 := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul]
      omega
    exact (logSpace_mono harg).trans (hJ x.length)
  have hsrc : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg (f x)) t ≤ c * K * L := by
    exact hs.trans (by simpa only [Nat.mul_assoc] using Nat.mul_le_mul_left c hlog)
  have hbank : 2 * B + 1 ≤ (2 * ((cl + cb) * J + 1) + 1) * L := by
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (cl + cb) hJx
    have he : (2 * ((cl + cb) * J + 1) + 1) * L =
        2 * ((cl + cb) * (J * L)) + 3 * L := by ring
    rw [he]
    dsimp only [B]
    omega
  have hsource : 2 * M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg (f x)) t + 1 ≤
      (2 * (c * K) + 1) * L := by
    have he : (2 * (c * K) + 1) * L = 2 * (c * K * L) + L := by ring
    rw [he]
    omega
  calc
    M.k * (2 * M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg (f x)) t + 1) + (W + 2) + D * (2 * B + 1)
        ≤ M.k * ((2 * (c * K) + 1) * L) + ((K + 2) * L) +
            D * ((2 * ((cl + cb) * J + 1) + 1) * L) := by
          apply Nat.add_le_add
          · apply Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left M.k hsource)
            rw [Nat.add_mul]; omega
          · exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left D hbank
    _ = _ := by ring

end Complexity
```

```
/-

Authors: Seyoon Ragavan

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.PreimageHost

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Reshaping implicit queries

To compose implicitly logspace computable functions [AB09, Lemma 4.17's proof], a query
`⟨x, bits i⟩` about `g (f x)` is reshaped into the query `⟨f x, bits i⟩` about `g`. This is
`Complexity.compQ f`, and it is itself implicitly logspace computable. Both query languages of
`g ∘ f` are then preimages of `g`'s along it (`Complexity.mem_indexLang_compQ_iff`), hence in
`L` by `Complexity.mem_LOGSPACE_preimage`.

Deciding `compQ f`'s own languages needs `f`'s queries at `⟨x, bits j⟩`. An abstract register
machine on the host `⟨⟨x, bits i⟩, bits p⟩` can only present `⟨⟨⟨x, bits i⟩, bits p⟩, bits j⟩`
(a `whole`-mode call). The index-dropping map `Complexity.dropIdx` takes
`⟨⟨w, b⟩, b'⟩ ↦ ⟨w, b'⟩`; applied twice it recovers `⟨x, bits j⟩`.

Phase P4.4b of `AroraBarakChapters3-4Plan.md`; see `audits/ch4-p44-resolutions-addendum.md`.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.dropIdx` — `⟨⟨w, b⟩, b'⟩ ↦ ⟨w, b'⟩`, and `[]` off that shape.
* `Complexity.compQ` — `⟨x, b⟩ ↦ ⟨f x, b⟩` for canonical `b`, and `[]` otherwise.

## Main results

* `Complexity.dropIdx_pairEncode`, `Complexity.dropIdx_length_le` — the map on nested pairs;
  its length bound.
* `Complexity.compQ_pairEncode`, `Complexity.mem_indexLang_compQ_iff`,
  `Complexity.compQ_length_le` — the map on queries; the preimage identity; the length bound.
* `Complexity.implicitlyLogspaceComputable_dropIdx`,
  `Complexity.ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable.compQ` — both maps are implicitly logspace
  computable (proved; phase-P4.4b statements).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.3, Definition 4.16, Lemma 4.17 and its proof.)
-/

namespace Complexity

open Turing

/-- **Dropping the middle index**: `⟨⟨w, b⟩, b'⟩ ↦ ⟨w, b'⟩`, and `[]` on words not of that
shape. -/
def dropIdx (z : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  match pairDecode z with
  | some (u, b') =>
    match pairDecode u with
    | some (w, _) => pairEncode w b'
    | none => []
  | none => []

/-- `dropIdx` on a nested pair. -/
theorem dropIdx_pairEncode (w b b' : List Bool) :
    dropIdx (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b') = pairEncode w b' := by
  simp [dropIdx, pairDecode_pairEncode]

/-- `dropIdx` never lengthens a word. -/
theorem dropIdx_length_le (z : List Bool) : (dropIdx z).length ≤ z.length := by
  unfold dropIdx
  split
  · rename_i u b' hz
    split
    · rename_i w b hu
      rw [eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode _ _ _ hz, eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode _ _ _ hu]
      simp only [length_pairEncode]
      omega
    · simp
  · simp

/-- **The query reshaping of a composition**: `⟨x, b⟩ ↦ ⟨f x, b⟩` when `b` is a canonical
binary word (some `Nat.bits i`), and `[]` otherwise. -/
def compQ (f : List Bool → List Bool) (w : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  match pairDecode w with
  | some (x, b) => if Nat.bits (LogProg.bitsVal b) = b then pairEncode (f x) b else []
  | none => []

/-- `compQ f` on a genuine query. -/
theorem compQ_pairEncode (f : List Bool → List Bool) (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    compQ f (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) = pairEncode (f x) (Nat.bits i) := by
  simp [compQ, pairDecode_pairEncode, LogProg.bitsVal_bits]

/-- **The preimage identity of composition**: a word is in `{⟨x, i⟩ | p (f x) i}` iff its
reshaping is in `{⟨y, i⟩ | p y i}`. Malformed and non-canonical queries go to `[]`, which no
index language contains. -/
theorem mem_indexLang_compQ_iff (f : List Bool → List Bool) (p : List Bool → ℕ → Prop)
    (w : List Bool) :
    w ∈ indexLang (fun x i => p (f x) i) ↔ compQ f w ∈ indexLang p := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, i, rfl, hp⟩
    exact ⟨f x, i, compQ_pairEncode f x i, hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, i, h, hp⟩
    unfold compQ at h
    split at h
    · rename_i x b hw
      split_ifs at h with hb
      · have := pairEncode_injective (a₁ := (f x, b)) (a₂ := (y, Nat.bits i)) h
        simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at this
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := this
        exact ⟨x, i, eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode _ _ _ hw, hp⟩
      · exact absurd h.symm (pairEncode_ne_nil _ _)
    · exact absurd h.symm (pairEncode_ne_nil _ _)

/-- `compQ f` is polynomially bounded when `f` is: `|compQ f w| ≤ (2C + 3)(|w| + 1)^{c+1}`
from `|f x| ≤ C (|x| + 1)^c`. -/
theorem compQ_length_le {f : List Bool → List Bool} {C c : ℕ}
    (hf : ∀ x, (f x).length ≤ C * (x.length + 1) ^ c) (w : List Bool) :
    (compQ f w).length ≤ (2 * C + 3) * (w.length + 1) ^ (c + 1) := by
  unfold compQ
  split
  · rename_i x b hw
    split_ifs
    · have hw' := eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode _ _ _ hw
      have hl : w.length = 2 * x.length + 2 + b.length := by rw [hw', length_pairEncode]
      have e1 : (w.length + 1) ^ c ≤ (w.length + 1) ^ (c + 1) :=
        Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
      have e2 : w.length + 1 ≤ (w.length + 1) ^ (c + 1) := by
        calc w.length + 1 = (w.length + 1) ^ 1 := (pow_one _).symm
          _ ≤ _ := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
      have e3 : (f x).length ≤ C * (w.length + 1) ^ c :=
        (hf x).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _))
      have e4 : C * (w.length + 1) ^ c ≤ C * (w.length + 1) ^ (c + 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ e1
      rw [length_pairEncode]
      have e5 : (2 * C + 3) * (w.length + 1) ^ (c + 1) =
          2 * (C * (w.length + 1) ^ (c + 1)) + 3 * (w.length + 1) ^ (c + 1) := by ring
      omega
    · simp
  · simp

/-- The kept prefix of `dropIdx` is read at stride four in its paired query host.
The discarded middle field and the retained suffix are arbitrary words.

**Proof sketch.** The two enclosing first-field encodings each double addresses. Below
the separator of the innermost pair, changing its second field does not change a bit. -/
private lemma dropIdx_prefix_address (w b b' tail : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j < 2 * w.length + 2) :
    (dropIdx (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b')).getD j false =
      (pairEncode (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b') tail).getD (4 * j) false := by
  have hu := length_pairEncode w b
  have hz := length_pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b'
  have h₁ : (pairEncode (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b') tail).getD (4 * j) false =
      (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b').getD (2 * j) false := by
    rw [pairEncode_getD, if_pos (by omega)]
    congr 1
    omega
  have h₂ : (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b').getD (2 * j) false =
      (pairEncode w b).getD j false := by
    rw [pairEncode_getD, if_pos (by omega)]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [h₁, h₂, dropIdx_pairEncode, pairEncode_getD, pairEncode_getD]
  split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega

/-- A retained suffix bit is read after the doubled outer separator. This address is
used only within the suffix; an out-of-range query must be rejected before making it.

**Proof sketch.** Remove the host's outer doubling, then the discarded pair's doubled
first field and separator. The remaining address is exactly the suffix index. -/
private lemma dropIdx_suffix_address (w b b' tail : List Bool) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < b'.length) :
    (dropIdx (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b')).getD (2 * w.length + 2 + j) false =
      (pairEncode (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b') tail).getD
        (4 * (pairEncode w b).length + 4 + 2 * j) false := by
  have hz := length_pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b'
  have h₁ : (pairEncode (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b') tail).getD
        (4 * (pairEncode w b).length + 4 + 2 * j) false =
      (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b').getD (2 * (pairEncode w b).length + 2 + j) false := by
    rw [pairEncode_getD, if_pos (by omega)]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [h₁, dropIdx_pairEncode, pairEncode_getD, pairEncode_getD]
  rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
    if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Passing a binary-width check bounds the decoded value by twice the cap, including a
zero cap. This also bounds every partial value in a most-significant-bit-first decoder.

**Proof sketch.** The value is below `2 ^ |bits r| ≤ 2 ^ |bits n|`. For positive `n`,
`2 ^ |bits n| ≤ 2*n`; at zero both canonical representations are empty. -/
private lemma query_index_bound (r n : ℕ)
    (hwidth : (Nat.bits r).length ≤ (Nat.bits n).length) : r ≤ 2 * n := by
  have hr : r < 2 ^ (Nat.bits n).length :=
    (LogProg.lt_two_pow_bits r).trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hwidth)
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    simp only [Nat.zero_bits, List.length_nil, pow_zero] at hr
    omega
  · have := LogProg.two_pow_bits_le n (by omega)
    omega

/-- Discarding low-order digits cannot increase a binary word's value. -/
private lemma query_suffix_value_le (w : List Bool) (j : ℕ) :
    LogProg.bitsVal (w.drop j) ≤ LogProg.bitsVal w := by
  induction j generalizing w with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    cases w with
    | nil => simp [LogProg.bitsVal]
    | cons b w =>
      have h := ih w
      simp only [List.drop_succ_cons, LogProg.bitsVal]
      omega

/-- The width test bounds every accumulator of the reverse tail scan before decoding it.
Canonicality is required only of the query index, never of `dropIdx`'s payload fields. -/
private lemma query_accumulator_bound (w : List Bool) (n j : ℕ) (hc : LogProg.Canon w)
    (hwidth : w.length ≤ (Nat.bits n).length) : LogProg.bitsVal (w.drop j) ≤ 2 * n := by
  apply (query_suffix_value_le w j).trans
  apply query_index_bound
  simpa only [← LogProg.canon_eq_bits w hc] using hwidth

/-- The canonical-index length overflow test makes both queries false before its
numerical value is accumulated. -/
private lemma dropIdx_query_overflow (z : List Bool) (r : ℕ)
    (hlarge : (Nat.bits ((pairEncode z (Nat.bits r)).length)).length < (Nat.bits r).length) :
    (dropIdx z).getD r false = false ∧ ¬ r < (dropIdx z).length := by
  have hr : (pairEncode z (Nat.bits r)).length < r := by
    by_contra h
    have hb := LogProg.length_bits_mono (Nat.le_of_not_gt h)
    omega
  have hz := length_pairEncode z (Nat.bits r)
  have hd := dropIdx_length_le z
  have hout : (dropIdx z).length ≤ r := by omega
  exact ⟨by simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_none hout], by omega⟩

/-! ## The bounded index-dropping ARM -/

open LogProg Classical

/-- Finite control of the one index-dropping ARM. The mode parameter selects bit or length
answers only at a successful lookup. Registers hold the physical pointer, host end,
first-field end, retained-suffix start, inner-field end, prefix end, query, scratch/candidate,
and query-tail start, in that order. -/
private inductive DropState where
  | lengthTest | lengthInc
  | copy (stage : Fin 8) (bump : Bool)
  | scan (layer : Fin 3) | first (layer : Fin 3)
  | second (layer : Fin 3) (bit : Bool) | readSecond (layer : Fin 3) (bit : Bool)
  | scanInc (layer : Fin 3) (choice : Fin 4) (step : Fin 4)
  | tailTest (last : Bool) | tailCheck | tailRead | tailHalf (bit : Bool) | tailInc (bit : Bool)
  | tailDone | clearPtr (stage : Fin 5)
  | zDec (step : Fin 2) | uDec (step : Fin 4)
  | decode | decodeDown | decodeRead | decodeCopy (bit : Bool) | decodeCopyInc (bit : Bool)
  | decodeClear (bit : Bool) | decodeScale (bit : Bool) | decodeTake (bit : Bool)
  | decodeInc (bit : Bool) (second : Bool) | decodeAdd (bit : Bool)
  | seek (suffix : Bool) | matchIndex (suffix : Bool) | nextIndex (suffix : Bool)
  | walk (suffix : Bool) (step : Fin 4) | hit | answer (bit : Bool)
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- Each copy stage names its destination, source, and continuation. -/
private def dropCopy : Fin 8 → Fin 9 × Fin 9 × DropState
  | 0 => (8, 0, .copy 1 false)
  | 1 => (7, 1, .tailTest true)
  | 2 => (0, 1, .decode)
  | 3 => (2, 8, .zDec 0)
  | 4 => (3, 0, .copy 5 false)
  | 5 => (4, 0, .uDec 0)
  | 6 => (5, 0, .clearPtr 3)
  | 7 => (0, 3, .seek true)

/-- The three pair scans read the host, its first field, and that field's first field. -/
private def dropStride (layer : Fin 3) : ℕ := ![1, 2, 4] layer

/-- End registers for those scans, all in physical host coordinates. -/
private def dropLimit (layer : Fin 3) : Fin 9 := ![1, 2, 4] layer

/-- A successful scan stores its boundary before the next phase. -/
private def dropScanDone (layer : Fin 3) : DropState :=
  .copy (![0, 4, 6] layer) false

/-- Shared finite increment chains for the received aligned scan. -/
private def dropAdvance (layer : Fin 3) (choice : Fin 4) (i : ℕ) : DropState :=
  if h : i < dropStride layer then .scanInc layer choice ⟨i, by
    have : dropStride layer ≤ 4 := (by decide : ∀ l, dropStride l ≤ 4) layer
    omega⟩
  else ![.second layer false, .second layer true, .scan layer, dropScanDone layer] choice

/-- A one-cell advance of the outer query tail. -/
private def dropTailAdvance (b : Bool) (i : ℕ) : DropState :=
  if i = 0 then .tailInc b else .tailTest b

/-- Two increments implement the decoder's doubling transfer. -/
private def dropDecodeAdvance (b : Bool) (i : ℕ) : DropState :=
  if i = 0 then .decodeInc b false else if i = 1 then .decodeInc b true else .decodeScale b

/-- Lookup walks use stride four in the kept prefix and stride two in the retained suffix. -/
private def dropWalk (suffix : Bool) (i : ℕ) : DropState :=
  if h : i < (if suffix then 2 else 4) then
    .walk suffix ⟨i, by
      cases suffix with
      | false => exact h
      | true => have : i < 2 := h; omega⟩
  else .seek suffix

/-- The complete index-dropping table, assembled from the bounded shared fragments.
Only the outer query tail is required to be canonical. The two payloads scanned inside
its first field are arbitrary words. -/
private def dropARM (lengthMode : Bool) : ARM 9 2 DropState
  | .lengthTest => .call 1 .whole [1] .lengthInc (.scan 0)
  | .lengthInc => .inc 1 .lengthTest
  | .copy s false => .jeq (dropCopy s).1 (dropCopy s).2.1 (dropCopy s).2.2 (.copy s true)
  | .copy s true => .inc (dropCopy s).1 (.copy s false)
  | .scan layer => .jeq 0 (dropLimit layer) (.answer false) (.first layer)
  | .first layer => .call 0 .whole [0] (dropAdvance layer 1 0) (dropAdvance layer 0 0)
  | .second layer b => .jeq 0 (dropLimit layer) (.answer false) (.readSecond layer b)
  | .readSecond layer b => .call 0 .whole [0]
      (if b then dropAdvance layer 2 0 else dropAdvance layer 3 0)
      (if b then .answer false else dropAdvance layer 2 0)
  | .scanInc layer choice i => .inc 0 (dropAdvance layer choice (i.val + 1))
  | .tailTest b => .jeq 0 1 (if b then .tailDone else .answer false) .tailCheck
  | .tailCheck => .jz 7 (.answer false) .tailRead
  | .tailRead => .call 0 .whole [0] (.tailHalf true) (.tailHalf false)
  | .tailHalf b => .half 7 (.tailInc b)
  | .tailInc b => .inc 0 (.tailTest b)
  | .tailDone => .clr 7 (.clearPtr 0)
  | .clearPtr s => .clr 0 (![.copy 2 false, .scan 1, .scan 2, .seek false, .copy 7 false] s)
  | .zDec i => .dec 2 (if i = 0 then .zDec 1 else .clearPtr 1)
  | .uDec i => .dec 4 (if h : i.val + 1 < 4 then .uDec ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ else .clearPtr 2)
  | .decode => .jeq 0 8 (.copy 3 false) .decodeDown
  | .decodeDown => .dec 0 .decodeRead
  | .decodeRead => .call 0 .whole [0] (.decodeCopy true) (.decodeCopy false)
  | .decodeCopy b => .jeq 7 6 (.decodeClear b) (.decodeCopyInc b)
  | .decodeCopyInc b => .inc 7 (.decodeCopy b)
  | .decodeClear b => .clr 6 (.decodeScale b)
  | .decodeScale b => .jz 7 (.decodeAdd b) (.decodeTake b)
  | .decodeTake b => .dec 7 (.decodeInc b false)
  | .decodeInc b false => .inc 6 (.decodeInc b true)
  | .decodeInc b true => .inc 6 (.decodeScale b)
  | .decodeAdd b => if b then .inc 6 .decode else .jz 7 .decode .decode
  | .seek suffix => .jeq 0 (if suffix then 2 else 5)
      (if suffix then .answer false else .clearPtr 4) (.matchIndex suffix)
  | .matchIndex suffix => .jeq 7 6 .hit (.nextIndex suffix)
  | .nextIndex suffix => .inc 7 (dropWalk suffix 0)
  | .walk suffix i => .inc 0 (dropWalk suffix (i.val + 1))
  | .hit => if lengthMode then .ret true else .call 0 .whole [0] (.answer true) (.answer false)
  | .answer b => .ret b

/-- The access bank is independent of the mode. -/
private def dropBank : Fin 2 → Language Bool := ![inputBitLang, inputLenLang]

/-- Both modes use the same language expression and the same table. -/
private def dropLang (lengthMode : Bool) : Language Bool :=
  indexLang fun z q => if lengthMode then q < (dropIdx z).length else (dropIdx z).getD q false = true

/-- Every reachable instruction's syntactic side conditions already hold for this table.
There are no format-specific input instructions, and every call has one argument. -/
private lemma drop_preS (mode : Bool) (h : List Bool) (c : AConf 9 DropState) :
    PreS (dropARM mode) h c := by
  rcases c with ⟨l, v, ans⟩
  cases l with
  | none => trivial
  | some l =>
    cases l <;> simp only [PreS, dropARM] <;> try decide
    case copy stage bump =>
      cases bump
      · exact (by decide : ∀ s, (dropCopy s).1 ≠ (dropCopy s).2.1) stage
      · trivial
    case scan layer => exact (by decide : ∀ l, (0 : Fin 9) ≠ dropLimit l) layer
    case second layer bit => exact (by decide : ∀ l, (0 : Fin 9) ≠ dropLimit l) layer
    case decodeAdd bit => cases bit <;> trivial
    case seek suffix => cases suffix <;> decide
    case decodeInc bit second => cases second <;> trivial
    case hit => cases mode <;> simp

/-- Truthful calls to the fixed two-language access bank. -/
private noncomputable def dropOracle (j : Fin 2) (w : List Bool) : Bool :=
  MultiTapeTM.indicator (dropBank j : Set (List Bool)) w

/-- The common bounded guard uses exactly the brief's linear register bound. -/
private abbrev DropGood (mode : Bool) (h : List Bool) (a : AConf 9 DropState) :=
  PreS (dropARM mode) h a ∧ ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4

/-- Bounded reachability is the received relation, with the fixed table and oracle. -/
private abbrev DropReach (mode : Bool) (h : List Bool) :=
  AReach (dropARM mode) dropOracle h (DropGood mode h)

/-- Halting uses the same received relation and guard. -/
private abbrev DropHalt (mode : Bool) (h : List Bool) :=
  AHalt (dropARM mode) dropOracle h (DropGood mode h)

/-- A register vector for the phase boundaries of the index-dropping machine. -/
private def dropValues (n : ℕ) (ptr zend retained inner kept query temp tail : ℕ := 0) : Fin 9 → ℕ :=
  ![ptr, n, zend, retained, inner, kept, query, temp, tail]

/-- A bit call reads the corresponding host position, including its false default. -/
private lemma drop_bit (h : List Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    dropOracle 0 (pairEncode h (Nat.bits i)) = h.getD i false := by
  change MultiTapeTM.indicator (inputBitLang : Set (List Bool)) _ = _
  exact indicator_inputBitLang h i

/-- A length call tests a host position. -/
private lemma drop_len (h : List Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    dropOracle 1 (pairEncode h (Nat.bits i)) = decide (i < h.length) := by
  change MultiTapeTM.indicator (inputLenLang : Set (List Bool)) _ = _
  exact indicator_inputLenLang h i

/-- Returning a bit halts in one bounded step. -/
private lemma drop_ret (mode b : Bool) (h : List Bool) (v : Fin 9 → ℕ)
    (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4) :
    DropHalt mode h (some (.answer b), v, none) b :=
  AHalt.ret rfl ⟨drop_preS mode h _, hv⟩

/-- At a matching index the length mode accepts; the bit mode calls the access bank. -/
private lemma drop_hit (mode : Bool) (h : List Bool) (v : Fin 9 → ℕ)
    (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4) :
    DropHalt mode h (some .hit, v, none) (if mode then true else h.getD (v 0) false) := by
  cases mode
  · apply AHalt.step ⟨drop_preS false h _, hv⟩
    rw [astep_call (show dropARM false .hit = _ from rfl)]
    simp only [vword_whole₁, drop_bit]
    cases hb : h.getD (v 0) false <;> simpa [hb] using drop_ret false _ h v hv
  · exact AHalt.ret rfl ⟨drop_preS true h _, hv⟩

/-- Every copy stage instantiates the one shared bounded copy loop. -/
private lemma drop_copy_run (mode : Bool) (h : List Bool) (stage : Fin 8) (v : Fin 9 → ℕ)
    (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4)
    (hle : v (dropCopy stage).1 ≤ v (dropCopy stage).2.1) :
    DropReach mode h (some (.copy stage false), v, none)
      (some (dropCopy stage).2.2,
        Function.update v (dropCopy stage).1 (v (dropCopy stage).2.1), none) := by
  exact registerCopy_loop (dropARM mode) dropOracle h _ _
    ((by decide : ∀ s, (dropCopy s).1 ≠ (dropCopy s).2.1) stage)
    _ _ _ rfl rfl _ v hv hle

/-- Every nested pair scan is an instance of the received strided pair validator. -/
private lemma drop_pair_run (mode : Bool) (h : List Bool) (layer : Fin 3)
    (w : List Bool) (v : Fin 9 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4)
    (hl : v (dropLimit layer) = v 0 + dropStride layer * w.length)
    (ho : ∀ i < w.length, h.getD (v 0 + dropStride layer * i) false = w.getD i false) :
    match pairDecode w with
    | none => ∃ t ≤ w.length, DropReach mode h (some (.scan layer), v, none)
        (some (.answer false), Function.update v 0 (v 0 + dropStride layer * t), none)
    | some (a, _) => DropReach mode h (some (.scan layer), v, none)
        (some (dropScanDone layer),
          Function.update v 0 (v 0 + dropStride layer * (2 * a.length + 2)), none) := by
  apply alignedPair_loop (dropARM mode) dropOracle h 0 (dropLimit layer) 0
    (.scan layer) (.first layer) (.second layer) (.readSecond layer)
    (.answer false) (dropScanDone layer) (dropAdvance layer) (dropStride layer) _
    ((by decide : ∀ l, 0 < dropStride l) layer)
    ((by decide : ∀ l, (0 : Fin 9) ≠ dropLimit l) layer) rfl rfl
    (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)
  · intro choice i hi
    simp only [dropAdvance, dif_pos hi, dropARM]
  · simp [dropAdvance]
  · exact hv
  · exact hl
  · intro i hi
    rw [drop_bit]
    exact ho i hi

/-- Lookup exposes a phase-boundary vector only when its register is supplied. -/
@[simp] private lemma dropValues_apply (n p z s u f q t a : ℕ) (r : Fin 9) :
    dropValues n p z s u f q t a r = ![p, n, z, s, u, f, q, t, a] r := rfl

/-- One register update preserves the boundary-vector representation. -/
@[simp] private lemma dropValues_update (n p z s u f q t a : ℕ) (r : Fin 9) (b : ℕ) :
    Function.update (dropValues n p z s u f q t a) r b =
      dropValues (if 1 = r then b else n) (if 0 = r then b else p)
        (if 2 = r then b else z) (if 3 = r then b else s) (if 4 = r then b else u)
        (if 5 = r then b else f) (if 6 = r then b else q) (if 7 = r then b else t)
        (if 8 = r then b else a) := by
  apply funext
  simp [Fin.forall_fin_succ, dropValues, Function.update_apply]

/-- Bounds on a boundary vector are the nine scalar bounds. -/
private lemma dropValues_bound (n p z s u f q t a B : ℕ)
    (hn : n ≤ B) (hp : p ≤ B) (hz : z ≤ B) (hs : s ≤ B) (hu : u ≤ B)
    (hf : f ≤ B) (hq : q ≤ B) (ht : t ≤ B) (ha : a ≤ B) :
    ∀ r, dropValues n p z s u f q t a r ≤ B := by
  simpa [Fin.forall_fin_succ] using ⟨hp, hn, hz, hs, hu, hf, hq, ht, ha⟩

/-- Successful outer validation decodes the bounded query; either failed test rejects.
The proof uses the shared tail scanner before the shared reverse decoder.

**Proof sketch.** Save the tail start and copy the host length into the width cap. The tail
scan either rejects or establishes canonicality and the width bound. Clear its scratch,
restore the pointer to the host end, and invoke bounded decoding. Its accumulator bounds
come from the frozen suffix-value lemma. No arbitrary payload is decoded numerically. -/
private lemma drop_tail_decode (mode : Bool) (z tail : List Bool) :
    let h := pairEncode z tail
    let p := 2 * z.length + 2
    if Canon tail ∧ tail.length ≤ (Nat.bits h.length).length then
      DropReach mode h
        (some (.copy 0 false), dropValues h.length (ptr := p), none)
        (some (.copy 3 false), dropValues h.length (ptr := p) (query := bitsVal tail) (tail := p), none)
    else DropHalt mode h
      (some (.copy 0 false), dropValues h.length (ptr := p), none) false := by
  dsimp only
  let h := pairEncode z tail
  let p := 2 * z.length + 2
  have len : h.length = p + tail.length := length_pairEncode z tail
  have pn : p ≤ h.length := by omega
  let v₀ := dropValues h.length (ptr := p)
  let v₁ := dropValues h.length (ptr := p) (tail := p)
  let v₂ := dropValues h.length (ptr := p) (temp := h.length) (tail := p)
  have bounds : ∀ (ptr temp : ℕ), ptr ≤ h.length → temp ≤ h.length →
      ∀ r, (dropValues h.length (ptr := ptr) (temp := temp) (tail := p)) r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := by
    intro ptr temp hp ht
    apply dropValues_bound <;> omega
  have b₀ : ∀ r, v₀ r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := by
    dsimp [v₀]; apply dropValues_bound <;> omega
  have b₁ := bounds p 0 pn (Nat.zero_le _)
  have b₂ := bounds p h.length pn le_rfl
  have c₀ : DropReach mode h (some (.copy 0 false), v₀, none)
      (some (.copy 1 false), v₁, none) := by
    simpa [v₀, v₁, dropCopy] using drop_copy_run mode h 0 v₀ b₀ (by simp [v₀, dropCopy])
  have c₁ : DropReach mode h (some (.copy 1 false), v₁, none)
      (some (.tailTest true), v₂, none) := by
    simpa [v₁, v₂, dropCopy] using drop_copy_run mode h 1 v₁ b₁ (by simp [v₁, dropCopy])
  have reads : ∀ i < tail.length,
      dropOracle 0 (pairEncode h (Nat.bits (v₂ 0 + 1 * i))) = tail.getD i false := by
    intro i hi
    rw [drop_bit]
    simp only [v₂, dropValues_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, one_mul]
    rw [show p + i = 2 * z.length + 2 + i by rfl]
    rw [show h = pairEncode z tail by rfl, pairEncode_getD]
    rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
    congr 1
    omega
  obtain ⟨v, bv, vp, frame, scan⟩ := canonicalTail_loop (dropARM mode) dropOracle h
    0 1 7 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) 0 DropState.tailTest
    .tailCheck .tailRead (.answer false) .tailDone DropState.tailHalf dropTailAdvance 1
    (4 * h.length + 4) (by omega) (fun _ => rfl) rfl rfl
    (fun _ => rfl)
    (by
      intro b i hi
      have hi0 : i = 0 := by omega
      subst i
      rfl)
    (fun _ => rfl) tail true v₂ b₂
    (by simpa [v₂] using len) reads
  have fn : v 1 = h.length := by simpa [v₂] using frame 1 (by decide) (by decide)
  have ft : v 8 = p := by simpa [v₂] using frame 8 (by decide) (by decide)
  by_cases good : Canon tail ∧ tail.length ≤ (Nat.bits h.length).length
  · rw [if_pos good]
    have flag := (drop_canon tail).mpr good.1
    have scan' : DropReach mode h (some (.tailTest true), v₂, none) (some .tailDone, v, none) := by
      have ss := scan
      simp only [flag, ↓reduceIte] at ss
      simpa [v₂, good.2] using ss
    have reset : DropReach mode h (some .tailDone, v, none)
        (some (.copy 2 false), dropValues h.length (tail := p), none) := by
      apply AReach.step ⟨drop_preS mode h _, bv⟩
      simp only [astep_clr (show dropARM mode .tailDone = _ from rfl)]
      apply AReach.step ⟨drop_preS mode h _, register_update_le v 7 _ 0 bv (by omega)⟩
      simp only [astep_clr (show dropARM mode (.clearPtr 0) = _ from rfl)]
      have ve : Function.update (Function.update v 7 0) 0 0 = dropValues h.length (tail := p) := by
        apply funext
        have fr := frame
        simp only [Fin.forall_fin_succ] at fr ⊢
        simp_all [v₂, Function.update_apply]
      rw [ve]
      exact AReach.refl _
    let vd := dropValues h.length (ptr := h.length) (tail := p)
    have bd : ∀ r, vd r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := bounds h.length 0 le_rfl (Nat.zero_le _)
    have cp : DropReach mode h (some (.copy 2 false), dropValues h.length (tail := p), none)
        (some .decode, vd, none) := by
      simpa [vd, dropCopy] using drop_copy_run mode h 2 (dropValues h.length (tail := p))
        (bounds 0 0 (Nat.zero_le _) (Nat.zero_le _)) (by simp [dropCopy])
    have vals : ∀ i ≤ tail.length, bitsVal (tail.drop i) ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := by
      intro i _
      have := query_accumulator_bound tail h.length i good.1 good.2
      omega
    have dread : ∀ i < tail.length,
        dropOracle 0 (pairEncode h (Nat.bits (vd 8 + i))) = tail.getD i false := by
      simpa only [vd, v₂, dropValues_apply, Matrix.cons_val_succ, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
        Nat.one_mul] using reads
    obtain ⟨vf, bf, ep, ea, et, ef, dec⟩ := boundedDecode_loop (dropARM mode) dropOracle h
      0 8 6 7 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      0 .decode .decodeDown .decodeRead (.copy 3 false)
      DropState.decodeCopy DropState.decodeCopyInc DropState.decodeClear
      DropState.decodeScale DropState.decodeTake DropState.decodeAdd dropDecodeAdvance
      rfl rfl rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)
      (fun _ => rfl)
      (by
        intro b i hi
        have hi01 : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
        rcases hi01 with rfl | rfl <;> rfl)
      (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) tail (4 * h.length + 4) vals tail.length le_rfl vd bd
      (by simpa [vd] using len) (by simp [vd, bitsVal]) (by simp [vd]) dread
    have endpoint : vf = dropValues h.length (ptr := p) (query := bitsVal tail) (tail := p) := by
      apply funext
      simp only [Fin.forall_fin_succ] at ef ⊢
      simp_all [vd]
    rw [endpoint] at dec
    exact (c₀.trans c₁).trans (scan'.trans (reset.trans (cp.trans dec)))
  · rw [if_neg good]
    have stop : DropReach mode h (some (.tailTest true), v₂, none)
        (some (.answer false), v, none) := by
      by_cases width : tail.length ≤ (Nat.bits h.length).length
      · have nc : ¬ Canon tail := fun hc => good ⟨hc, width⟩
        have flag : tail.getLastD true = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr (fun ht => nc ((drop_canon tail).mp ht))
        have ss := scan
        simp only [flag, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ite_self] at ss
        exact ss
      · simpa [v₂, width] using scan
    exact ((c₀.trans c₁).trans stop).halt (drop_ret mode false h v bv)

/-- Both lookup segments instantiate the same bounded indexing fragment. -/
private lemma drop_seek_run (mode suffix : Bool) (h : List Bool) (count : ℕ) (v : Fin 9 → ℕ)
    (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4)
    (hl : v (if suffix then 2 else 5) = v 0 + (if suffix then 2 else 4) * count)
    (hb : v 7 + count ≤ 4 * h.length + 4) (hq : v 7 ≤ v 6) :
    if v 6 < v 7 + count then
      DropReach mode h (some (.seek suffix), v, none)
        (some .hit, Function.update (Function.update v 0
          (v 0 + (if suffix then 2 else 4) * (v 6 - v 7))) 7 (v 6), none)
    else
      DropReach mode h (some (.seek suffix), v, none)
        (some (if suffix then .answer false else .clearPtr 4),
          Function.update (Function.update v 0 (v (if suffix then 2 else 5))) 7 (v 7 + count), none) := by
  apply indexedSeek_loop (dropARM mode) dropOracle h 0 (if suffix then 2 else 5) 7 6
    (by cases suffix <;> decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by cases suffix <;> decide) (by cases suffix <;> decide) (by decide)
    (.seek suffix) (.matchIndex suffix) (.nextIndex suffix) .hit
    (if suffix then .answer false else .clearPtr 4) (dropWalk suffix)
    (if suffix then 2 else 4) _ (by cases suffix <;> decide) rfl rfl rfl
  · intro i hi
    simp only [dropWalk, dif_pos hi, dropARM]
  · simp [dropWalk]
  · exact hv
  · exact hl
  · exact hb
  · exact hq

/-- The final lookup reads the kept prefix at stride four, then the retained suffix at
stride two. The discarded and retained fields have no canonicality hypothesis.

**Proof sketch.** The shared bounded seek either hits inside the kept prefix or reaches
its end. On a miss, relocate the pointer to the retained suffix and use the same seek
again. The frozen prefix/suffix address lemmas identify each hit with the output bit;
the end-of-suffix branch is precisely an out-of-range query. -/
private lemma drop_lookup (mode : Bool) (w b b' : List Bool) (q : ℕ) (v : Fin 9 → ℕ)
    (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ 4 * (pairEncode (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b') (Nat.bits q)).length + 4)
    (hp : v 0 = 0) (hk : v 5 = 4 * (2 * w.length + 2))
    (hs : v 3 = 4 * (pairEncode w b).length + 4)
    (he : v 2 = 4 * (pairEncode w b).length + 4 + 2 * b'.length)
    (hq : v 6 = q) (hi : v 7 = 0) :
    DropHalt mode (pairEncode (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b') (Nat.bits q))
      (some (.seek false), v, none)
      (if mode then decide (q < (dropIdx (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b')).length)
        else (dropIdx (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b')).getD q false) := by
  let h := pairEncode (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b') (Nat.bits q)
  change ∀ r, v r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 at hv
  let n := 2 * w.length + 2
  let out := dropIdx (pairEncode (pairEncode w b) b')
  have outlen : out.length = n + b'.length := by simp [out, n, dropIdx_pairEncode, length_pairEncode]
  have nb : n ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := by have := hv 5; change v 5 = 4 * n at hk; omega
  have total : n + b'.length ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := by simp only [h, n, length_pairEncode]; omega
  have first := drop_seek_run mode false h n v hv (by simpa [hp, n] using hk)
    (by simpa [hi] using nb) (by simp [hi])
  by_cases lt : q < n
  · have cond : v 6 < v 7 + n := by omega
    simp only [if_pos cond, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at first
    let vh := Function.update (Function.update v 0 (4 * q)) 7 q
    have run : DropReach mode h (some (.seek false), v, none) (some .hit, vh, none) := by
      simpa [hp, hq, hi, vh] using first
    have pos : 4 * q ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := by have := hv 5; change v 5 = 4 * n at hk; omega
    have bv : ∀ r, vh r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := register_update_le _ 7 _ q
      (register_update_le v 0 _ _ hv pos) (by simpa [hq] using hv 6)
    have bit := dropIdx_prefix_address w b b' (Nat.bits q) q lt
    have ans : (if mode then true else h.getD (vh 0) false) =
        (if mode then decide (q < out.length) else out.getD q false) := by
      have inside : q < out.length := by omega
      cases mode with
      | false =>
        change h.getD (4 * q) false = out.getD q false
        exact bit.symm
      | true => simp [inside]
    rw [← ans]
    exact run.halt (drop_hit mode h vh bv)
  · have cond : ¬ v 6 < v 7 + n := by omega
    simp only [if_neg cond, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at first
    let vm := Function.update (Function.update v 0 (v 5)) 7 n
    have run : DropReach mode h (some (.seek false), v, none) (some (.clearPtr 4), vm, none) := by
      simpa [hi, vm] using first
    have bm : ∀ r, vm r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := register_update_le _ 7 _ n
      (register_update_le v 0 _ _ hv (hv 5)) nb
    let vs := Function.update vm 0 (v 3)
    have bs : ∀ r, vs r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := register_update_le vm 0 _ _ bm (hv 3)
    have move : DropReach mode h (some (.clearPtr 4), vm, none) (some (.seek true), vs, none) := by
      apply AReach.step ⟨drop_preS mode h _, bm⟩
      simp only [astep_clr (show dropARM mode (.clearPtr 4) = _ from rfl)]
      have copy := drop_copy_run mode h 7 (Function.update vm 0 0)
        (register_update_le vm 0 _ 0 bm (by omega)) (by simp [dropCopy])
      simpa [dropCopy, vs, vm] using copy
    have vp : vs 0 = 4 * (pairEncode w b).length + 4 := by simp [vs, hs]
    have ve : vs 2 = 4 * (pairEncode w b).length + 4 + 2 * b'.length := by simp [vs, vm, he]
    have vi : vs 7 = n := by simp [vs, vm]
    have vq : vs 6 = q := by simp [vs, vm, hq]
    have second := drop_seek_run mode true h b'.length vs bs
      (by simpa [vp] using ve) (by simpa [vi] using total) (by rw [vi, vq]; omega)
    by_cases inrange : q < n + b'.length
    · have cond' : vs 6 < vs 7 + b'.length := by omega
      simp only [if_pos cond', ↓reduceIte] at second
      let addr := 4 * (pairEncode w b).length + 4 + 2 * (q - n)
      let vh := Function.update (Function.update vs 0 addr) 7 q
      have hit : DropReach mode h (some (.seek true), vs, none) (some .hit, vh, none) := by
        simpa [vp, vq, vi, addr, vh] using second
      have pos : addr ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := by have := hv 2; dsimp [addr]; omega
      have bh : ∀ r, vh r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := register_update_le _ 7 _ q
        (register_update_le vs 0 _ _ bs pos) (by simpa [hq] using hv 6)
      have jlt : q - n < b'.length := by omega
      have bit := dropIdx_suffix_address w b b' (Nat.bits q) (q - n) jlt
      have qeq : 2 * w.length + 2 + (q - n) = q := by dsimp [n] at *; omega
      rw [qeq] at bit
      have ans : (if mode then true else h.getD (vh 0) false) =
          (if mode then decide (q < out.length) else out.getD q false) := by
        have inside : q < out.length := by omega
        cases mode with
        | false =>
          change h.getD addr false = out.getD q false
          exact bit.symm
        | true => simp [inside]
      rw [← ans]
      exact (run.trans (move.trans hit)).halt (drop_hit mode h vh bh)
    · have cond' : ¬ vs 6 < vs 7 + b'.length := by omega
      simp only [if_neg cond', ↓reduceIte] at second
      let vf := Function.update (Function.update vs 0 (vs 2)) 7 (vs 7 + b'.length)
      have bf : ∀ r, vf r ≤ 4 * h.length + 4 := register_update_le _ 7 _ _
        (register_update_le vs 0 _ _ bs (bs 2)) (by rw [vi]; exact total)
      have bit : out.getD q false = false := by
        simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_none (show out.length ≤ q by omega)]
      have ans : (if mode then decide (q < out.length) else out.getD q false) = false := by
        cases mode with
        | false => exact bit
        | true => simp [show ¬ q < out.length by omega]
      rw [ans]
      exact (run.trans (move.trans second)).halt (drop_ret mode false h vf bf)

/-- Reading an even position in a paired first field removes one doubling. -/
private lemma drop_first_read (a b : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < a.length) :
    (pairEncode a b).getD (2 * i) false = a.getD i false := by
  rw [pairEncode_getD, if_pos (by omega)]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- A finite subtraction chain preserves the common register bound. The two nested-pair
preparations use this same argument for their physical separator widths. -/
private lemma drop_decrement_run (mode : Bool) (h : List Bool) (r : Fin 9) (count : ℕ)
    (path : ℕ → DropState) (v : Fin 9 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ j, v j ≤ 4 * h.length + 4)
    (steps : ∀ i < count, dropARM mode (path i) = .dec r (path (i + 1))) :
    DropReach mode h (some (path 0), v, none)
      (some (path count), Function.update v r (v r - count), none) := by
  induction count generalizing path v with
  | zero => simpa using AReach.refl (some (path 0), v, none)
  | succ count ih =>
    apply AReach.step ⟨drop_preS mode h _, hv⟩
    simp only [astep_dec (steps 0 (by omega))]
    have bound := register_update_le v r (4 * h.length + 4) (v r - 1) hv
      (by have := hv r; omega)
    have rest := ih (fun i => path (i + 1)) (Function.update v r (v r - 1)) bound
      (fun i hi => steps (i + 1) (by omega))
    simpa [Function.update_idem, Nat.sub_sub, Nat.add_comm] using rest
