import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.MARM
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARMCompile

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Compiling memory register machines

The compiled machine of a memory register machine `A` (`Complexity.LogProg.mcompileTM`) has
the work tapes of the compiled deterministic part `A.detPart false` (registers and decider
block) and one more tape, the memory. Away from the start states of memory instructions it
makes the step of the compiled deterministic part, leaving the memory tape alone
(`Complexity.LogProg.liftAct`); at those start states it makes one step on the memory tape.
The memory tape holds `1` as the symbol `true` and `0` as a blank, so the only symbol ever
written on it is `true`.

As for nondeterministic machines (`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARMCompile`),
no instruction-level simulation is redone: at a memory start state the compiled deterministic
part halts at once, so its runs that end live (or with the other answer) avoid those states,
and the compiled memory machine follows them (`Complexity.LogProg.mrunFrom_eq`).

This is infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1.1], not itself a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.liftAct`, `Complexity.LogProg.memCfg` — an extra, idle tape.
* `Complexity.LogProg.mcompileTM`, `Complexity.LogProg.mcompileFinTM` — the compiled machine.
* `Complexity.LogProg.mseam` — the compiled configuration of a memory machine configuration.
* `Complexity.LogProg.MBox` — head ranges of registers, deciders and memory.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.mdet_live`, `Complexity.LogProg.mdet_halt` — the register steps.
* `Complexity.LogProg.mmem_step` — a memory step is one compiled step.
* `Complexity.LogProg.mcompileTM_init` — the initial configuration.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

/-! ## An extra tape -/

section Lift

variable {K : ℕ} {St : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- The memory tape of memory bits: `true` at the `1`s, blank at the `0`s. -/
def memTape (M : ℤ → Bool) : ℤ → Option Bool := fun z => if M z then some true else none

/-- An action with one more work tape, left alone. -/
def liftAct (a : Action K Bool St) : Action (K + 1) Bool St :=
  ⟨a.inputTape, Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Option (Option Bool) × SignType) a.workTapes (none, 0),
    a.output, a.state⟩

/-- A configuration with one more work tape holding `M`, its head at `p`. -/
def memCfg (c : Cfg K Bool St x) (M : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ) : Cfg (K + 1) Bool St x :=
  ⟨c.state, c.inputPos, Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℤ → Option Bool) c.workTapes M,
    Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℤ) c.workTapePos p, c.output⟩

/-- The old tapes read as before. -/
@[simp] lemma memCfg_symbols_castSucc (c : Cfg K Bool St x) (M : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ)
    (i : Fin K) : (memCfg c M p).workTapeSymbols i.castSucc = c.workTapeSymbols i := by
  simp [memCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols]

/-- The extra tape reads its cell under the head. -/
@[simp] lemma memCfg_symbols_last (c : Cfg K Bool St x) (M : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ) :
    (memCfg c M p).workTapeSymbols (Fin.last K) = M p := by
  simp [memCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols]

/-- A lifted action acts on the old tapes and leaves the extra tape alone. -/
lemma liftAct_apply (a : Action K Bool St) (c : Cfg K Bool St x) (M : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ) :
    (liftAct a).apply (memCfg c M p) = memCfg (a.apply c) M p := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · funext i z
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [Action.apply, liftAct, memCfg]
    · simp only [Action.apply, liftAct, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  · funext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [Action.apply, liftAct, memCfg]
    · simp [Action.apply, liftAct, memCfg]

end Lift

/-! ## The compiled machine -/

section Construction

variable {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type}

/-- The memory instruction whose fragment starts at a compiled state (`none` elsewhere). -/
def mop (A : MARM m d Λ) : CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m → Option (MIns m d Λ)
  | .prog (l, ph) => if ph = .start ∧ (A l).isMem = true then some (A l) else none
  | _ => none

/-- A compiled state with a memory instruction is the start state of its fragment. -/
lemma mop_spec {A : MARM m d Λ} {q : CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m} {i : MIns m d Λ}
    (h : mop A q = some i) : ∃ l, q = .prog (l, .start) ∧ A l = i ∧ i.isMem = true := by
  match q, h with
  | .prog (l, ph), h =>
    simp only [mop] at h
    split_ifs at h with hph
    · obtain ⟨rfl, hm⟩ := hph
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
      subst h
      exact ⟨l, rfl, rfl, hm⟩

/-- The one-step action of a memory instruction, reading the memory symbol `r`. -/
def memAct {K : ℕ} (i : MIns m d Λ) (r : Option Bool) : Action (K + 1) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) :=
  match i with
  | .det _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩
  | .mread l₁ l₀ =>
    ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some (.prog ((if r = some true then l₁ else l₀), .start))⟩
  | .mset l =>
    ⟨0, Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (fun _ => (none, 0))
      (some (some true), 0), none, some (.prog (l, .start))⟩
  | .mleft l =>
    ⟨0, Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (fun _ => (none, 0)) (none, -1),
      none, some (.prog (l, .start))⟩
  | .mright l =>
    ⟨0, Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (fun _ => (none, 0)) (none, 1),
      none, some (.prog (l, .start))⟩

/-- **The compiled memory machine** of a memory register machine `A` with start label `l₀`,
calling the deciders `D` from the start states `q0 j`: at the start state of a memory
instruction one step on the memory tape (the last work tape), everywhere else the step of the
compiled deterministic part with the memory tape idle. -/
def mcompileTM (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) :
    MultiTapeTM (m + kD + 1) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) where
  q₀ := .prog (l₀, .start)
  tr q a w :=
    match mop A q with
    | some i => memAct i (w (Fin.last _))
    | none => liftAct (ctr (armProg (A.detPart false) l₀) D q0 q a (fun i => w i.castSucc))

/-- The compiled memory machine as a bundled finite machine. -/
def mcompileFinTM [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ] [Fintype SD] [DecidableEq SD]
    (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) : FinTM Bool where
  k := m + kD + 1
  State := CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m
  tm := mcompileTM A l₀ D q0

/-- The compiled deterministic part answering `β` at the memory labels. -/
abbrev detM (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (β : Bool) : MultiTapeTM (m + kD) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) :=
  compileTM (armProg (A.detPart β) l₀) (l₀, .start) D q0

/-- The call nodes of the compiled deterministic parts do not depend on the answer at the
memory labels. -/
lemma armProg_mdetPart_call (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (β β' : Bool) :
    (armProg (A.detPart β) l₀).call = (armProg (A.detPart β') l₀).call := by
  funext q
  obtain ⟨l, ph⟩ := q
  show insCall (A.detPart β l) ph = insCall (A.detPart β' l) ph
  cases hA : A l with
  | det i => rw [MARM.detPart_det hA, MARM.detPart_det hA]
  | _ =>
    rw [MARM.detPart_mem (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem]), MARM.detPart_mem (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem])]
    rfl

/-- Away from the memory start states, the compiled deterministic parts agree. -/
lemma detM_tr (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    {q : CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m} (hq : mop A q = none) (β : Bool) :
    (detM A l₀ D q0 β).tr q = (detM A l₀ D q0 false).tr q := by
  funext a w
  simp only [detM, compileTM]
  rw [ctr_congr D q0 q (armProg_mdetPart_call A l₀ β false) ?_]
  rintro ⟨l, ph⟩ rfl
  funext a' w'
  show insTr (A.detPart β l) l ph a' w' = insTr (A.detPart false l) l ph a' w'
  cases hA : A l with
  | det i => rw [MARM.detPart_det hA, MARM.detPart_det hA]
  | _ =>
    have hph : ph ≠ .start := by
      rintro rfl; simp [mop, hA, MIns.isMem] at hq
    rw [MARM.detPart_mem (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem]), MARM.detPart_mem (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem])]
    cases ph <;> first | exact absurd rfl hph | rfl

/-- **Away from the memory start states, the compiled memory machine makes the step of the
compiled deterministic part** (for either answer `β`), its memory tape idle. -/
lemma mcompileTM_step (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (β : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) x)
    (hc : ∀ q, c.state = some q → mop A q = none) (M : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ) :
    (mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).step (memCfg c M p) = memCfg ((detM A l₀ D q0 β).step c) M p := by
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  cases hs : c.state with
  | none => simp [memCfg, hs]
  | some q =>
    have hq := hc q hs
    have hst : (memCfg c M p).state = some q := by simp [memCfg, hs]
    rw [hst]
    simp only
    rw [detM_tr A l₀ D q0 hq β]
    have hsym : (fun i => (memCfg c M p).workTapeSymbols i.castSucc) = c.workTapeSymbols := by
      funext i; simp
    have hin : (memCfg c M p).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := rfl
    simp only [mcompileTM, hq, hsym, hin]
    exact liftAct_apply _ c M p

/-- **The compiled memory machine follows the compiled deterministic part** along its runs
that avoid the memory start states, its memory tape idle.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the time, by `mcompileTM_step`. -/
lemma mrunFrom_eq (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (β : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) x) (M : ℤ → Option Bool)
    (p : ℤ) (T : ℕ)
    (hX : ∀ t < T, ∀ q, ((detM A l₀ D q0 β).runFrom c t).state = some q → mop A q = none) :
    ∀ t ≤ T, (mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (memCfg c M p) t =
      memCfg ((detM A l₀ D q0 β).runFrom c t) M p := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => intro _; rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    intro ht
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega)]
    exact mcompileTM_step A l₀ D q0 β _ (hX t (by omega)) M p

/-- **At a memory start state the compiled deterministic part halts at once, writing `β`.** -/
lemma detM_step_mem (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (β : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) x)
    (q : CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) (hc : c.state = some q) (hq : mop A q ≠ none) :
    ((detM A l₀ D q0 β).step c).state = none ∧
      ((detM A l₀ D q0 β).step c).output = c.output ++ [β] := by
  obtain ⟨i, hq'⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hq
  obtain ⟨l, rfl, hA, hm⟩ := mop_spec hq'
  have hret : A.detPart β l = .ret β := MARM.detPart_mem (by rw [hA]; exact hm) β
  have hcall : (armProg (A.detPart β) l₀).call (l, .start) = none := by
    show insCall (A.detPart β l) .start = none
    rw [hret]; rfl
  have htr : ∀ a w, (armProg (A.detPart β) l₀).tm.tr (l, .start) a w = retAct β := by
    intro a w
    show insTr (A.detPart β l) l .start a w = retAct β
    rw [hret]; rfl
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  rw [hc]
  simp only [detM, compileTM, ctr, hcall, htr, retAct, Action.apply]
  exact ⟨rfl, by simp⟩

/-- The deterministic parts have the same preconditions. -/
lemma pre_mdetPart (A : MARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B : ℕ) {x : List Bool} (β β' : Bool)
    (a : AConf m Λ) :
    Pre (A.detPart β) oracle D q0 B x a ↔ Pre (A.detPart β') oracle D q0 B x a := by
  rcases a with ⟨_ | l, v, res⟩
  · exact Iff.rfl
  · cases hA : A l with
    | det i => simp only [Pre, MARM.detPart_det hA]
    | _ =>
      simp only [Pre, MARM.detPart_mem (A := A) (l := l) (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem])]

/-- At a register label the deterministic parts make the same step. -/
lemma astep_mdetPart {A : MARM m d Λ} {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i)
    (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) {x : List Bool} (β β' : Bool) (v : Fin m → ℕ)
    (res : Option Bool) :
    astep (A.detPart β) oracle x (some l, v, res) =
      astep (A.detPart β') oracle x (some l, v, res) := by
  simp only [astep, MARM.detPart_det hA]

/-- The compiled configuration of a memory machine configuration: the compiled program
configuration of the registers, and the memory tape. -/
def mseam (x : List Bool) (l : Λ) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool) :
    Cfg (m + kD + 1) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) x :=
  memCfg (seam (kD := kD) (SD := SD) (aseam x l v out)) (memTape M) p

/-- The initial configuration of the compiled memory machine is the compiled configuration of
the start label, all registers `0`, the memory blank with its head at `0`. -/
lemma mcompileTM_init (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (x : List Bool) :
    (mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).initCfg x = mseam x l₀ (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => false) 0 [] := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · funext i z
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [mseam, memCfg, memTape]
    · simp only [mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun k => ?_) j <;>
        simp [seam, aseam, Nat.zero_bits]
  · funext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [mseam, memCfg]
    · simp only [mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun k => ?_) j <;> simp [seam, aseam]

end Construction

/-! ## Simulating the steps -/

section Steps

variable {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- A compiled memory configuration with register heads in `[-1, W]`, decider heads in
`[-B, B]` and the memory head in `[-P, P]`. -/
def MBox {St : Type} (W B P : ℕ) (C : Cfg (m + kD + 1) Bool St x) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : Fin m, (-1 : ℤ) ≤ C.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r).castSucc ∧
    C.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r).castSucc ≤ W) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin kD, |C.workTapePos (Fin.natAdd m i).castSucc| ≤ B) ∧
  |C.workTapePos (Fin.last _)| ≤ P

/-- The compiled configuration of a memory machine configuration is in the box. -/
lemma mbox_mseam (W B P : ℕ) (l : Λ) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (hp : |p| ≤ P) :
    MBox (kD := kD) (St := CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) W B P (mseam x l v M p out) :=
  ⟨fun r => by simp only [mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; simp [seam, aseam],
    fun i => by simp only [mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; simp [seam],
    by simpa [mseam, memCfg] using hp⟩

/-- A lifted configuration is in the box when the original one has its register and decider
heads in range and the memory head is in range. -/
lemma mbox_memCfg {St : Type} (W B P : ℕ) (c : Cfg (m + kD) Bool St x) (M : ℤ → Option Bool)
    (p : ℤ) (h1 : ∀ r : Fin m, (-1 : ℤ) ≤ c.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r) ∧
      c.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r) ≤ W)
    (h2 : ∀ i : Fin kD, |c.workTapePos (Fin.natAdd m i)| ≤ B) (hp : |p| ≤ P) :
    MBox W B P (memCfg c M p) :=
  ⟨fun r => by simp only [memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact h1 r,
    fun i => by simp only [memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact h2 i,
    by simpa [memCfg] using hp⟩

/-- **A live register step.** If, at a register label, the deterministic part steps from
`(l, v)` to the live `(l', v')`, with the preconditions and register widths of `arm_step`,
then the compiled memory machine goes from the compiled configuration of `(l, v)` to that of
`(l', v')`, the memory unchanged, in the box.

**Proof sketch.** `arm_step` and `compile_correct_from` give a run of the compiled
deterministic part reaching the seam of `(l', v')`, in range. It ends live, so it avoids the
memory start states (`avoid_of_live`, `detM_step_mem`), and the compiled memory machine
follows it (`mrunFrom_eq`). -/
theorem mdet_live (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B W P : ℕ) (l l' : Λ) (v v' : Fin m → ℕ)
    (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (hs : astep (A.detPart false) oracle x (some l, v, none) = (some l', v', none))
    (hp : Pre (A.detPart false) oracle D q0 B x (some l, v, none))
    (hw : ∀ r, ((Nat.bits (v r + 1)).length : ℤ) ≤ W) (hP : |p| ≤ P) :
    ∃ S, (mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) S = mseam x l' v' M p out ∧
      ∀ t ≤ S, MBox W B P ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) t) := by
  obtain ⟨T, e, hinv⟩ := arm_step (A.detPart false) l₀ oracle D q0 B W l l' v v' out hs hp hw
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hb⟩ := compile_correct_from (armProg (A.detPart false) l₀) (l₀, .start) D q0
    oracle (fun _ => -1) (fun _ => (W : ℤ)) B (aseam x l v out) T
    (fun t ht r => by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T with h | h
      · exact (hinv t h).1 r
      · obtain rfl : t = T := by omega
        rw [e]; simp [aseam])
    (fun t ht => (hinv t ht).2)
  have hX := avoid_of_live (detM A l₀ D q0 false) (fun q => mop A q ≠ none)
    (fun c q hc hq => (detM_step_mem A l₀ D q0 false c q hc hq).1)
    (seam (aseam x l v out)) S (by rw [hS, e]; simp [seam, aseam])
  have hag := mrunFrom_eq A l₀ D q0 false (seam (aseam x l v out)) (memTape M) p S
    (fun t ht q hq => not_not.mp (hX t ht q hq))
  refine ⟨S, ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  · rw [mseam, hag S le_rfl, hS, e]; rfl
  · rw [mseam, hag t ht]
    exact mbox_memCfg W B P _ _ p (hb t ht).1 (hb t ht).2 hP

/-- **A halting register step.** If, at a register label, the deterministic part halts from
`(l, v)` with answer `b₀`, with the preconditions and register widths of `arm_run`, then the
compiled memory machine halts from the compiled configuration of `(l, v)` with output
`out ++ [b₀]`, in the box.

**Proof sketch.** As `mdet_live`, with `arm_run` (one step) for the deterministic part
answering `!b₀` at the memory labels: its run ends with answer `b₀ ≠ !b₀`, so it avoids the
memory start states (`avoid_of_halt`). -/
theorem mdet_halt (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B W P : ℕ) (l : Λ) {i : Ins m d Λ}
    (hA : A l = .det i) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool) (b₀ : Bool)
    (hs : astep (A.detPart false) oracle x (some l, v, none) = (none, v, some b₀))
    (hp : Pre (A.detPart false) oracle D q0 B x (some l, v, none))
    (hw : ∀ r, ((Nat.bits (v r + 1)).length : ℤ) ≤ W) (hP : |p| ≤ P) :
    ∃ S, ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) S).state = none ∧
      ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) S).output = out ++ [b₀] ∧
      ∀ t ≤ S, MBox W B P ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) t) := by
  have hs' : astep (A.detPart (!b₀)) oracle x (some l, v, none) = (none, v, some b₀) := by
    rw [astep_mdetPart hA oracle (!b₀) false]; exact hs
  obtain ⟨T, e1, e2, e3, hinv⟩ := arm_run (x := x) (A.detPart (!b₀)) l₀ oracle D q0 B W 1 l v out
    b₀ (by simp [arun, hs']) (by simp [arun, hs'])
    (fun t ht => by
      obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      exact ⟨(pre_mdetPart A oracle D q0 B false (!b₀) _).1 hp, hw⟩)
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hb⟩ := compile_correct_from (armProg (A.detPart (!b₀)) l₀) (l₀, .start) D q0
    oracle (fun _ => -1) (fun _ => (W : ℤ)) B (aseam x l v out) T
    (fun t ht r => by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T with h | h
      · exact (hinv t h).1 r
      · obtain rfl : t = T := by omega
        exact e3 r)
    (fun t ht => (hinv t ht).2)
  have hX := avoid_of_halt (detM A l₀ D q0 (!b₀)) (fun q => mop A q ≠ none) (!b₀)
    (fun c q hc hq => detM_step_mem A l₀ D q0 (!b₀) c q hc hq)
    (seam (aseam x l v out)) S b₀ (by rw [hS]; exact e2) (by cases b₀ <;> simp)
  have hag := mrunFrom_eq A l₀ D q0 (!b₀) (seam (aseam x l v out)) (memTape M) p S
    (fun t ht q hq => not_not.mp (hX t ht q hq))
  refine ⟨S, ?_, ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  · rw [mseam, hag S le_rfl, hS]
    exact seam_state_none (kD := kD) (SD := SD) _ e1
  · rw [mseam, hag S le_rfl, hS]
    exact e2
  · rw [mseam, hag t ht]
    exact mbox_memCfg W B P _ _ p (hb t ht).1 (hb t ht).2 hP

/-- **A memory step is one compiled step**: at a memory label, the compiled memory machine
goes in one step from the compiled configuration of a configuration to that of its successor.

**Proof sketch.** At the start state of a memory instruction the compiled transition is
`memAct`: it reads the memory cell under the head, moves only the memory head or writes `true`
under it, and goes to the target label. Compare the components of the two configurations
(`Fin.lastCases` on the tapes: the old tapes are untouched). -/
lemma mmem_step (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) {l : Λ} (hA : (A l).isMem = true)
    (v : Fin m → ℕ) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool) :
    ∃ l' M' p', mstep A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) = ((some l', v, none), (M', p')) ∧
      (mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).step (mseam x l v M p out) = mseam x l' v M' p' out := by
  have hst : (mseam (kD := kD) (SD := SD) x l v M p out).state = some (.prog (l, .start)) := rfl
  have hmop : mop (SD := SD) A (.prog (l, .start)) = some (A l) := by simp [mop, hA]
  have hlast : (mseam (kD := kD) (SD := SD) x l v M p out).workTapeSymbols (Fin.last _) =
      memTape M p := by simp [mseam]
  have key : ∀ (l' : Λ) (M' : ℤ → Bool) (p' : ℤ)
      (a : Action (m + kD + 1) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m)),
      a.inputTape = 0 → a.output = none → a.state = some (.prog (l', .start)) →
      (∀ j : Fin (m + kD), a.workTapes j.castSucc = (none, 0)) →
      ((a.workTapes (Fin.last _)).1 = none ∧ M' = M ∨
        (a.workTapes (Fin.last _)).1 = some (some true) ∧ M' = Function.update M p true) →
      p + ((a.workTapes (Fin.last _)).2 : ℤ) = p' →
      a.apply (mseam x l v M p out) = mseam x l' v M' p' out := by
    intro l' M' p' a h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp [Action.apply, h3, mseam, memCfg, seam, aseam]
    · simp [Action.apply, h1, mseam, memCfg, seam, aseam]
    · funext i z
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simp only [Action.apply, mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_last]
        rcases h5 with ⟨hw, rfl⟩ | ⟨hw, rfl⟩
        · simp only [hw]
        · simp only [hw]
          by_cases hz : z = p
          · subst hz; simp [memTape]
          · simp [memTape, Function.update_of_ne hz]
      · simp only [Action.apply, h4 j, mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; rfl
    · funext i
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simp only [Action.apply, mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_last]
        exact h6
      · simp only [Action.apply, h4 j, mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; simp; rfl
    · simp [Action.apply, h2, mseam, memCfg, seam, aseam]
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  rw [hst]
  simp only [mcompileTM, hmop, hlast]
  cases hA' : A l with
  | det i => rw [hA'] at hA; simp [MIns.isMem] at hA
  | mread l₁ l₀' =>
    refine ⟨if M p then l₁ else l₀', M, p, by simp [mstep, hA'], key _ M p _ rfl rfl ?_
      (fun j => rfl) (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) (by simp [memAct])⟩
    by_cases hM : M p <;> simp [memAct, memTape, hM]
  | mset l' =>
    refine ⟨l', Function.update M p true, p, by simp [mstep, hA'], key _ _ p _ rfl rfl rfl
      (fun j => by simp [memAct]) (Or.inr ⟨by simp [memAct], rfl⟩) (by simp [memAct])⟩
  | mleft l' =>
    refine ⟨l', M, p - 1, by simp [mstep, hA'], key _ M _ _ rfl rfl rfl
      (fun j => by simp [memAct]) (Or.inl ⟨by simp [memAct], rfl⟩) (by simp [memAct]; ring)⟩
  | mright l' =>
    refine ⟨l', M, p + 1, by simp [mstep, hA'], key _ M _ _ rfl rfl rfl
      (fun j => by simp [memAct]) (Or.inl ⟨by simp [memAct], rfl⟩) (by simp [memAct])⟩

end Steps

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.MARMCompile
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.DTIME
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Memory register machines decide in exponential time

The run theorem for memory register machines (`Complexity.LogProg.marm_run`): if the
abstract machine answers `b`, its registers of at most `W` binary digits and its memory head
in `[-P, P]`, then the compiled machine (`Complexity.LogProg.mcompileTM`) answers `b`, every
head staying in its range. The time bound is then a configuration count
(`Complexity.LogProg.runFrom_count_eq`), as for space-bounded machines
([AB09, §4.1.1, proof of Theorem 4.2]): a halting deterministic run never repeats a
configuration. The memory tape is not small, but it only grows — its only symbol is `true`,
and `true` is never overwritten — so along the run its contents are determined by its number
of `true` cells: two configurations of the run with the same small tapes, the same heads
and the same number of memory `1`s are equal. Hence the time is at most
`2 ^ O(W + log n) · P²` (`Complexity.LogProg.marm_dtime`), whatever the number of abstract
steps.

This is infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1.1, Theorem 4.2], not itself a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.MGuard` — the guard of the run theorem.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.marm_run` — the run theorem.
* `Complexity.LogProg.runFrom_count_eq` — a run whose last tape only grows, with heads in
  bounded ranges, halts within the count of its configurations.
* `Complexity.LogProg.marm_dtime` — a correct memory register machine calling logspace
  deciders runs in time `2 ^ O(W + log n) · (P + 1)²`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1, Claim 4.4, Theorem 4.2.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

/-! ## The run theorem -/

section Run

variable {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- The guard of the run theorem: the preconditions of the step (`Pre` of the deterministic
part), register values of at most `W` binary digits (counting one increment), and the memory
head in `[-P, P]`. -/
def MGuard (A : MARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD)
    (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B W P : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (c : MConf m Λ) : Prop :=
  Pre (A.detPart false) oracle D q0 B x c.1 ∧
    (∀ r, ((Nat.bits (c.1.2.1 r + 1)).length : ℤ) ≤ W) ∧ |c.2.2| ≤ P

/-- **The run theorem for memory register machines.** If, from `(l, v)` with memory `(M, p)`,
the abstract machine halts after `N` steps with answer `b`, every configuration before
satisfying `MGuard`, then the compiled machine, from the compiled configuration having written
`out`, halts with output `out ++ [b]`, staying in the box (`MBox`).

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `N`. A register step is `mdet_live` or `mdet_halt`; a memory
step is one compiled step (`mmem_step`). The runs are concatenated
(`runFrom_forall_append`). -/
theorem marm_run (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B W P : ℕ) :
    ∀ (N : ℕ) (l : Λ) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool) (b : Bool),
      (mrun A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) N).1.1 = none →
      (mrun A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) N).1.2.2 = some b →
      (∀ t < N, MGuard A oracle D q0 B W P x (mrun A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) t)) →
      ∃ T, ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) T).state = none ∧
        ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) T).output = out ++ [b] ∧
        ∀ t ≤ T, MBox W B P ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) t) := by
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero => intro l v M p out b h1; simp [mrun] at h1
  | succ N ih =>
    intro l v M p out b h1 h2 hg
    obtain ⟨hp, hw, hP⟩ := hg 0 (by omega)
    simp only [mrun, Function.iterate_zero, id] at hp hw hP
    rw [mrun_succ] at h1 h2
    have hg' : ∀ c', mstep A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) = c' →
        ∀ t < N, MGuard A oracle D q0 B W P x (mrun A oracle x c' t) := by
      intro c' hc t ht
      have := hg (t + 1) (by omega)
      rwa [mrun_succ, hc] at this
    -- a segment to a compiled configuration followed by a halting run
    have compose : ∀ (S : ℕ) (C' : Cfg (m + kD + 1) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) x),
        (mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) S = C' →
        (∀ t ≤ S, MBox W B P ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) t)) →
        (∃ T', ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom C' T').state = none ∧
          ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom C' T').output = out ++ [b] ∧
          ∀ t ≤ T', MBox W B P ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom C' t)) →
        ∃ T, ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) T).state = none ∧
          ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) T).output = out ++ [b] ∧
          ∀ t ≤ T, MBox W B P ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) t) := by
      rintro S C' hS hbS ⟨T', e1, e2, e3⟩
      refine ⟨S + T', by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hS]; exact e1,
        by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hS]; exact e2, runFrom_forall_append hbS ?_⟩
      rw [hS]; exact e3
    cases hA : A l with
    | det i =>
      rcases astep_cases (x := x) (A.detPart false) oracle l v none with ⟨l', v', hs⟩ | ⟨b₀, hs⟩
      · have hm : mstep A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) = ((some l', v', none), (M, p)) := by
          rw [mstep_det hA false, hs]
        rw [hm] at h1 h2
        obtain ⟨S, hS, hbS⟩ := mdet_live A l₀ oracle D q0 B W P l l' v v' M p out hs hp hw hP
        exact compose S _ hS hbS (ih l' v' M p out b h1 h2 (hg' _ hm))
      · have hm : mstep A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) = ((none, v, some b₀), (M, p)) := by
          rw [mstep_det hA false, hs]
        rw [hm, mrun_halted] at h2
        simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h2
        subst h2
        exact mdet_halt A l₀ oracle D q0 B W P l hA v M p out b₀ hs hp hw hP
    | _ =>
      obtain ⟨l', M', p', hm, hstep⟩ := mmem_step A l₀ oracle D q0 (x := x) (l := l)
        (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem]) v M p out
      rw [hm] at h1 h2
      refine compose 1 _ (by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one,
        hstep]) (fun t ht => ?_) (ih l' v M' p' out b h1 h2 (hg' _ hm))
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 1 with h | h
      · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
        exact mbox_mseam W B P l v M p out hP
      · obtain rfl : t = 1 := by omega
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one, hstep]
        cases N with
        | zero => simp [mrun] at h1
        | succ N =>
          exact mbox_mseam W B P l' v M' p' out (hg' _ hm 0 (by omega)).2.2

end Run

/-! ## Counting configurations with a growing tape -/

section Count

variable {K : ℕ} {St : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- A machine whose transitions write on the last tape only `true` (or nothing) changes each
cell of that tape at most into `true`. -/
lemma step_last_cell (tm : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool St)
    (hwrite : ∀ q a w, ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = none ∨
      ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = some (some true))
    (c : Cfg (K + 1) Bool St x) (z : ℤ) :
    (tm.step c).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = c.workTapes (Fin.last K) z ∨
      (tm.step c).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true := by
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  cases hs : c.state with
  | none => exact Or.inl rfl
  | some q =>
    simp only [Action.apply]
    rcases hwrite q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols with h | h
    · left; simp only [h]
    · simp only [h]
      by_cases hz : z = c.workTapePos (Fin.last K)
      · subst hz; right; simp
      · left; simp [Function.update_of_ne hz]

/-- Along a run from initialization, the last tape holds only blanks and `true`s, and a
`true` stays.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the time, by `step_last_cell`. -/
lemma last_tape_run (tm : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool St)
    (hwrite : ∀ q a w, ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = none ∨
      ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = some (some true)) :
    (∀ t z, (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = none ∨
      (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true) ∧
    ∀ t t', t ≤ t' → ∀ z, (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true →
      (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t').workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true := by
  refine ⟨fun t => ?_, fun t t' htt' z hz => ?_⟩
  · induction t with
    | zero => intro z; left; rfl
    | succ t ih =>
      intro z
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
      rcases step_last_cell tm hwrite (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t) z with h | h
      · rw [h]; exact ih z
      · exact Or.inr h
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, t' = t + k := ⟨t' - t, by omega⟩
    induction k with
    | zero => exact hz
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
      rcases step_last_cell tm hwrite (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) (t + k)) z with h | h
      · rw [h]; exact ih (by omega)
      · exact h

open MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount in
/-- **A run whose last tape only grows halts within its configuration count.** If the
transitions of `tm` write on the last tape only `true`, and the run from initialization has
halted by time `T` with every head of the other tapes in `[-B, B]` and the head of the last
tape in `[-P, P]` up to then, then the run is already at its final configuration at time
`(|St| + 1) (n + 2) 3 ^ (K (2B + 1)) (2B + 1) ^ K (2P + 1) (2P + 2)`.

**Proof sketch.** Before the first halting time no core repeats (`core_injOn`). Code a
configuration by its state, input position, the other tapes on `[-B, B]`, the heads, and the
number of `true` cells of the last tape in `[-P, P]`; nonblank cells lie in the head ranges
(`mem_visited_of_ne_none`). Along the run the last tape only grows (`last_tape_run`), so of
two times, the earlier tape is contained in the later; with equal counts they are equal. So
the code is injective before the halting time, which is therefore at most the number of
codes. -/
theorem runFrom_count_eq [Fintype St] (tm : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool St) (B P T : ℕ)
    (hwrite : ∀ q a w, ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = none ∨
      ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = some (some true))
    (hT : (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) T).state = none)
    (hbox : ∀ t ≤ T, (∀ i : Fin K, |(tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos i.castSucc| ≤ B) ∧
      |(tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos (Fin.last K)| ≤ P) :
    tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) ((Fintype.card St + 1) * (x.length + 2) * 3 ^ (K * (2 * B + 1)) *
      (2 * B + 1) ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2))) = tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) T := by
  classical
  set run := fun t => tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t with hrun
  obtain ⟨T₀, hT0T, hmin, hfirst⟩ :=
    MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt tm (tm.initCfg x) hT
  have hT0 : (run T₀).state = none := (congrArg Cfg.state hfirst).trans hT
  obtain ⟨hcells, hmono⟩ := last_tape_run (x := x) tm hwrite
  -- nonblank cells lie in the head ranges
  have hwin : ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ (i : Fin (K + 1)) (z : ℤ), (run t).workTapes i z ≠ none →
      ∃ t' ≤ t, (run t').workTapePos i = z := by
    intro t ht i z hz
    have := MultiTapeTM.mem_visited_of_ne_none tm x t i z hz
    exact (MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff (tm := tm) (tm.initCfg x) t i z).mp this
  have hwinS : ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ (i : Fin K) (z : ℤ), (run t).workTapes i.castSucc z ≠ none →
      |z| ≤ B := by
    intro t ht i z hz
    obtain ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩ := hwin t ht _ z hz
    exact (hbox t' (by omega)).1 i
  have hwinL : ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ z : ℤ, (run t).workTapes (Fin.last K) z ≠ none → |z| ≤ P := by
    intro t ht z hz
    obtain ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩ := hwin t ht _ z hz
    exact (hbox t' (by omega)).2
  -- the code
  let cnt : ℕ → Finset ℤ := fun t =>
    (Finset.Icc (-(P : ℤ)) P).filter fun z => (run t).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true
  have hcnt : ∀ t, (cnt t).card ≤ 2 * P + 1 := by
    intro t
    refine (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
  let code : ℕ → Option St × Fin (x.length + 2) × (Fin K → Fin (2 * B + 1) → Option Bool) ×
      (Fin K → Fin (2 * B + 1)) × Fin (2 * P + 1) × Fin (2 * P + 2) := fun t =>
    ((run t).state, (run t).inputPos,
      fun i j => (run t).workTapes i.castSucc ((j : ℤ) - B),
      fun i => posCode B ((run t).workTapePos i.castSucc),
      posCode P ((run t).workTapePos (Fin.last K)),
      ⟨(cnt t).card, by have := hcnt t; omega⟩)
  -- equal codes at two times give equal cores
  have hcore : ∀ a b, a ≤ b → b ≤ T → code a = code b → core (run a) = core (run b) := by
    intro a b hab hb h
    simp only [code, Prod.mk.injEq, Fin.mk.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨hs, hi, hw, hp, hpl, hc⟩ := h
    simp only [core_eq, Prod.mk.injEq]
    refine ⟨hs, hi, ?_, ?_⟩
    · funext i z
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · -- the memory tape
        have hsub : cnt a ⊆ cnt b := by
          intro z hz
          simp only [cnt, Finset.mem_filter] at hz ⊢
          exact ⟨hz.1, hmono a b hab z hz.2⟩
        have heq : cnt a = cnt b := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (le_of_eq hc.symm)
        by_cases hz : |z| ≤ P
        · have hzI : z ∈ Finset.Icc (-(P : ℤ)) P := by
            rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; rw [abs_le] at hz; exact hz
          have hiff : (run a).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true ↔
              (run b).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true := by
            have := congrArg (fun s => z ∈ s) heq
            simpa [cnt, hzI] using this
          rcases hcells a z with ha | ha <;> rcases hcells b z with hb' | hb'
          · rw [ha, hb']
          · exact absurd (hiff.mpr hb') (by rw [ha]; simp)
          · exact absurd (hiff.mp ha) (by rw [hb']; simp)
          · rw [ha, hb']
        · have h1 : (run a).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = none := by
            by_contra hne; exact hz (hwinL a (by omega) z hne)
          have h2 : (run b).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = none := by
            by_contra hne; exact hz (hwinL b hb z hne)
          rw [h1, h2]
      · by_cases hz : |z| ≤ B
        · have := congrFun (congrFun hw j) ⟨(z + B).toNat, by rw [abs_le] at hz; omega⟩
          simp only at this
          rwa [show (((z + B).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) - B = z by rw [abs_le] at hz; omega] at this
        · have h1 : (run a).workTapes j.castSucc z = none := by
            by_contra hne; exact hz (hwinS a (by omega) j z hne)
          have h2 : (run b).workTapes j.castSucc z = none := by
            by_contra hne; exact hz (hwinS b hb j z hne)
          rw [h1, h2]
    · funext i
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · exact posCode_injOn P (hbox a (by omega)).2 (hbox b hb).2 hpl
      · exact posCode_injOn B ((hbox a (by omega)).1 j) ((hbox b hb).1 j) (congrFun hp j)
  have hinj : Set.InjOn code (Finset.range T₀ : Set ℕ) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio] at ha hb
    by_contra hne
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h' | h'
    · exact core_injOn tm _ T₀ hT0 hmin h' hb (hcore a b h'.le (by omega) hab)
    · exact core_injOn tm _ T₀ hT0 hmin h' ha (hcore b a h'.le (by omega) hab.symm)
  have hcard : T₀ ≤ (Fintype.card St + 1) * (x.length + 2) * 3 ^ (K * (2 * B + 1)) *
      (2 * B + 1) ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2)) := by
    have := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn code (fun a _ => Finset.mem_univ _) hinj
    simp only [Finset.card_range, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_option,
      Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_pi, Finset.prod_const, Fintype.card_bool] at this
    refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm (2 * B + 1) K]
    ring
  calc
    tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) ((Fintype.card St + 1) * (x.length + 2) * 3 ^ (K * (2 * B + 1)) *
        (2 * B + 1) ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2))) = tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) T₀ := by
      rw [show (Fintype.card St + 1) * (x.length + 2) * 3 ^ (K * (2 * B + 1)) *
          (2 * B + 1) ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2)) =
          T₀ + ((Fintype.card St + 1) * (x.length + 2) * 3 ^ (K * (2 * B + 1)) *
          (2 * B + 1) ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2)) - T₀) by omega,
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt _ hT0]
    _ = tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) T := hfirst

end Count

/-! ## From memory register machines to deterministic time -/

section Bridge

/-- The configuration count of `runFrom_count_eq` for the compiled machine, in exponential
form. Here `q + 1` bounds the states, `K` is the number of small tapes, the register heads lie
in `[-1, W]` and the decider heads in `[-B, B]` with `B` the logspace range of the virtual
inputs (`length_callSegs_le`).

**Proof sketch.** The virtual input length `y = 2n + 2 + m (2W + 2)` is below
`2 ^ (logSpace n + W + m + 3)`, so `logSpace y ≤ logSpace n + W + m + 3` and the small-tape
range is at most `(cs + 1) (m + 3) u` with `u = W + logSpace n + 1`. Bound `3 ≤ 2 ^ 2`,
`X ≤ 2 ^ X`, `n + 2 ≤ 2 ^ (logSpace n + 1)` and `(2P + 1) (2P + 2) ≤ 4 (P + 1) ^ 2`, and
collect the exponents. -/
private lemma count_bound (q n K W cs m P : ℕ) :
    (q + 1) * (n + 2) *
        3 ^ (K * (2 * (W + 1 + (cs * logSpace (2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * W + 2)) + 1)) + 1)) *
        (2 * (W + 1 + (cs * logSpace (2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * W + 2)) + 1)) + 1) ^ K *
        ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2)) ≤
      2 ^ ((q + 4 + 3 * K * (2 * ((cs + 1) * (m + 3)) + 1)) * (W + logSpace n + 1)) *
        (P + 1) ^ 2 := by
  set L := logSpace n with hL
  set y := 2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * W + 2) with hy
  have hn : n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ L := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide : 1 < 2) n
  have hW : W + 1 ≤ 2 ^ W := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := W)
  have hm : m + 1 ≤ 2 ^ m := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := m)
  have hL1 : 1 ≤ L := by simp [hL, logSpace]
  -- the logarithm of the virtual input length
  have hylog : logSpace y ≤ L + W + m + 3 := by
    have h1 : y ≤ 4 * ((n + 1) * (W + 1) * (m + 1)) := by
      have a1 : n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) * (W + 1) * (m + 1) := by
        calc n + 1 = (n + 1) * 1 * 1 := by ring
          _ ≤ (n + 1) * (W + 1) * (m + 1) := by gcongr <;> omega
      have a2 : m * (W + 1) ≤ (n + 1) * (W + 1) * (m + 1) := by
        calc m * (W + 1) = 1 * (W + 1) * m := by ring
          _ ≤ (n + 1) * (W + 1) * (m + 1) := by gcongr <;> omega
      have e : y = 2 * (n + 1) + 2 * (m * (W + 1)) := by simp only [hy]; ring
      omega
    have h2 : (n + 1) * (W + 1) * (m + 1) ≤ 2 ^ L * 2 ^ W * 2 ^ m := by gcongr
    have h3 : y < 2 ^ (L + W + m + 3) := by
      have : 2 ^ (L + W + m + 3) = 8 * (2 ^ L * 2 ^ W * 2 ^ m) := by
        rw [pow_add, pow_add, pow_add]; ring
      have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ L * 2 ^ W * 2 ^ m :=
        Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.two_pow_pos L) (Nat.two_pow_pos W)) (Nat.two_pow_pos m)
      omega
    have h4 := Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (b := 2) (by omega : y ≠ 0) h3
    simp only [logSpace]
    omega
  -- the small-tape range
  set E := (cs + 1) * (m + 3) with hE
  set u := W + L + 1 with hu
  have hu1 : 1 ≤ u := by omega
  have hB : W + 1 + (cs * logSpace y + 1) ≤ E * u := by
    have h1 : cs * logSpace y ≤ cs * (L + W + m + 3) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hylog
    have h2 : L + W + m + 3 ≤ (m + 3) * u := by
      have : (m + 3) * u = u + (m + 2) * u := by ring
      have : m + 2 ≤ (m + 2) * u := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hu1
      omega
    have h3 : (cs + 1) * (L + W + m + 3) ≤ E * u := by
      rw [hE, mul_assoc]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h2
    have : (cs + 1) * (L + W + m + 3) = cs * (L + W + m + 3) + (L + W + m + 3) := by ring
    omega
  set X := 2 * (W + 1 + (cs * logSpace y + 1)) + 1 with hX
  have hXu : X ≤ (2 * E + 1) * u := by
    have : (2 * E + 1) * u = 2 * (E * u) + u := by ring
    omega
  -- the factors
  have f1 : q + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (q + 1) := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := q + 1)).le
  have f2 : n + 2 ≤ 2 ^ (L + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := L); omega
  have f3 : 3 ^ (K * X) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * (K * X)) := by
    calc 3 ^ (K * X) ≤ (2 ^ 2) ^ (K * X) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by decide) _
      _ = 2 ^ (2 * (K * X)) := (pow_mul 2 2 _).symm
  have f4 : X ^ K ≤ 2 ^ (X * K) := by
    rw [pow_mul]; exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := X)).le _
  have f5 : (2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2) ≤ 2 ^ 2 * (P + 1) ^ 2 :=
    calc (2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2) ≤ (2 * P + 2) * (2 * P + 2) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
      _ = 2 ^ 2 * (P + 1) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hexp : (q + 1) + (L + 1) + 2 * (K * X) + X * K + 2 ≤
      (q + 4 + 3 * K * (2 * E + 1)) * u := by
    have g1 : 3 * (K * X) ≤ 3 * K * ((2 * E + 1) * u) := by
      rw [mul_assoc]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hXu)
    have g2 : (q + 4) + L ≤ (q + 4) * u := by
      have g2a : L ≤ (q + 4) * L := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left L (by omega)
      have g2b : (q + 4) * (L + 1) ≤ (q + 4) * u := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
      have g2c : (q + 4) * (L + 1) = (q + 4) * L + (q + 4) := by ring
      omega
    have e : (q + 4 + 3 * K * (2 * E + 1)) * u = (q + 4) * u + 3 * K * ((2 * E + 1) * u) := by
      ring
    have e2 : X * K = K * X := Nat.mul_comm _ _
    omega
  calc (q + 1) * (n + 2) * 3 ^ (K * X) * X ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2))
      ≤ 2 ^ (q + 1) * 2 ^ (L + 1) * 2 ^ (2 * (K * X)) * 2 ^ (X * K) *
          (2 ^ 2 * (P + 1) ^ 2) := by gcongr
    _ = 2 ^ ((q + 1) + (L + 1) + 2 * (K * X) + X * K + 2) * (P + 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [pow_add, pow_add, pow_add, pow_add]; ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ ((q + 4 + 3 * K * (2 * E + 1)) * u) * (P + 1) ^ 2 :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hexp)

variable {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type}

/-- **Memory register machines decide in exponential time.** If, on every input `x`, the
memory register machine `A` (calling deciders for languages in `L`), started at `l₀` with all
registers `0` and a blank memory, answers `x ∈ L` through configurations meeting the syntactic
preconditions, with register values of at most `W |x|` binary digits (counting one increment)
and the memory head in `[-P |x|, P |x|]`, then some machine decides `L` on every input `x`
within `2 ^ (C (W |x| + logSpace |x| + 1)) · (P |x| + 1)²` steps.

**Proof sketch.** As for `arm_decides`: the deciders are collected in a clean bank
(`bank_cleanRun`), whose head ranges on the virtual inputs (of length at most
`2|x| + 2 + m (2W + 2)`, `length_callSegs_le`) are logarithmic. `marm_run` gives a halting
compiled run in the box, and `runFrom_count_eq` (the compiled machine writes only `true` on its
memory tape) bounds its halting time by the configuration count, which `count_bound` puts in
exponential form. -/
theorem marm_dtime {L : Language Bool} [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ] (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ)
    (As : Fin d → Language Bool) (hAs : ∀ j, As j ∈ LOGSPACE) (W P : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hcorr : ∀ x, MHalt A (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) x
      (fun c => PreS (A.detPart false) x c.1 ∧
        (∀ r, (Nat.bits (c.1.2.1 r + 1)).length ≤ W x.length) ∧ |c.2.2| ≤ (P x.length : ℤ))
      ((some l₀, fun _ => 0, none), (fun _ => false, 0))
      (MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x)) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (C : ℕ), ∀ x, M.ComputesInTime x
      [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x]
      (2 ^ (C * (W x.length + logSpace x.length + 1)) * (P x.length + 1) ^ 2) := by
  classical
  have hc : ∀ j, ∃ (c : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool), M.DecidesInSpace (As j) fun n => c * logSpace n :=
    fun j => hAs j
  let c : Fin d → ℕ := fun j => Classical.choose (hc j)
  let Ms : Fin d → FinTM Bool := fun j => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (hc j))
  have hMs : ∀ j, (Ms j).DecidesInSpace (As j) fun n => c j * logSpace n :=
    fun j => Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hc j))
  set cs := ∑ j, c j with hcs
  have hcj : ∀ j, c j ≤ cs := fun j =>
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := c) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  set oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool :=
    fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V with horacle
  set q := Fintype.card (CSt (Λ × Ph) (CleanSt (BankS Ms) (bankK Ms)) m) with hq
  refine ⟨mcompileFinTM A l₀ (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms),
    q + 4 + 3 * (m + (bankK Ms + bankK Ms)) * (2 * ((cs + 1) * (m + 3)) + 1), fun x => ?_⟩
  set n := x.length with hn
  set Wn := W n with hWn
  set Pn := P n with hPn
  set B := cs * logSpace (2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * Wn + 2)) + 1 with hB
  obtain ⟨N, h1, h2, hm⟩ := hcorr x
  have hguard : ∀ t < N, MGuard A oracle (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms) B Wn Pn x
      (mrun A oracle x ((some l₀, fun _ => 0, none), (fun _ => false, 0)) t) := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨hps, hbd, hp⟩ := hm t ht
    refine ⟨?_, fun r => by exact_mod_cast hbd r, hp⟩
    generalize hat : (mrun A oracle x ((some l₀, fun _ => 0, none), (fun _ => false, 0)) t).1 =
      a at hps hbd
    rcases a with ⟨_ | l, v, res⟩
    · trivial
    · simp only [Pre]
      cases hA : A.detPart false l with
      | jeq r s' l₁ l₀' => simpa [PreS, hA] using hps
      | jeqIn r l₁ l₀' => simpa [PreS, hA] using hps
      | jeqFst r l₁ l₀' => simpa [PreS, hA] using hps
      | jeqSnd r l₁ l₀' => simpa [PreS, hA] using hps
      | inc => trivial
      | dec => trivial
      | clr => trivial
      | half => trivial
      | jz => trivial
      | jodd => trivial
      | ret => trivial
      | valP => trivial
      | valQ => trivial
      | call j md args l₁ l₀' =>
      simp only [PreS, hA] at hps
      refine ⟨hps, ?_⟩
      refine cleanRun_mono (bank_cleanRun Ms As (fun j n => c j * logSpace n) hMs j _) ?_
      have hVl := length_callSegs_le (x := x) ⟨j, md, args, l₁, l₀'⟩ Wn (fun r => Nat.bits (v r))
        (fun r => by
          show (Nat.bits (v r)).length ≤ Wn
          have h0 : (Nat.bits (v r + 1)).length ≤ Wn := hbd r
          have hle : (Nat.bits (v r)).length ≤ (Nat.bits (v r + 1)).length :=
            length_bits_mono (by omega)
          omega) hps
      rw [← hn] at hVl
      have hlog : logSpace (vword (callSegs ⟨j, md, args, l₁, l₀'⟩ x
          fun r => Nat.bits (v r))).length ≤ logSpace (2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * Wn + 2)) := by
        simp only [logSpace]
        have := Nat.log_mono_right (b := 2) hVl
        omega
      have hcm : c j * logSpace (vword (callSegs ⟨j, md, args, l₁, l₀'⟩ x
          fun r => Nat.bits (v r))).length ≤ cs * logSpace (2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * Wn + 2)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (hcj j) hlog
      show max _ 1 ≤ B
      exact max_le (hcm.trans (by omega)) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨T, e1, e2, e3⟩ := marm_run (x := x) A l₀ oracle (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms) B Wn Pn N l₀
    (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => false) 0 [] (MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x) h1 h2
    hguard
  rw [← mcompileTM_init] at e1 e2 e3
  simp only [List.nil_append] at e2
  have hcount := runFrom_count_eq (K := m + (bankK Ms + bankK Ms)) (x := x)
    (mcompileTM A l₀ (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms))
    (Wn + 1 + B) Pn T
    (fun q' a w => by
      simp only [mcompileTM]
      cases mop A q' with
      | none => left; simp [liftAct]
      | some i => cases i <;> simp [memAct])
    e1
    (fun t ht => by
      obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3⟩ := e3 t ht
      refine ⟨fun i => ?_, b3⟩
      refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun k => ?_) i
      · have := b1 r
        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> push_cast <;> omega
      · have := b2 k
        rw [abs_le] at this ⊢; constructor <;> push_cast <;> omega)
  rw [FinTM.computesInTime_iff]
  have hb := count_bound q n (m + (bankK Ms + bankK Ms)) Wn cs m Pn
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · show ((mcompileTM A l₀ (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms)).runFrom
      ((mcompileTM A l₀ (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms)).initCfg x) _).state = none
    rw [← Nat.add_sub_of_le hb, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hcount, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt _ e1]
    exact e1
  · show ((mcompileTM A l₀ (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms)).runFrom
      ((mcompileTM A l₀ (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms)).initCfg x) _).output = _
    rw [← Nat.add_sub_of_le hb, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hcount, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt _ e1]
    exact e2

end Bridge

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMProof
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMReach

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Nondeterministic abstract register machines

A *nondeterministic abstract register machine* (`Complexity.LogProg.NARM`) is an abstract
register machine (`Complexity.LogProg.ARM`) with one more instruction, `choose l₁ l₀`: go to
`l₁` or to `l₀`, nondeterministically. Its runs are indexed by *choice words* — one bit per
step, consumed left to right, ignored by the deterministic instructions — exactly as the runs
of the binary-choice machines `Turing.NDTM` [AB09, §2.1.2]. This is how nondeterministic
logspace algorithms are described in [AB09, §4.3] ("guess the next vertex"); the compilation
onto `Turing.FinNDTM` is in `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARMCompile` and the
space theorem in `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARMRun`, the bridges to `NL` and
`NPSPACE` in `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARMProof`.

The machine model is infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1–4.3], not itself a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.NIns`, `Complexity.LogProg.NARM` — instructions and machines.
* `Complexity.LogProg.NARM.detPart` — the deterministic machine answering `β` at the
  `choose` labels (used by the compilation).
* `Complexity.LogProg.nastep`, `Complexity.LogProg.narun` — the semantics under choice bits
  and choice words.
* `Complexity.LogProg.NPreS`, `Complexity.LogProg.NPre` — the preconditions of a step.
* `Complexity.LogProg.NHalts` — every choice word of a given length halts the machine through
  configurations satisfying a guard; `Complexity.LogProg.NAns` — some choice word of that
  length ends with a given answer.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.narun_append`, `Complexity.LogProg.narun_halted` — the run algebra.
* the combinators `Complexity.LogProg.NHalts.det`, `NHalts.choose`, `NHalts.run`,
  `NHalts.mono_len` (and their converses `NHalts.of_det`, `NHalts.of_choose`), and
  `Complexity.LogProg.nans_det`, `nans_choose`, `nans_run`, `nans_mono_len`, for proving
  machines correct by induction over their loops.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§2.1.2, §4.1, §4.3.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

variable {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- The instructions of a nondeterministic abstract register machine: a deterministic
instruction, or a nondeterministic branch. -/
inductive NIns (m d : ℕ) (Λ : Type) where
  /-- a deterministic instruction of `Complexity.LogProg.Ins` -/
  | det (i : Ins m d Λ)
  /-- go to `l₁` (choice bit `1`) or to `l₀` (choice bit `0`) -/
  | choose (l₁ l₀ : Λ)

/-- A nondeterministic abstract register machine: an instruction at every label. -/
abbrev NARM (m d : ℕ) (Λ : Type) := Λ → NIns m d Λ

/-- The branch targets of a `choose` instruction (`none` for a deterministic one). -/
def NIns.targets {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} : NIns m d Λ → Option (Λ × Λ)
  | .det _ => none
  | .choose l₁ l₀ => some (l₁, l₀)

/-- The deterministic part of a nondeterministic machine, answering `β` at the `choose`
labels. The compiled nondeterministic machine agrees with the compiled `A.detPart β` away from
the `choose` labels. -/
def NARM.detPart (A : NARM m d Λ) (β : Bool) : ARM m d Λ := fun l =>
  match A l with
  | .det i => i
  | .choose _ _ => .ret β

/-- At a deterministic label the deterministic part is the instruction. -/
lemma NARM.detPart_det {A : NARM m d Λ} {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i)
    (β : Bool) : A.detPart β l = i := by
  simp [NARM.detPart, hA]

/-- At a `choose` label the deterministic part answers `β`. -/
lemma NARM.detPart_choose {A : NARM m d Λ} {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} (hA : A l = .choose l₁ l₀)
    (β : Bool) : A.detPart β l = .ret β := by
  simp [NARM.detPart, hA]

open Classical in
/-- **One step of a nondeterministic abstract register machine** under the choice bit `b`: a
deterministic instruction behaves as in `astep` (ignoring `b`), `choose l₁ l₀` moves to `l₁`
if `b` and to `l₀` otherwise, keeping the values; halted configurations are fixed. -/
noncomputable def nastep (A : NARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) : AConf m Λ → AConf m Λ
  | (none, v, res) => (none, v, res)
  | (some l, v, res) =>
    match A l with
    | .det i => astep (fun _ => i) oracle x (some l, v, res)
    | .choose l₁ l₀ => (some (if b then l₁ else l₀), v, res)

/-- The run of a nondeterministic abstract register machine under a choice word, one bit per
step, consumed left to right. -/
noncomputable def narun (A : NARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (x : List Bool) : List Bool → AConf m Λ → AConf m Λ
  | [], a => a
  | b :: σ, a => narun A oracle x σ (nastep A oracle x b a)

/-- The syntactic preconditions of a nondeterministic step: those of the deterministic
instruction (`PreS`), none at a `choose`. -/
def NPreS (A : NARM m d Λ) (x : List Bool) (a : AConf m Λ) : Prop :=
  PreS (A.detPart false) x a

/-- The preconditions of a nondeterministic step: those of the deterministic instruction
(`Pre`, including clean decider runs within head range `B`), none at a `choose`. -/
def NPre (A : NARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD)
    (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (a : AConf m Λ) : Prop :=
  Pre (A.detPart false) oracle D q0 B x a

section Semantics

variable {A : NARM m d Λ} {oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool}

/-- At a deterministic label a nondeterministic step is the step of the deterministic part,
whatever the choice bit. -/
lemma nastep_det {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i) (β b : Bool) (v : Fin m → ℕ)
    (res : Option Bool) :
    nastep A oracle x b (some l, v, res) = astep (A.detPart β) oracle x (some l, v, res) := by
  simp only [nastep, hA, astep, NARM.detPart_det hA β]

/-- At a `choose` label a nondeterministic step follows the choice bit. -/
lemma nastep_choose {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} (hA : A l = .choose l₁ l₀) (b : Bool) (v : Fin m → ℕ)
    (res : Option Bool) :
    nastep A oracle x b (some l, v, res) = (some (if b then l₁ else l₀), v, res) := by
  simp only [nastep, hA]

/-- A halted configuration is fixed by every nondeterministic step. -/
@[simp] lemma nastep_none (b : Bool) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (res : Option Bool) :
    nastep A oracle x b (none, v, res) = (none, v, res) := rfl

/-- The empty choice word runs no step. -/
@[simp] lemma narun_nil (a : AConf m Λ) : narun A oracle x [] a = a := rfl

/-- Consuming one choice bit is one step. -/
lemma narun_cons (b : Bool) (σ : List Bool) (a : AConf m Λ) :
    narun A oracle x (b :: σ) a = narun A oracle x σ (nastep A oracle x b a) := rfl

/-- Running under `σ ++ τ` is running under `σ`, then under `τ`. -/
lemma narun_append (σ τ : List Bool) (a : AConf m Λ) :
    narun A oracle x (σ ++ τ) a = narun A oracle x τ (narun A oracle x σ a) := by
  induction σ generalizing a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b σ ih => exact ih _

/-- A halted configuration stays put under every choice word. -/
@[simp] lemma narun_halted (σ : List Bool) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (res : Option Bool) :
    narun A oracle x σ (none, v, res) = (none, v, res) := by
  induction σ with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b σ ih => exact ih

/-- A configuration halted under a prefix stays put under any extension. -/
lemma narun_append_of_halted {σ : List Bool} {a : AConf m Λ}
    (h : (narun A oracle x σ a).1 = none) (τ : List Bool) :
    narun A oracle x (σ ++ τ) a = narun A oracle x σ a := by
  rw [narun_append]
  obtain ⟨⟨_ | l, v, res⟩, e⟩ : ∃ c, narun A oracle x σ a = c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · rw [e, narun_halted]
  · rw [e] at h; simp at h

/-- The preconditions of the deterministic part do not depend on the answer at the `choose`
labels. -/
lemma pre_detPart (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B : ℕ) (β : Bool)
    (a : AConf m Λ) : Pre (A.detPart β) oracle D q0 B x a ↔ NPre A oracle D q0 B x a := by
  rcases a with ⟨_ | l, v, res⟩
  · exact Iff.rfl
  · unfold NPre
    cases hA : A l with
    | det i => simp only [Pre, NARM.detPart_det hA]
    | choose l₁ l₀ => simp only [Pre, NARM.detPart_choose hA]

/-- **A deterministic run inside a nondeterministic machine.** If the deterministic part runs
`T` steps from `a` without meeting a `choose` label (before time `T`), then every choice word
of length at most `T` drives the nondeterministic machine along the same run. -/
lemma narun_eq_arun (β : Bool) (a : AConf m Λ) (T : ℕ)
    (hdet : ∀ t < T, ∀ l, (arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a t).1 = some l → (A l).targets = none)
    (σ : List Bool) (hσ : σ.length ≤ T) :
    narun A oracle x σ a = arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a σ.length := by
  induction σ generalizing a T with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b σ ih =>
    obtain ⟨T, rfl⟩ : ∃ T', T = T' + 1 := ⟨T - 1, by simp at hσ; omega⟩
    have hstep : nastep A oracle x b a = astep (A.detPart β) oracle x a := by
      rcases a with ⟨_ | l, v, res⟩
      · rfl
      · have h0 := hdet 0 (by omega) l rfl
        cases hA : A l with
        | det i => exact nastep_det hA β b v res
        | choose l₁ l₀ => rw [hA] at h0; simp [NIns.targets] at h0
    rw [narun_cons, hstep, List.length_cons, arun_succ]
    refine ih _ T (fun t ht l hl => hdet (t + 1) (by omega) l ?_) (by simp at hσ; omega)
    rwa [arun_succ]

end Semantics

/-! ## Proving nondeterministic machines correct -/

/-- **All branches halt**: every choice word `σ` of length `N` halts the machine from `a`, and
every live configuration along the run satisfies the guard `G`. -/
def NHalts (A : NARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (G : AConf m Λ → Prop) (a : AConf m Λ) (N : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ σ : List Bool, σ.length = N → (narun A oracle x σ a).1 = none ∧
    ∀ t < N, (narun A oracle x (σ.take t) a).1 ≠ none → G (narun A oracle x (σ.take t) a)

/-- **Some branch answers `b`**: some choice word of length `N` ends the run from `a` with the
answer `b`. -/
def NAns (A : NARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (a : AConf m Λ) (N : ℕ) (b : Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ σ : List Bool, σ.length = N ∧ (narun A oracle x σ a).2.2 = some b

section Combinators

/-- A prefix of length `s ≥ N` is the prefix of length `N` followed by a prefix of the rest. -/
lemma take_split (σ : List Bool) {N s : ℕ} (h : N ≤ s) :
    σ.take s = σ.take N ++ (σ.drop N).take (s - N) := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, s = N + k := ⟨s - N, by omega⟩
  rw [List.take_add]; simp

variable {A : NARM m d Λ} {oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool} {G : AConf m Λ → Prop}

/-- A halted configuration halts on every branch. -/
lemma NHalts.halted (v : Fin m → ℕ) (res : Option Bool) (N : ℕ) :
    NHalts A oracle x G (none, v, res) N :=
  fun σ _ => ⟨by simp, fun t _ h => by simp at h⟩

/-- All-branch halting through a guard is all-branch halting through any weaker guard. -/
lemma NHalts.mono {G' : AConf m Λ → Prop} {a : AConf m Λ} {N : ℕ}
    (h : NHalts A oracle x G a N) (hG : ∀ c, G c → G' c) : NHalts A oracle x G' a N :=
  fun σ hσ => ⟨(h σ hσ).1, fun t ht hl => hG _ ((h σ hσ).2 t ht hl)⟩

/-- **All-branch halting is monotone in the length.**

**Proof sketch.** A word of length `N' ≥ N` is its prefix of length `N`, which halts, followed
by bits that change nothing (`narun_append_of_halted`); guards beyond `N` are at halted
configurations. -/
lemma NHalts.mono_len {a : AConf m Λ} {N N' : ℕ} (h : NHalts A oracle x G a N)
    (hN : N ≤ N') : NHalts A oracle x G a N' := by
  intro σ hσ
  have hlen : (σ.take N).length = N := by simp; omega
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h (σ.take N) hlen
  have e : ∀ s, N ≤ s → narun A oracle x (σ.take s) a = narun A oracle x (σ.take N) a := by
    intro s hs
    have : σ.take s = σ.take N ++ (σ.drop N).take (s - N) := by
      exact take_split σ hs
    rw [this, narun_append_of_halted h1]
  refine ⟨?_, fun t ht hl => ?_⟩
  · have := e N' hN; rw [← hσ, List.take_length] at this; rw [this]; exact h1
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t N with htN | htN
    · have := h2 t htN
      rw [List.take_take, min_eq_left htN.le] at this
      exact this hl
    · rw [e t htN] at hl; exact absurd h1 hl

/-- **A deterministic step**: if the guard holds at a live configuration at a deterministic
label, and the machine halts on every branch after the step, it halts on every branch from
the configuration, one step later. -/
lemma NHalts.det {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i) (β : Bool) {v : Fin m → ℕ}
    {res : Option Bool} {N : ℕ} (hG : G (some l, v, res))
    (h : NHalts A oracle x G (astep (A.detPart β) oracle x (some l, v, res)) N) :
    NHalts A oracle x G (some l, v, res) (N + 1) := by
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨b, σ', rfl⟩ : ∃ b σ', σ = b :: σ' := by
    cases σ with
    | nil => simp at hσ
    | cons b σ' => exact ⟨b, σ', rfl⟩
  simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hσ
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h σ' hσ
  refine ⟨by rw [narun_cons, nastep_det hA β]; exact h1, fun t ht hl => ?_⟩
  cases t with
  | zero => exact hG
  | succ t =>
    simp only [List.take_succ_cons, narun_cons, nastep_det hA β] at hl ⊢
    exact h2 t (by omega) hl

/-- **A `choose`**: if the guard holds at a live configuration at a `choose` label, and the
machine halts on every branch from both targets, it halts on every branch from the
configuration, one step later.

**Proof sketch.** A word of length `N + 1` is a bit `b` followed by a word of length `N`; the
first step moves to the target selected by `b`, from which the rest halts with the guard along
the way; the guard at time `0` is the hypothesis. -/
lemma NHalts.choose {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} (hA : A l = .choose l₁ l₀) {v : Fin m → ℕ}
    {res : Option Bool} {N : ℕ} (hG : G (some l, v, res))
    (h₁ : NHalts A oracle x G (some l₁, v, res) N) (h₀ : NHalts A oracle x G (some l₀, v, res) N) :
    NHalts A oracle x G (some l, v, res) (N + 1) := by
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨b, σ', rfl⟩ : ∃ b σ', σ = b :: σ' := by
    cases σ with
    | nil => simp at hσ
    | cons b σ' => exact ⟨b, σ', rfl⟩
  simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hσ
  have key : ∀ c : Bool, NHalts A oracle x G (some (if c then l₁ else l₀), v, res) N := by
    intro c; cases c
    · simpa using h₀
    · simpa using h₁
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := key b σ' hσ
  refine ⟨by rw [narun_cons, nastep_choose hA]; exact h1, fun t ht hl => ?_⟩
  cases t with
  | zero => exact hG
  | succ t =>
    simp only [List.take_succ_cons, narun_cons, nastep_choose hA] at hl ⊢
    exact h2 t (by omega) hl

/-- **A deterministic run**: if the deterministic part runs `T` steps from `a` to `a'` without
meeting a `choose` label, through configurations satisfying the guard, and the machine halts
on every branch from `a'` within `N`, it halts on every branch from `a` within `T + N`.

**Proof sketch.** On the first `T` bits the nondeterministic run is the deterministic one
(`narun_eq_arun`), reaching `a'`; the remaining `N` bits halt from `a'`. Guards before `T`
are those of the deterministic run, later ones those of the run from `a'` (`take_split`). -/
lemma NHalts.run (β : Bool) {a a' : AConf m Λ} {T N : ℕ}
    (he : arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a T = a')
    (hG : ∀ t < T, G (arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a t) ∧
      ∀ l, (arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a t).1 = some l → (A l).targets = none)
    (h : NHalts A oracle x G a' N) : NHalts A oracle x G a (T + N) := by
  intro σ hσ
  have hT : (σ.take T).length = T := by simp; omega
  have e1 : narun A oracle x (σ.take T) a = a' := by
    rw [narun_eq_arun β a T (fun t ht => (hG t ht).2) _ hT.le, hT, he]
  have hd : (σ.drop T).length = N := by simp; omega
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h (σ.drop T) hd
  refine ⟨by rw [← List.take_append_drop T σ, narun_append, e1]; exact h1, fun t ht hl => ?_⟩
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T with htT | htT
  · have hlen : (σ.take t).length ≤ T := by simp; omega
    rw [narun_eq_arun β a T (fun t ht => (hG t ht).2) _ hlen] at hl ⊢
    have : (σ.take t).length = t := by simp; omega
    rw [this]; exact (hG t htT).1
  · have e : σ.take t = σ.take T ++ (σ.drop T).take (t - T) := by
      exact take_split σ htT
    rw [e, narun_append, e1] at hl ⊢
    exact h2 (t - T) (by omega) hl

/-- The guard holds at the start of a run halting on every branch, if the start is live. -/
lemma NHalts.guard {l : Λ} {v : Fin m → ℕ} {res : Option Bool} {N : ℕ}
    (h : NHalts A oracle x G (some l, v, res) (N + 1)) : G (some l, v, res) := by
  have := (h (List.replicate (N + 1) false) (by simp)).2 0 (by omega)
  simpa using this

/-- All branches from a deterministic step halt one step earlier from its successor. -/
lemma NHalts.of_det {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i) (β : Bool) {v : Fin m → ℕ}
    {res : Option Bool} {N : ℕ} (h : NHalts A oracle x G (some l, v, res) (N + 1)) :
    NHalts A oracle x G (astep (A.detPart β) oracle x (some l, v, res)) N := by
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h (false :: σ) (by simp [hσ])
  refine ⟨by rwa [narun_cons, nastep_det hA β] at h1, fun t ht hl => ?_⟩
  have := h2 (t + 1) (by omega)
  simp only [List.take_succ_cons, narun_cons, nastep_det hA β] at this
  exact this hl

/-- All branches from a `choose` halt one step earlier from either target. -/
lemma NHalts.of_choose {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} (hA : A l = .choose l₁ l₀) (b : Bool) {v : Fin m → ℕ}
    {res : Option Bool} {N : ℕ} (h : NHalts A oracle x G (some l, v, res) (N + 1)) :
    NHalts A oracle x G (some (if b then l₁ else l₀), v, res) N := by
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h (b :: σ) (by simp [hσ])
  refine ⟨by rwa [narun_cons, nastep_choose hA] at h1, fun t ht hl => ?_⟩
  have := h2 (t + 1) (by omega)
  simp only [List.take_succ_cons, narun_cons, nastep_choose hA] at this
  exact this hl

/-- The answers of a halted configuration. -/
lemma nans_halted (v : Fin m → ℕ) (res : Option Bool) (N : ℕ) (b : Bool) :
    NAns A oracle x (none, v, res) N b ↔ res = some b := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, -, h⟩; simpa using h
  · intro h; exact ⟨List.replicate N false, by simp, by simpa using h⟩

/-- **The answers after a deterministic step** are those of the next configuration. -/
lemma nans_det {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i) (β : Bool) (v : Fin m → ℕ)
    (res : Option Bool) (N : ℕ) (b : Bool) :
    NAns A oracle x (some l, v, res) (N + 1) b ↔
      NAns A oracle x (astep (A.detPart β) oracle x (some l, v, res)) N b := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, h⟩
    obtain ⟨c, σ', rfl⟩ : ∃ c σ', σ = c :: σ' := by
      cases σ with
      | nil => simp at hσ
      | cons c σ' => exact ⟨c, σ', rfl⟩
    refine ⟨σ', by simpa using hσ, ?_⟩
    rwa [narun_cons, nastep_det hA β] at h
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, h⟩
    exact ⟨false :: σ, by simp [hσ], by rwa [narun_cons, nastep_det hA β]⟩

/-- **The answers after a `choose`** are those of either target. -/
lemma nans_choose {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} (hA : A l = .choose l₁ l₀) (v : Fin m → ℕ)
    (res : Option Bool) (N : ℕ) (b : Bool) :
    NAns A oracle x (some l, v, res) (N + 1) b ↔
      NAns A oracle x (some l₁, v, res) N b ∨ NAns A oracle x (some l₀, v, res) N b := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, h⟩
    obtain ⟨c, σ', rfl⟩ : ∃ c σ', σ = c :: σ' := by
      cases σ with
      | nil => simp at hσ
      | cons c σ' => exact ⟨c, σ', rfl⟩
    rw [narun_cons, nastep_choose hA] at h
    cases c
    · exact Or.inr ⟨σ', by simpa using hσ, by simpa using h⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨σ', by simpa using hσ, by simpa using h⟩
  · rintro (⟨σ, hσ, h⟩ | ⟨σ, hσ, h⟩)
    · exact ⟨true :: σ, by simp [hσ], by rw [narun_cons, nastep_choose hA]; simpa using h⟩
    · exact ⟨false :: σ, by simp [hσ], by rw [narun_cons, nastep_choose hA]; simpa using h⟩

/-- **The answers after a deterministic run** (without `choose` labels) are those of its end. -/
lemma nans_run (β : Bool) {a a' : AConf m Λ} {T : ℕ}
    (he : arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a T = a')
    (hdet : ∀ t < T, ∀ l, (arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a t).1 = some l → (A l).targets = none)
    (N : ℕ) (b : Bool) : NAns A oracle x a (T + N) b ↔ NAns A oracle x a' N b := by
  have key : ∀ σ τ : List Bool, σ.length = T →
      narun A oracle x (σ ++ τ) a = narun A oracle x τ a' := by
    intro σ τ hσ
    rw [narun_append, narun_eq_arun β a T hdet σ hσ.le, hσ, he]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, h⟩
    refine ⟨σ.drop T, by simp; omega, ?_⟩
    rwa [← List.take_append_drop T σ, key _ _ (by simp; omega)] at h
  · rintro ⟨τ, hτ, h⟩
    exact ⟨List.replicate T false ++ τ, by simp [hτ], by rwa [key _ _ (by simp)]⟩

/-- **Answers are stable beyond all-branch halting**: if every branch halts within `N`, the
answers of branches of any length `N' ≥ N` are those of length `N`. -/
lemma nans_mono_len {a : AConf m Λ} {N N' : ℕ} (h : NHalts A oracle x G a N) (hN : N ≤ N')
    (b : Bool) : NAns A oracle x a N' b ↔ NAns A oracle x a N b := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, hb⟩
    have hlen : (σ.take N).length = N := by simp; omega
    refine ⟨σ.take N, hlen, ?_⟩
    rwa [← List.take_append_drop N σ, narun_append_of_halted (h _ hlen).1] at hb
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, hb⟩
    refine ⟨σ ++ List.replicate (N' - N) false, by simp; omega, ?_⟩
    rwa [narun_append_of_halted (h σ hσ).1]

end Combinators

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-
